Rival Smart Pot: IQ of about 100. Rival's "Smart Pot" is a pretty good crock pot that offers an oval shape for easy handling of longer pieces of meat and an hourly time control that automatically switches to warm at the end of the heating cycle. This crock pot is a little fancier than others and it offers a more modern look and appeal.
However, there are some flaws with this product- flaws that I didn't really notice or even think about until I started to use the pot. First of all, there is no way to set the crock pot directly on warm. The pot will switch to warm only after a timed cycle has ended. This is bad for those situations when all you need is to keep something warm. Second, there are only four timed settings to choose from: 4 hours, 6 hours, 8 hours, and 10 hours. Third, the crock pot can get very hot and doesn't have an opening at the top to let steam escape. Be careful when you lift the lid- if it's really hot, the steam can burn and cause you to react quickly by dropping the lid.
Another problem that occurs some of the time is burning. If you have a small amount of food and the liquid doesn't fill to the top, you could end up with burnt marks on the side of the ceramic container. As long as the pot is full, this isn't a problem. But it's something to watch out for if you plan to cook smaller meals.
I like the large capacity of this crock pot (six quarts) and I like the neutral color. It's also nice to be able to remove the interior pot for cleaning. It's bulky, but it's better than other crock pots (those that do not have a removable pot) that have to be cleaned by scrubbing directly.
Taken as a whole, this is an acceptable crock pot that has its good points and bad points. With a few more improvements, it could be much better. As it is, it's only average- suitable for those of us to don't do much cooking but inadequate for the more serious chefs among us.

Nice Kitchen Aid, but has its Limitations. Kitchen gadgets are great for reducing the time it takes to prepare food and the Vidalia Chop Wizard Food Processor is one of many time- saving devices that make it easier to slice and dice food. Cutting onions into hundreds of small squares is easy with the Vidalia Chop Wizard Food Processor and it is also very useful for certain other foods such as pears, potatoes, and more. The sharp, stainless steel blades chop food into uniform pieces, saving much time and effort.

The Vidalia Chop Wizard Food Processor doubles as a quick measuring tool and this fact adds convenience. Once you have pressed the food through the blades, all you need to do is lift the device and turn it upright. You can then view the amount of food by looking at the cup and milliliter markings on the sides of the base. This eliminates the extra step of measuring the chopped food in a measuring cup.

Probably the greatest disadvantage with the Vidalia Chop Wizard Food Processor is the fact that it comes with only two blade inserts. For more experienced and more creative chefs, this isn't going to be nearly enough and it greatly limits the chopper's usefulness. Also, one needs to remember that certain foods require a much harder push than others, to pass them through the blades. Often, it will be necessary to cut up food into smaller pieces first, making the device less convenient than it would otherwise be.

Vidalia Chop Wizard Food Processor is dishwasher safe and it does come with a special cleaning device to make it easy to help with the process. Unfortunately, the claw- like cleaning aid is quite limited in its usefulness. It is better than nothing, but I find that I often need to reach for a butter knife to dislodge the bits of food.

So how does the Vidalia Chop Wizard Food Processor stack up overall? Well, it is a decent kitchen aid and a tool that I find fairly useful for simple chopping jobs. It is completely manual and it takes a good push to chop certain foods, but it is still better than no assistance at all. It makes a good choice for the casual cook who needs a little bit of help from time to time and doesn't mind having the limitations that come with such a basic device.

Looks Nice on the Countertop, but Heat is an Issue. Large in size and requiring sufficient space, this counter top oven from Cuisinart is designed to combine the heating ability of a convection oven with the speed of a microwave oven. It offers both abilities in one, and can add convenience to most any kitchen.

This oven does have a nice appearance and it looks good on a large countertop. Its stainless steel matches well in my kitchen, with its abundance of stainless steel appliances. You need to make sure to have plenty of space for ventilating in the rear and on one side of the unit, but other than that, it easily makes the grade from an appearance standpoint.

But besides being pretty, a micro/convection oven needs to work well at heating up food and this one seems okay in most instances. The microwave works as well as any other, but I do have some other issues with this oven, and chief among them is that the outside of the unit gets very hot. You can feel the heat radiating from the inside- out and a quick check of the exterior will confirm that the heat is exiting through the outside walls of the oven. This will surprise some users at first, but you get used to it. You just have to make sure to keep your hands- and those of kids in the house- away from the unit while in operation.

This oven has several different settings from which to select. Besides the microwave setting, it has a defrost setting, warm, convection, convection bake, and convection roast. It even comes with a recipe book so you can utilize these special settings and prepare food like a pro. But one fact to keep in mind is that this unit can take a long time to heat up to high temperatures. It has little problem reaching, say, 350 but if temps get into the mid to upper 400 range, it can take longer than is worth it. For these high- temp cooking jobs, a regular oven is best. I'm not an expert on heat transfer, but it seems like the loss of heat described above is part of the problem.

Ovens are a must for any kitchen and having a microwave/convection combo is nice for certain cooking purposes. This Cuisinart model works well for the most part, but the issues with the heat convince me to rate it only average overall.

Breadman Works, but You Need to be Patient. Breadman BK1060S Two Pound Professional Bread Maker is a good bread machine for making creative loaves of bread, hot and fresh, right in your own kitchen. This bread maker offers a nice, professional- looking appearance with its metal exterior and it has many extras like fourteen different settings for specific types of bread; a fruit and nut dispenser; a built in memory that stores your settings for up to seven minutes in case of a power failure; and the ability to program the bread maker to start up to fifteen hours ahead of time.

All of these extra features are nice, but what matters most is the performance and quality of the finished product. My experiences here have been mixed, but they have improved. My first attempt resulted in a compressed block of bread that was inedible and had to be discarded. I followed the instructions presented in the included recipe guide, and later discovered the problem: The recipe book contains several errors. The recipe I consulted did not have an accurate measurement for the liquids and after looking through the guide, I noticed others errors in other recipes. One recipe, for example, calls for a tablespoon of raisins, which is obviously incorrect. I am a little surprised that the manufacturer hasn't realized these glaring mistakes and made a greater effort to correct them.

Beyond my first experience with this bread maker, I have enjoyed positive results. My more recent attempts with this bread maker have resulted in good, fresh loaves of bread and my confidence in the machine has improved. However, there are still a few areas of concern. One is that the loaf of bread, once removed, often has a patch of flour on one of the corners. This is because the paddle doesn't always mix the ingredients as well as it should and you end up with a flour- coated corner. Another area of concern is the metal paddle. When you release the loaf of bread, the paddle often pops out with the bread and lodges itself in the bottom of the loaf.

Breadman BK1060S Two Pound Professional Bread Maker is generally good, but I have noticed other peculiar qualities that are misleading at first. There are multiple points in the process where the bread maker will go several minutes without making any sound. You will think there is a possible problem with the machine and will be tempted to open the lid, check the settings, and possibly even reset, but you need to resist the temptation. The machine is fine and needs to be left alone. And, I have also learned that if you open the door early on and you have ingredients in the fruit/nut dispenser, it will often drop the extra ingredients into the bread as soon as you close the door. Again, you have to trust that everything is okay and resist the temptation to open the lid. And you need to be careful where you touch- the metal exterior looks nice, but it also conducts heat very well and can get quite hot to the touch.

Hot, fresh bread is a great addition to any meal and the Breadman BK1060S Two Pound Professional Bread Maker is a good small appliance for the purpose of making tasty, creative loaves of bread just like a professional. If you use the included recipe book, make sure to examine the recipes closely for typos and above all, exercise patience. The lack of noise and other distractions are not cause for alarm. Just let your Breadman complete its process and enjoy the finished product.

Fast Hot Water with Bodum. I like the occasional glass of hot chocolate or hot tea. Creating these beverages requires a hot water source and the Bodum Bistro Cordless Electric Water Heater is ready to assist. It heats up water to the boiling point, making it a good resource for small, individual hot water needs.

Heating up water is fast with this unit. All you do is fill it with the desired amount of water, press the on button, and wait. Minutes later, your hot water is ready to pour. The appearance of this device is nice, too, and the red (even though it doesn't match my other kitchen appliances) really stands out on the kitchen counter.

It is nice to have an appliance that heats up water so fast, but I have noticed a few problems with this small appliance. One minor issue is the lack of an off button. This concerned me at first and while I have accepted this fact, I would prefer if it had one. I have had no problem with the unit shutting off automatically once the water inside reaches the boiling point, but it would make me feel more confident if the unit had an off switch. An audible signal, warning when the water is boiling, would also be nice. Again, it isn't critical because I am always right there, close to the unit, when in use. But it would still be nice to have this added feature.

The above points are minor, but there is one aspect of this kettle that is quite annoying and that is the lid- it is hinged in the middle and that means you cannot easily reach inside for cleaning. Unless you have very small hands, the opening is too small to reach inside and scrub they way you should. Granted, the unit is intended to boil water and nothing more, but even plain old water creates deposits over time that need to be cleaned. I am a little surprised that the manufacturer didn't realize this problem. Perhaps a second edition is in the making?

Hot water is a necessary ingredient for hot tea, hot chocolate, instant soup and noodles, etc. This tea kettle gets the job done, but it has a few essential flaws that convince me to drop my rating just a tad, to the neutral, 3- star level.

Bissell Easy Sweep: A Little Much, in Many Ways. A broom and dustpan are the usual tools used for small cleanups in the kitchen or on other smooth, flat surfaces. This manual method works, but there are other options; options that get the job done without bending or stooping. One of then is the Bissell Easy Sweep Cordless Rechargeable Sweeper.

Taking this device out of the box, assembly is the first thing to complete. It is simple- you just snap the handle together, then plug it in. The sweeper can then be unplugged and used for ordinary sweeping. It can be used on flat floors or on carpet as long as the carpet is flat.

I have used this tool many times now and it is definitely a device with its share of good and bad. Looking first at the good points, this cordless sweeper works well on small jobs and picks up crumbs and other small debris without much effort. It is VERY lightweight, starts with the press of a large, flat button, and empties with the press of another button. There is no bag to empty or replace and with cordless, plug- in action, you don't need batteries.

The positive points make this device sound like a winner, but once you have used it a few times, you realize that Bissell did overlook a few important points. First, let's talk about this weight issue. It is always nice to have a sweeper that is lightweight, but the lightness in this instance is almost too much- it makes it seem low in durability and quality. The swivel action is also too much- it swivels in every direction, like it is barely held together. It seems like it is on the verge of breaking at every moment.

As for the cleaning ability, this Bissell products is only average overall. It has no problem picking up small crumbs of food, but it isn't very powerful and you often have to go back over the same area to pick everything up. Another annoyance is with the handle. Pick up the sweeper and shake it in any way, and there is a chance the handle will fall apart and have to be reattached.

So, how do I rate the Bissell Easy Sweep Cordless Rechargeable Sweeper? Well, as you can see, it has its share of good points and bad points and I can understand perfectly why some have rated it below average. I am going to go ahead and rate it at the middle, three- star level. It is not without flaws- that is certain. But it does come in handy when you need to clean up small jobs in the kitchen and as long as you keep its limited abilities in mind, it should work okay for your simpler cleaning tasks.

Taylor Digital Food Scale not Big on Intuition, but Acceptable. Those who are serious about dieting often consider a food scale an essential part of the weight management process and the Taylor scale is a handy little tool for this purpose. It checks a food's weight, matches it to the type of food, and then delivers a calculation for total calories, helping dieters and others control food intake and keep calories in check.

This scale takes a little effort to set up. The battery compartment uses watch- style batteries and it has to be opened with a very small screwdriver. It would be better, and easier, if the compartment could be opened without a screwdriver and I would like it better if it used ordinary batteries, but the setup process was acceptable at this point and I was now ready to use the scale. The manufacturer says that 1000 food items are already pre- loaded into the scale, so in most instances, it is just a matter of finding your food item in the database, placing it on the scale, and waiting for the display to show the total calories. If you have a food that is not in the database, you can add it manually, into the scale's memory, for future reference.

The Taylor scale is a useful device for checking food weight and caloric values, but I must say that it isn't the most intuitive when it comes to programming and food lookup. As I said before, you can input your own food items manually, but it takes time because all you have is a 10- key keypad, similar to a standard phone. You have to press the numbered key containing the desired letter either once, twice, or three times depending on its position on the button. This can take some time, depending on the word. Then, you have to be ready to input the number of calories in a 100 gram serving. It is a good idea to have a calculator handy for this purpose.

Serious dieters will enjoy this scale the best, but others can benefit from it as well. We could all use a little better diet management and this Taylor scale does come in handy for this purpose. It could use a little more intuition and perhaps a few more bells and whistles, as well as larger keys, but it is still a good starter unit that has the basics covered.

Convenient, But Can it Replace the Skillet Method?. Emeson Omelet Wave is a convenient device for quick preparation of an omelet in the microwave. Its semi- circle design is made to hold and shape the eggs and other ingredients into a nicely shaped omelet, prepared and ready to eat in minutes.

I was anxious to give this product a try, just to see if it could produce an omelet not only quickly, but also one that tastes as good as those prepared on the stove top. The preparation is simple enough. You just pour the eggs and other ingredients into the plastic container and pop into the microwave. In less than two minutes, the food is ready to consume.

I have to give a product like this kudos for speed, but the omelet itself? Well, I have certainly had better. The problem is that eggs turn out more like a container of scrambled eggs than an actual omelet. They lack the shape and other qualities you expect. I agree with what others have said- the results are perfect for making a breakfast burrito because what you get is just right for scrambled egg filling. The eggs taste okay, but they don't have the slightly brown look and better flavor of an omelet prepared in a skillet.

The Emson Omelet Wave is easy to clean. Its non- stick surface and small size make it a cinch to wipe clean and it is dishwasher safe. These qualities are nice, but they are not enough to eclipse the quality of the food itself, which is okay but nothing great.

I like devices that save time and effort and this contraption is certainly more convenient than cooking on the stove top. But a skillet doesn't take that much more time and if you have your mind set on the perfect omelet, the traditional preparation is the way to go. This microwave device is acceptable and makes good scrambled eggs, but it cannot take the place of a good skillet and some old- fashioned heat.

Cuisinart Thermal Coffee Maker Looks Nice, but has a Few Issues. The Cuisinart DCC- 1150 10 Cup Coffee Maker is a decent coffee maker overall with an equal share of pros and cons. I have owned several different coffee makers over the years and have used several Cuisinart coffee makers, but I never owned one until now. I was attracted to this particular model due to its appearance and its ability to save electricity. The unit automatically shuts off after it finishes brewing, then keeps the coffee warm in the thermal carafe as you gradually consume one cup at a time.

This coffee maker brews in a similar fashion to other modern coffee makers and it does have some nice features worth mentioning. I like the water filter and the permanent filter because it means cleaner, fresher tasting water, greater convenience, and less money spent on paper filters. I also like the automatic shutoff, at least in theory, because it helps conserve electricity. The carafe is unbreakable, which is nice, and the programmable functions work well. These are all good, useful features and the unit scores points in each of these areas.

Now, let's talk about the potential problems with this Cuisinart coffee maker because there are a few. The first problem I noticed when I started using this coffee maker is the difficulty in cleaning. The opening at the top of the carafe is very narrow and only the smallest hands and fingers will be able to fit inside. I have found it necessary to use a brush for cleaning purposes because there is just no way to get my hand inside. This also means, of course, that drying is a challenge. I usually turn it upside down and air- dry because other than using a hair dryer or some other air- blowing source, it is just too difficult to get inside to soak up the excess water.

The next potential problem area is the one mentioned by most consumers who own this coffee maker, and that is its inability to keep coffee hot over an extended period. The manufacturer did what it could to engineer the carafe in such a way as to maintain heat, but there are still limits to its ability. The lid seals itself shut at the end of the brewing cycle and the carafe is double- walled to keep the heat inside, but it is still limited in its capabilities so you need to hurry up and finish drinking as quickly as possible or else be faced with a pot of cold coffee.

One other potential drawback with this coffee maker is one you wouldn't think about at first. Because the carafe is metal and is non- see through like a glass carafe, there is always a chance you will forget about making a pot of coffee and just let the carafe sit there for days or even weeks without cleaning. You cannot see the actual coffee and because of this, it is very easy to forget that coffee and coffee grounds are still inside the unit. I have experienced this more than once. I pulled out the carafe and basket to prepare for a fresh pot of coffee, only to notice that the carafe still contained some leftover coffee and the basket was still filled with coffee grinds, along with some mold/mildew. I never had to worry about a problem such as this with a glass carafe because I could easily see the leftover coffee.

Cuisinart is known for its many fine products, but the Cuisinart DCC- 150 10 Cup Coffee Maker is not the picture of coffee- making excellence I was hoping for. I can fully understand why the reviews of this coffee maker are so mixed, because it does have some potential problems that could make its use impractical for some. I find it sufficient for my limited, fast- drinking needs but I can see how some consumers will have a problem with the lack of heat, cleaning, and other issues.

Cute Plates, but Handle with Care. Little Hoot and the Snowman 4- piece dessert plate gift set is a nice way to celebrate the holiday season. The small plates are just right for serving small portions of food and the design fits in nicely during this time of year.

I haven't used many Rachel Ray cookware or dish products, but these plates certainly seem like a nice set based on appearance. With the cute design, these plates could even be used as a display inside a china cabinet during the holidays. Kids and others will like the snowman and owl design and they make a good gift choice for those who like festive, holiday- specific gift items.

I agree with others who rave about the cuteness of these plates, but I also agree with a few who question their overall craftsmanship and durability. Rub your fingers across the surface of the plates and you will quickly notice that they are not smooth like a plate should be. In addition, they are quite light and seem very delicate. I am very careful when I have used them because they seem prone to shattering at the slightest mishandling. Nothing has gone wrong yet, but I am glad they are meant only for the holidays because they do not seem made to last.

Aside from the questionable construction, however, this four- piece dessert plate set seems like a nice way to put you in the holiday frame of mind. The colors and the design fit perfectly with the winter season and they make a good serving option for desserts and other, smaller fare. Just try your best to handle with care- they may not last long otherwise.

Simple Device for the Casual Wine Drinker. Oxo makes many handy gadgets that make life easier and the Oxo Steel Wine Aerator is a good one for those who drink wine. It makes the wine flow from the bottle in a widened stream, helping to aerate the wine, minimize spills, and make it taste better.

I don’t drink a large amount of wine, but I do drink some and I have found that aerators are nice for making wine pour more easily. This Oxo model is a little simpler than many others, but is also less expensive and gets the job done to a satisfactory level. I cannot tell a great difference in taste, but I certainly like the way the wine flows from the bottle. There is less chance of splashing and spilling when this device is attached to a bottle. I have found that wine pours out a little faster using this aerator than with others, and that makes me question its effectiveness. Still, it seems adequate for the job.

Oxo Steel Wine Aerator isn’t intended to be left inside the bottle, so don’t make that mistake. You still have to remove it and re- cork your wine for storage. I know that some people will go ahead and leave this in the bottle anyway, but it won’t protect wine like a cork will. Your wine won’t last long, so make sure you remove.

I own several Oxo products in my house and with the Oxo Steel Wine Aerator, we have another Oxo manufactured good to call our own. It isn’t an amazing aerator, so serious wine lovers might want to look elsewhere and invest a little more money in a more sophisticated product. But this is a good enough wine aerator to recommend. It basically does what it says and the price is right.

Warm Coffee from Beginning to End. Thermal carafe coffee makers are nice for those who like a nice, warm cup of coffee and want to save electric power. These coffee makers do not heat continuously- the metal carafe receives the hot liquid and attempts to keep it insulated and warm, from the first cup to the final drink.

I have owned two different thermal carafe- style coffee makers and have found them useful, but not perfect. This Frigidaire model is the second one I have owned and it is about as good as my Cuisinart, which means it is good, but does have some issues. The greatest issue is that it doesn’t brew very quickly and this is particularly true when you dial the strength up to high, which you will want to do because the other settings produce coffee that is too weak. In this full strength setting, you have to wait and wait for the unit to complete the brewing cycle. I haven’t timed it, but I am sure it is over 10 minutes for a full pot. This is much too long and impractical when you’re in a hurry. You are forced to brew a smaller pot when time is tight.

Cleaning/drying is another issue. This is the same problem I had with my other thermal carafe. The way it is shaped, you have a very difficult time reaching inside, under the rim, to dry after washing. If you have VERY tiny hands, it might work but even then, it will be a challenge.

Some people will not like the fact that this coffee maker isn’t capable of brewing a really HOT cup of coffee. It is true- the coffee is not as hot as the coffee produced from an ordinary coffee maker. But I don’t mind this. Warm is generally good enough for me and we tend to empty the pot in my household quickly enough that the coffee remains warm enough to enjoy.

Overall, this thermal coffee maker isn’t anything amazing, but it is about as good as other thermal coffee makers, which means it is good enough to earn a passing grade. It is priced competitively, too, so it’s worth considering if you choose to go thermal.

They Work, but Try to Protect from the Sun. My patio has several type of furniture, one of which is a carry over from my previous home of 2 years ago. The furniture that was brought with me from old home is my glass table, patio chairs, and umbrella set. The furniture itself has stood the test of time, but the cushions, well, I have had to replace them for various reasons. And one set that I purchased for a quick replacement is Pillow Perfect Rounded Outdoor Chair Cushions.

I wanted cushions with a blue color scheme and that is what convinced me to buy these. The size was right and the price was right, so I went ahead and made the purchase. Attaching the cushions to my patio chairs was simple enough and required simply tying the strings on the back of the cushion, to secure them to the chair.

The comfort level of these cushions is certainly good. They are thick and I can sit on them for a while and still feel comfy. This is certainly important, but there are two concerns I have with these cushions that could influence if I buy them again: The tendency to fade and the tendency of the strings to break off. The fading is due, of course, to exposure to the sun and because of where my table and chairs are situated, they are exposed to a good deal of sunshine. This has caused the colors to noticeably fade, even after a single summer season. If possible, it is a good idea to keep your cushions in a shaded space or remove them during the colder season and store in a safe, dry, unsunny place.

Then, there is the tendency of the strings on the back- the ones you use to tie the cushions to the chairs- the break off. When this happens, there is no easy way to fix. I have found that, as long as only one string breaks, I'm usually fine because the other will hold the cushion in place. If two break, well, your cushion may very well start to flop in the wind. It really depends on how often you use the cushions. If you sit in them and move around a lot, like we do, then eventually, the strings are going to break.

Chair cushions are necessary when you on a patio set like mine and these cushions are fine for occasional use. Like I said, you can extend the life of the cushions and prevent fading by keeping out of the sun, but the issue with fading and the tendency of the strings to break off convince me to lower my rating to average overall.

It's Okay, but the Pump Design Needs Improvement. Permanent liquid soap dispensers are nice to have around. They are refillable and they cut down on costs because you can purchase a larger bottle of soap and save money per ounce. For this reason, I was happy to give the InterDesign Midi Soap Pump Caddy a try. It seemed like a nice addition to the kitchen, next to the sink, so I loaded it with liquid soap and put it to use.

From the outside, this dispenser has a nice appearance. The brushed nickel is attractive and I like that the soap dispenser is clear and completely see- through because that means I will know when the soap is about to run out. The two caddy holders are nice, too, because they can be used to store sponges and other items, for easy access.

As for the soap dispenser itself, it does look nice, but I have issues with the design that convince me to lower my overall rating. The greatest problem I have is with the dispensing mechanism. You press down to release soap and it returns to its normal position, which is expected, but the problem is that there is not enough space to press down. The pump needs to be re-designed to elevate it higher above the base. This would allow for more clearance and result in the right amount of liquid soap getting dispensed. The way it works now, you have to place your hands very close to the base and, with so little space, a single pump dispenses only a small amount of soap, and to the edge of your hand. It would be better if the nozzle was not only higher up, but also if it stretched further from the base in order to deposit the soap closer to the middle of the hand.

If you can get past the frustration with dispensing, you will find that the InterDesign Midi Soap Pump Caddy is a decent product. It makes an attractive enough addition to the kitchen and it has enough weight that it doesn’t require holding the base in order to use, like many of the plastic bottles do. It holds enough soap that it should go far between refills and it does have added compartments for storing other items, even if they are not all that large. Still, it’s difficult to ignore the dispensing design and I can understand why so many people rate this below average. I’m going to be more understanding and give this product 3 stars, but the manufacturer should definitely spend time on making what should be simple improvements.

Grill and Griddle at once with George Foreman. George Foreman Dual Surface Griddle and Grill is an appliance with a familiar name. We own and use two different George Foreman grills in our home and since it’s a brand we trust, we had no problem welcoming a third grill into the fold.

The first thing you notice about this grill is the size. It’s a BIG grill, and it does take up considerable counter space. You need to make sure you have room to accommodate before you purchase. The other thing you notice is, of course, the dual nature of this appliance. It combines the features of a George Foreman Grill with those of a standard griddle. With this type of design, you can cook different foods using the different surfaces, so it does have some good, practical use.

I like the idea of a dual cooking device like this one, but once you use this appliance, you do notice a few problems. The greatest issue for me is the small size of the griddle surface. It’s just not large enough to make it useful for a family, as it can hold only a few fried eggs and pancakes at once. I was surprised when I first looked at the actual grill because I assumed it would be split down the middle, with the griddle on one side and the grill on the other. Instead, the grill sections are on both sides with the griddle in the center. It works, I suppose, but a little more attention to the griddle surface would have been better.

Overall, my opinion of this appliance is mixed. It seems to heat well and prepare food with a good deal of consistency, but when we griddle, it’s usually a large number of items all at once and this appliance isn’t large enough to accommodate. So, we will likely stick with using or regular George Foreman Grill and regular griddle when we need this dual- action, but that doesn’t mean this is a bad appliance. It does have its merits and it does carry the George Foreman name. Add everything together and I think the good outweigh the bad, enough to award this with an average rating and small recommendation.

Have a Happy Halloween. Want something to welcome guests into your home this Halloween season? If so, then a good option is the DII Happy Halloween Decoration Banner. It spells out the two words Happy Halloween in reasonably eye- catching fashion, letting everyone know that the spirit of Halloween is in high gear.

We often have Halloween parties at our house so when I learned about this banner, I decided it would be a nice addition to the décor. The banner is about 9.5 feet wide so it can stretch across a fairly large space and should work well for most entry ways, tables, walls, etc. It is very light weight and easy to hang and is ready to use out of the package.

As for the design, it’s decent enough. The letters are each on their own, pennant- shaped space, with alternating pegboard background and diagonal stripe background. The letters are orange in color and the combination of background and orange and black gives the banner a decent amount of eye appeal. I say that because I can think of different designs that would have been more apt to jump out at you and thus would have been a little more Halloween- like. But these are good enough to pass.

My main issue with this Happy Halloween banner is the size of the letters. It seemed like they would be a little larger when I ordered the item, but the letters are, in fact, only about 6 inches tall. This isn’t much and they can easily get lost if the banner isn’t placed right. We were going to place this on a table, but the small letters and lack of contrast with the table cloth convinced us that using it as a welcome banner, in our home entry way, is the best way to go.

Halloween is all about decorations, celebrations, trick or treating, and the like. If you have a party in the making this Halloween season and need something to welcome guests, then this banner could be just what you’re looking for. The small size of the letters is cause for some concern, but the banner is still sufficient overall and should be good enough for most needs.

They Work, but Beware of the Thumb. Kitchen essentials are many and if you frequently use your oven, you need a good set of pot holders and oven mitts. We have a few in my household but are always in need of replacements, as many of them tend to wear out. This ongoing need was enough to convince me to get my hands on DII Cotton Heat Resistant Kitchen Pot Holder and Oven Mitt Set.

With this purchase, you get a pair of items to keep your hands protected from the heat- one mitt, and one pot holder. The black and white design is good for my kitchen because our appliances are all stainless steel or black. And the material is good because, since it is entirely made from cotton, it feels soft and is completely machine washable, which are both plusses.

We have used and generally liked these two kitchen helpers, but there is one issue I have with the mitt, and it is one I see that other reviewers have stated as well. It’s the thumb in the mitt- it isn’t long enough to make it as practical as it should be. Because it is short, I find I cannot grip a hot pan as securely as I should be able to. I haven’t burned myself or anything like that, but I find that, in order to feel safer and more secure, when I use the mitt I will often use the pot holder along with it, on my other hand, while I carry the hot pan or cookie sheet from the oven. With other mitts that have longer thumbs, I can easily pick up most hot pans with only the mitt. Not a huge issue, I suppose. But it bugs me because this seems like something that the manufacturer should have realized was a flaw and immediately corrected.

This mitt and pot holder set is attractive and matches my kitchen, but due to the issue stated above, I can only give them an average rating overall. If you have very small hands, they might be just fine but for the rest of us, the short thumb will likely be a problem, so keep that in mind if you decide to buy.

Good, Functional Toaster for the Money. Toasters are a kitchen essential. I find we don’t use our toaster as much as we once did and since my previous toaster was well- worn and had room for 4 slices, I decided it was time for something new, and smaller. My choice was the MADETEC 2 Slice Wide Slot Toaster.

With this toaster, you get the basic needs for nicely toasted slices of bread, a heated bagel, a pastry, etc. The openings are wide so most anything you need to toast will fit. The toaster has buttons for defrost, bagel, or cancel, plus a knob with seven settings to control the darkness/duration of the heating cycle.

I have had good success with this toaster when I use it for bread and other foods. The toasting seems best when set on the four or five position, but things like toaster pastries are better if you dial it back a bit. The heating elements disperse the heat just enough so that a piece of bread comes out evenly toasted, for the most part. I have found the defrost setting to be a little less reliable and I often have to run it twice it get the job done. But this is better than having things burn, so it’s not really that bad. And the springs and cancel buttons work well, almost too well, in fact. Slices of bread often pop up too high and have come very close to landing on the counter.

The red colors on the sides of this toaster would have been enough to convince me not to get it in the not- too- distant past. But I just recently obtained a set of knives with a similar shade of red, so this toaster now has something in the kitchen to match. I might very well continue this trend with my other small appliances. I have always gone with black and stainless steel, but a change of colors is probably a good idea.

It’s always a good idea to replace worn- out kitchen appliances and the MADATEC 2 Slice Wide Slot Toaster has turned out to be a change for the better. We don’t use our toaster enough anymore to warrant a 4- slice model, so 2 slices suits us well and the red color is a trend I plan to continue. The functionality is good, too, even if the springs tend to release too suddenly. Overall, this is a good toaster for the price and it should suit most household needs.

It Looks Nice, but the Tray is Too Small. Like most families, ours has a dishwasher but regardless, we still wash some dishes by hand. It could be because the dishwasher is already full or it could be because some items are better cleaned when washed by hand. Whatever the reason, hand washing is not likely to go away and that fact coupled with the need for a quality means for drip drying dishes led me to get the Homelody Dish Rack.

Straight from the box, this dish rack does look nice and its shiny stainless steel construction is one of its best qualities. It comes with separate attachments for glasses and for silverware that you can attach where you like. And since the four glass/cup holders keep the cups on the outside of the rack, there is more room on the inside for other dishes.

Homelody Dish Rack holds a good amount of dishes and I like the way it looks. But there is one problem with this dish rack that I cannot overlook and that is with the drainage tray. The tray is not large enough to capture all of the drips and anything on the edges- like cups- are going to drip water all over your counter top. You need to have a towel underneath the rack or another, larger tray, to catch these drips.

There is one other issue I have with the tray that makes it less convenient, and that is the simple fact that the tray is closed on all sides. With other dish racks, the tray is slanted in one direction with an open end that you can place right over your sink so that the water drains into the sink. There is no such feature like that with this Homelody Dish Rack. You have to periodically lift it up and pour the water down the drain.

As I said, I do like the appearance of this dish rack and it looks great in my kitchen, which is already accented with stainless steel appliances. But the issues with the drip tray are a concern and I’m not so sure I am willing to completely give up my old dish rack for this reason. I might have to shop for and purchase a large, sloping tray and use it instead. That might be enough to convince me to give this dish rack a permanent home on my kitchen counter top. But until that happens, I plan on only limited use for this dish rack and can only rate it average overall for the reasons stated above.

Inexpensive Christmas Tree, but Keep Your Vacuum Handy. We are torn in our house when it comes to Christmas decorations. My kids generally want to go all- out, with decorations in every room and on the outside of the house. I tend to get a little less carried away with the season, but I do like Christmas decorations overall and I like having multiple Christmas trees, especially if the trees are different in some important way. This desire for a second tree convinced me to add the Bocca 7 FT Christmas Artificial Pine Tree Full Branches Strong Iron Stand Indoor Outdoor 7FT tree to my home.

This tree arrives in a small box and when I received it, the box seemed too small to hold a seven foot tree. Once I opened the box and started to prepare to assemble, I could see why the box is so small. The tree is narrower than most and there are only four pieces to put together, so it is much easier than other trees to get set up and ready. My current Christmas tree requires inserting each branch separately, so it takes time. With this tree, you just attach the four pieces, spread out the branches, and you’re ready to go.

Spreading out each of the small branches on this tree does take time and once I put everything together, I realized that it would have been better to assemble one piece, then spread out all of the branches first, before moving on to the next. My kids and I were anxious to get it together so we assembled the four pieces first, then started to spread out the branches, which proved to be less efficient.

This tree comes complete with a four- leg stand so it is fairly stable compared to other tree stands I have used over the years, many of which have only three legs. The tree is lightweight, however, so you need to be careful what you place on the branches. As I started to add ornaments, I quickly found that some of them were too heavy and they caused the branches to droop. We will have to save those for our other, green Christmas tree.

Another issue I have had with this tree, and probably its greatest flaw, is the tendency of the needles to fall off. Quite a few were lost upon taking everything out of the box, but more have been lost since then. It makes me question the tree’s quality. I’m hoping that the loss of needles is temporary and the tree won’t lose any more, but I wonder if this will turn out to be true. My other tree doesn’t have any problem like this. Oh well, I guess for a price this low, you can’t expect perfection.

Our holiday décor is growing and expanding each year thanks to overly excited kids and while I think decorations need to be kept in check, I do like the idea of having two trees in the house. This white tree from Bocca is narrower than most trees and thus it can fit into many spaces where other artificial trees will not fit and a white tree is a nice change of pace from the usual green. The quality isn’t the greatest for the reasons stated above, but for a seven foot tall tree, this is a good choice for the price.

Nice but There are Some Issues. My flat screen television has been resting atop a television stand made using glass and with a wood finish for some time. The stand is okay, but it is rather low- lying and I decided that an upgrade was in store. This was enough to convince me to add the Rockpoint Plymouth 53 Inch Wood TV Stand Storage Console to my family room.

This television stand comes in a box, packed inside of another box, and requires quite a bit of assembly. Unpacking it creates quite a mess, as the Styrofoam bits scatter everywhere. When you look at the multiple bags of hardware needed to complete the assembly, you may contemplate not doing the work at all and hiring someone else to do the job.

It does take time to assemble this and it helps if you have someone to help you, so if you decide to take the plunge, get yourself an assistant. Once finished, the stand does look nice and since it is black, it blends with most any décor. I like that it even comes with a special pen that you can use to conceal scratches. This is a good thing to have and in fact, I had to use it right away because some of the pieces had scratches on them. The cabinet loses some points in this area.

This stand does, indeed, elevate my flat screen television about ten inches from its previous height, so it fulfills its purpose. Again, I’m not thrilled with the blemishes or the way the device was packed and the assembly instructions are not always easy to follow. So, overall, considering everything, this stand earns an average rating from me.

Look Nice, but Product Info is Lacking. I love a good Moscow Mule and as most everyone will agree, this is one of those drinks that needs its own, specific serving vessel to enhance the experience. For Moscow Mules, that vessel is, of course, a copper mug and a good choice for this is the Artisans Village Moscow Mule Copper Mug.

Out of the package, these copper mugs look nice. They are not exceptionally fancy in design, but the copper and the brass handle look good. The handle has a flat piece at the top which is perfect for placing your thumb, for more secure control. And best of all, these mugs keep your drink cold for a LONG time! With ordinary glass or plastic, the beverage gets warm far too quickly, especially when you take your drinks outdoors on a hot day, like I often do. These metal mugs keep the beverage cold for the duration and you can really feel the coldness when you touch the beverage- filled mugs.

So far, so good, but there are some facts about these mugs that concern me. My greatest concern is the confusion over the metal composition. Read the fact sheet on this page and it says there is nickel on the inside, which is certainly not what I expected. I assumed it was lined with stainless steel, but then I read the fine print product description and found out it is made from nickel. However, the description you see here at the top of the page says it is stainless steel. Maybe it is both? They really need to clarify this because, if it truly is nickel, some people will not be able to drink from this mug. I’m a little concerned, too, because while I am not allergic, I certainly do not want to freely use these mugs at gatherings if they really are made from nickel. I don’t want to take that chance.

All things considered, these Moscow Mule mugs from Artisans Village do look nice and they do serve to enhance a beverage. They are made for Moscow Mules, but they can be used for anything you like. I wish there was more reliable info on these mugs, but they still have their usefulness and have enough going for them to recommend.

Nice Additon to the Kitchen. Every kitchen needs a basic set of utensils. I don’t mean just spatulas and large spoons, I also mean other, misc tools and gadgets that make food prep and serving easier. A quick way to get a full set of these essentials is to buy the AmazonBasics 7-Piece Kitchen Stainless Steel Gadget Set with Rotating Stand.

This set comes complete with an ice cream scoop, pizza cutter, peeler, cheese slicer, garlic press, and cheese grater. Each item has an opening at the end of the handle, which is then placed on the holder. The holder turns so that you can spin to get the item you need. The holder/stand is light, so you have to hold the base while turning.

These gadgets/utensils feature a dark grey/black and green color combo that looks cool and with my small appliances all being black, it looks good in my kitchen. As for the gadgets themselves, they are not as large and heavy duty as some of my others. The pizza cutter, for example, has a small wheel and the ice cream scoop isn’t nearly as large as the one I use now. At first, I was hoping I could replace my older gadgets with these, but I’m going to keep them all, since my current ones are larger and seem more durable.

Made with dishwasher safe stainless steel, these gadgets are good overall and I like that they are stored on a stand because it means more space in my kitchen drawers, which are overflowing at the moment. Like I said, the individual gadgets are not the absolute best you will ever find, but they are good for most needs and the colors are attractive. It sums up to a good product overall.

It Works, but I've Had Better. We use candles in my household with a good deal of frequency. Scents are what attract us to a specific candle more than anything else and since I like the scent of coconut and pineapple, I decided it was a good idea to get the Homesick Scented Candle Poolside Pina.

This candle is a little smaller than others in our house. It burns clean and from the box, it smells pleasant. These are among the features that matter most to me in a candle. The natural soy composition is a plus, too.

Once lit, the scent emitted by this candle is not as strong as expected. I still find it good enough, but I was hoping for more. But the greatest strike against this candle, at least to me, is the lack of a lid. It is always nice when you can snap a heavy lid in place to protect your candles and store them, but there is no such lid on this candle. Another issue I have, although it’s less important, is the lack of an attractive label. All you get is a plain, black and white label with the name and a few facts.

We have candles throughout the house and Homesick Scented Candle Poolside Pina has found a permanent home on the bar between my kitchen and family room. It works, I suppose, but it isn’t one of the better candles I have owned/used.

It Works but Description is Misleading. Storage containers are a necessity for any household. We have lots of excess stuff and we need places to put it and keep it out of harm’s way. This need led me to get the DII Home Essentials Large Plate Storage Bin, a storage container recommended for dishes, photos, etc.

We are getting ready to move to a new home and because of this, we have found the need to store as much of our household contents as possible to clear the house of clutter and prepare to change residences. This was enough to convince me to obtain this storage bin. We have lots of dishes and it seemed like something that would come in very handy.

What I quickly learned when I opened the package and examined the DII Home Essentials Large Plate Storage Bin is that this container is not really meant to protect fragile dishes, like I was led to believe. Looking at other reviews, I can see that I am not the only one with this concern. The container is too flimsy to use for my glass plates and anything else that could break. It’s fine for plastic ware and that is exactly what I am using mine for. But it is not good for anything breakable and I’m a little disappointed at the manufacturer for making this misleading claim.

If you can get past the deception, you will find that this is a decent storage bin, even if it is a little on the small side. It’s only fourteen inches square and just four inches deep so it is very limited in what it can handle. I find it sufficient for my plastic plates plus other small plastic items. It won’t do for much else, but what can you expect for something this size?

Storage containers are important and they especially matter to someone in the early stages of relocation. This storage bin is acceptable, but I’m still a little annoyed that the manufacturer led me to believe it would be good for storing china and other breakables. It might work for items like that if you’re placing the storage container in one place and not moving it. But if you plan to transport anything, play it safe and use this container for plastic, clothing, or other unbreakable items. It really can’t handle much else so keep this in mind if you buy.

Keeps Your Beer Cold and Your Friends Amused. Keeping your beer chilled and ready to drink is important. Finding a way to accomplish this during a football themed party is made easy and fun with the Football Inflatable Cooler from Big Mouth, Inc.

Big Mouth manufactures many novelty items related to football and this cooler is one of a handful designed to keep items cold during a tailgate or other party. The cooler is easy to store because it comes in a small box and has to be inflated to use. I found that it does take a good effort to get it blown up and ready to use and the reason is because the blow hole has a tight seal that, even when you squeeze, doesn’t let in much breath. On the positive side, that means it also doesn’t lose air when you let go. The cooler’s interior air space volume isn’t very big but again, it is an exercise in lung power to get it inflated completely and ready for use.

The interior section of this cooler, where the beer is chilled, isn’t very large compared to the rest of the cooler, but it is big enough to hold roughly 12 bottles or cans of beer without any problem. It’s deep enough that you can stand the bottles upright and still cover them with enough ice to keep them chilled. You could possibly squeeze in more bottle or cans, but best to leave some space for the ice and purchase a second cooler if you anticipate having a large number of cans or bottles in need of chilling.

My greatest issue with this novelty item is its flimsiness. There is no solid backing and that means you need to be very careful if you use it indoors. Once the ice starts to melt and your cans/bottles are floating in slush, it will be difficult to transport it to the nearest sink or outdoors to dump. You could very easily spill the water and ice everywhere, making a big mess. This is why I recommend using it outdoors for the most part. With it safely outside, this worry is eliminated.

One other issue I have with a cooler like this is that it could get punctured and therefore may have a short usable life. The manufacturer does include a patch kit so you can repair a problem like this without too much difficulty. Still, if you’re the type who likes to play rough with your cooler, then a product like this may not last very long.

Beer is an important part of any football game experience and with the Football Inflatable Cooler, you can enjoy your beer and amuse your friends with your cool beer storage device made with football in mind. The fact that this is inflatable and plastic means it does have its share of pros and cons, but as long as you’re careful, you should find this a fun addition to your next tailgate experience.

Note: I received this product complimentary in exchange for an unbiased review, but I was not compensated in any way.

Adequate for the Amateur Juicer. Juicing is a great way to improve health. You can purchase pre- made juice, but if you really want to taste juice in its most natural form, you need to produce your own. For that, you need a small appliance to extract juice and one possible option is the AmazonBasics Wide-Mouth, 2-Speed Centrifugal Juicer with Juice Jug and Pulp Container, Black.

Utilitarian in design and functionality, this juicer has two speed settings and consists of the usual parts: Extractor/centrifuge, pulp container, chute, and plastic pusher to press the fruits and veggies through the opening along with a plastic measuring cup to catch the juice. You just turn the device on, place the plastic cup under the spout, and start pushing fruits and veggies through the opening. In a matter of minutes, you will have a serving of high- nutrient green juice, ready for consumption.

I’ve owned my share of juicers and I like them for the healthfulness that they encourage. This AmazonBasics juicer, compared to others I’ve owned, is very middle of the road overall. Among its positive points, it takes up little countertop space and I like the included plastic cup and the way it hooks itself under the spout. The measurements on the cup are handy, too, because this way you know exactly how much juice you are drinking.

Looking for cons, I am able to find a few. My greatest problem is that the centrifuge itself isn’t as efficient as it should be. It loses its grip on too much of the food contents, hurling them into the pulp container to discard. I often use kale when I juice and more often than not, I will find large pieces of kale in the pulp container. This shouldn’t happen. The juicer should be able to grip the pieces of food and extract more juice than this. I have been tempted to take the contents of the pulp container and run them through the juicer a second time for this reason.

Another concern I have with this juicer is that it seems to be working really, really hard to extract the juice. The extractor slows down as you push the food through, which is normal, but it makes an agonizing sound. And this makes me question the juicer’s durability. It seems like it will burn itself out with frequent use.

Fresh juice is a great addition to anyone’s diet. A good juicing machine is a necessary appliance when you want to make your own and the AmazonBasics Wide-Mouth, 2-Speed Centrifugal Juicer with Juice Jug and Pulp Container is one solution, albeit a weak one, to your quest for better health. It’s fine for those who only juice every now and then, but it will prove woefully inadequate for the more serious juicers in our ranks.

Looks Nice but a Little too Fragile. We drink lots of tea in our household. Making tea with ordinary tea bags is usually good enough, but lately we have taken a liking to loose leaf tea. And a means to make and serve larger servings of loose leaf tea is the MIOCARO Glass Tea Pot Warmer Set.

Glass in design with a metal base, this teapot holds one liter of tea, so it is good for about 5 cups of tea, depending on serving size. There is a metal insert in the center where you place your loose leaf tea. You then pour in hot water, let it steep, and serve. The metal base holds the teapot and serves as a warmer, since you can place a small light or short candle underneath, to keep your tea warm.

This glass tea pot looks nice and I like the warmer idea, but I have several concerns. My greatest issue, straight from the box, is the fragility of the tea pot and the way it perches on the metal base. The glass doesn’t seem very heavy and it sits on the base on a wobbly fashion. I think if the base had been designed to be a little deeper, it would make me feel better. One slight bump and the teapot will fall of the base, may crack, and have to be discarded. With the pot filled with tea, the added weight makes it a little sturdier, but I still don’t feel that safe.

The other issue I have with this tea pot is that the warmer base almost looks like it was intended to be used directly on your stovetop burner. It isn’t so make sure you don’t use it in this manner. The true intention is to use the base as a countertop warmer by placing a small light or candle in the opening below the pot. I only confirmed this by first inquiring online.

I drink more tea than any other beverage. MIOCARO Glass Tea Pot Warmer Set is a good addition to my kitchen overall and it does brew a good pot of tea. I am still concerned that its fragile nature means it won’t last very long and for that reason, I can only rate it average overall.

Two Tiers are Nice, but.... Like most people, I own a dishwasher and rely on it for most of my dishwashing needs. But there is still and will always be a need to wash dishes by hand and therefore a dish rack is a must. I prefer a durable, metal dish rack to the cheaper, plastic varieties and the latest to make its way to my kitchen is the XIGOO Dish Drying Rack.

Two- tier in design, this dish drying rack can handle a moderate number of dishes. The top rack is designed to hold plates while the bottom rack is intended for things that don’t need to be held in place. There is a side attachment for utensils, a second attachment that can hold up to three glasses or cups, and a third attachment that is good for holding a cutting board.

After using this dishrack a few times, I have come away with almost an equal share of pros and cons. I like the draining on the bottom- the water is channeled toward a drain in the center and there is an extension on the bottom that can be directed to the sink. The way it is designed, you can direct this drain in any direction. That means you can place the rack length- wise or sideways and turn the drain extender toward your sink. Having a second tier is nice as well and I like the separate attachment for knives- makes it easy to slip them into their own slot for drying.

Looking at the cons, I have found a few. For one, the dish rack is on the small side. It’s a good thing there is a second tier because the bottom tier is far too small to handle many dishes. Another thing I don’t like is that the utensil holder isn’t positioned to drain into the drip tray. There are holes to release the water, but they end up on the kitchen counter. And the two extension handles on the top rack, while they seem good for hanging a cup, will not allow the cup to dry properly because it won’t be upside down. Thus, these extenders have limited usefulness. Another issue I have is the rack's tendency to slide on the counter. The dish rack itself had non- skid feet, but the drip tray in which it sits doesn't. That means if you use the drip tray- and you almost certainly will want to- you will have to deal with it the possibility of sliding.

If you don’t have too many dishes to dry, the XIGOO Dish Drying Rack could suit your needs. I am undecided on this rack so far, for the reasons listed, and I decided to keep my previous rack within reach in case I decide I like it better and want it back. So, with an almost equal share of good and bad points, I am rating this rack average overall.

It Does What a Small Vacuum Should. Vacuum cleaners are a household essential. We have a few in my house; two larger ones and now one smaller one, the Black and Decker Dustbuster Cordless Lithium Hand Vacuum.

I was attracted to this vacuum mainly due to its size. A small vacuum is very handy for small jobs and the first thing that came to mind when I saw this vacuum was its use in my car. It’s small enough to handle vacuuming a small vehicle and the narrow nozzle would be good, I reasoned, to suck up small particles between the seats and in other tight spaces.

After using this vacuum in my car, I quickly learned a few things. One is the weak suction- other reviewers have made this point and it’s very true. There isn’t enough suction here to pick up very many things. This limits the vacuum’s usefulness, but then again, it’s only a small hand held vacuum so expectations need to be kept in check. Another issue I have is with the charge- it only lasted me about 20 minutes so don’t be surprised if you have to reach for the cord sooner than later.

With the waste and filter, I do like that it’s easy to unscrew, dump the waste, and remove and clean the filter. You don’t need to purchase small bags, which is nice. And it’s easy to see when the container is getting too full because this section is made from clear, see through plastic. Even if you couldn’t see it, you would know the container is full because the suction reduces to almost nothing. Oh, and it does have an attached, flip up brush which is good for vacuuming furniture.

So, after using the Black and Decker Dustbuster Cordless Lithium Hand Vacuum what is my final verdict? I like it, but I have a few reservations. It would be nice if it held a charge for a longer period of time and it would be great if it had a little more sucking power. Then again, this is a small, handheld vacuum so it isn’t fair to judge it by comparing to a full size vacuum. Taken as a whole, it’s good for what it does and it has proven itself handy for keeping my small car free from debris.

Well, it is Cute, Right?. When was the last time you changed your shower curtain? We have two showers in our house, one with a glass door and the other with a curtain. It has been years since we changed the curtain, so when presented with this opportunity, I went ahead and grabbed it.

With its pink colors, my girls- the primary users of the bathroom with the shower curtain- liked what they saw. I agree that the colors are pleasant and since my girls’ bathroom is neutral in color anyway, it was very easy to place this curtain and matching mat in the bathroom without anything looking weird. The more feminine colors make it good choice for a girls bathroom so in this respect, the curtain/rug combo earns some points.

However, this set from Oceanique loses points in other ways and one of them is with the shower hooks. They do not slide very well along the shower rod, due to their metal construction sliding against the metal rod. They seem cheap, too, and are not completely closed, rounded hooks. That makes it easy to remove the curtain and the hooks because they lift right off without little effort. But it’s bad because it means the hooks can pop off as you try to move the curtain back and forth. Rounded hooks take more effort to attach and remove, but they are more secure.

Looking at the quality of the material used for the shower curtain and the mat, well, they seem okay but not anything great. When I think about the going price for this set, it does seem a little high for what you get and I notice that other reviewers have made similar observations. I do like that the mat stays in place on the floor and doesn’t slide around but it seems a little too thin. And I also wish the set came with a liner. You have to supply this yourself, which seems unfair when you consider the price. The manufacturer should have included this.

Shower curtains need occasional upgrades and the Oceanique shower curtain/bathroom mat set seems like an acceptable option. I know there are better curtains on the market and I still think the set is overpriced. But it does have enough going for it- including the fact that my girls like it- to make it worth a look.

Practical Bar Stools, Pleasing to Look at. My household contains a few different bars. We have a bar in our front living area, a breakfast bar, and a bar on our patio. When you have bars, it’s always good to have bar stools to accommodate and this need led me to get the Ashley Furniture Bellatier Adjustable height Bar Stool package.

These stools are upholstered with a black- colored cushion that helps add to the comfort. They have a foot rest and a handle on the sides to adjust the height. The black and stainless steel colors means that the stools will match most décor and I find they look really nice next to our breakfast bar in the kitchen, since most of our appliances, large and small, are either stainless steel or black in color.

Assembling these bar stools is extremely easy and intuitive- you could easily figure out what to do without even reading the instructions. They are very light weight also, making them easy to transport from one place to the next. And they swivel 360 degrees so you can turn to face different directions if you like.

If I had to find some negative things to say about this product, one would be the lack of arms. Bar stools are more comfortable and look nicer if they include arms. The seat and back are small in size, so they don’t offer much room to handle different size people. Also, unless I’m completely misunderstanding something, I cannot get the adjustment arm to work. I have moved it up and down, again and again, and I cannot get the height to adjust. Lucky for me, the height at which they are presently set is just right for what I need, but if I ever decide to move the chairs someplace else, I may run into a problem since the adjustment function appears not to work.

Bar chairs are essential when your home has as many bars as mine. Ashley Furniture Bellatier Adjustable height Bar Stools are pleasing to look at and they match most décor. The issue with the adjustment lever is a concern, but other than that and other minor issues, these are good bar stools and I like that they come two in a pack.

They Work but I Have my Concerns. Frozen pizzas are a popular food option in my house, thanks to our busy schedules and the desire to make food that is quick and requires little or no prep. We need something to help get the pizza out of the oven and cut/serve and this need convinced me to get the HOMEFAVOR Pizza Paddle Spatula.

Sold as a pair, the HOMEFAVOR Pizza Paddle Spatula is good for scooping a pizza from the oven and serving it on the table or counter. The boards have an extended handle and even have a slot so that you can hang them on a hook. The beveled edge helps make it easy to get the paddle underneath a pizza, lift, and remove from the oven. Once removed, the paddles double as a cutting board and serving plate.

I like these boards and have found them useful, but I do have concerns. For one, the moment they arrived, they already had small nicks in the edge of both paddles. The nick is too small to matter now, but given that these are made of wood and can so easily get a blemish like this, it makes me wonder how long until the same thing happens again and possible splinters start to show.

Another issue I have is with the size and thickness. The boards are a little thinner than I prefer and the size, well, it isn’t that big. It can handle only a small, store- bought pizza but that’s it. Anything larger will extend over the sides of the pan. However, besides pizza, you could also use these paddle pans for other things, like for serving meat and cheese. The handles make it easy to pick them up and transport from place to place with one hand.

We like to eat pizza and the HOMEFAVOR Pizza Paddle Spatula is a good addition to our kitchen. I am concerned about the nicks, the small size, and I am also a little concerned about excessive washing taking its toll. So, overall, this is a good item but it may not be adequate for some people.

Good for Basic Needs. Dish towels are something we all use. Even if you own a dishwasher, there are items that need to be washed by hand and dish towels are good for drying so that you don’t waste paper towels. These dish towels are useful for this basic of household tasks.

Examining these dishtowels reveals that they are very soft, as one would expect for something made entirely from cotton. They are a good size and good for their intended use. They are not as super absorbent as they claim, but that shouldn’t matter for most uses.

I have a variety of dish towels in my house and one thing I have noticed, when comparing these towels to the others, is that these towels are a little bit thinner. That could explain the fact that they are a little less absorbent than they claim. Also, because of the thinness, you need to be careful how you use these towels. I know that some people like to use dish towels to grab hot pans from the oven and for that purpose, these towels are not as good as others. If you want to use them for handling hot pots and pans, just make sure you fold them several times first, to make them thicker and thereby protect your hands.

Dish towels are not the most exciting of merchandise, but they are something found in most every kitchen. These towels are not the best I have ever used, but they seem sufficient to satisfy most needs. Give them a shot if you need the basics covered.

Looks Like a Miniature Tree, but a Little too Fake. How do you make a boring space look better? I have been on a quest to make my office look more colorful and homier and I have been relying mostly on artwork and artificial plants to do the trick. One of the fake plants that now adorns my desktop is this fake bonsai tree from the Yoerm store.

First, let’s talk about the plusses. This fake tree does, indeed, look like a miniature version of an actual tree. It is presented in a rectangular base, which is good for a fake tree that slants in one direction. From a distance, the tree looks cool and the bright green color does look nice on an otherwise plain, boring, brown colored desktop.

Where this fake tree loses a few points with me is its overall appearance. Specifically, what I am referring to its level of fakeness. Once you get closer and examine, you quickly notice that the trunk of the tree looks like plastic. It doesn’t even look remotely real. The detail of the branches of the tree is nice, but again, it reminds me of an artificial Christmas tree.

It’s cool to have more color in my office décor but compared to the other fake plants I have, this bonsai tree is a little less appealing. The level of fake is the reason so if you’re the type who likes fake plants that at least provide the semblance of something genuine, you may want to pass on this one. Add up the pros and cons and you have an average decoration overall.

Good for Storing and Serving Oils and Syrups. Olive oil, vegetable oil, and other oils and syrups are common to all households. You can always pour what you need straight from the bottle you purchased at the store, but a good alternative is this PARACITY Glass Oil Dispenser.

This small pitcher holds about 20 ounces and can be used for most any type of oil. The opening on the top is large enough that you can easily pour the contents of a store bottle into the pitcher without spilling. The pitcher even has milliliter measurement markings, which can be useful in some instances.

As for its design, this is a practical container and I like that the opening on top is large enough that you don’t need a funnel. The spout is small, and I wonder if a thicker liquid could be poured from here without any problem. I’m likely going to use this pitcher for olive oil, since that is something we use frequently in my household. I have considered pancake syrup, but the thickness might be an issue.

The markings on the side of this container can be useful, but there are no ounce markings, only milliliters, so be ready to convert, if necessary. There is also a small plug that comes with this, to block the opening on the spout and keep things from getting in through the small opening. This is a good idea, but it’s only a matter of time until this small plug gets lost. When that happens, you will need to cover it with a small piece of plastic wrap or something similar. Also, the glass seems thin, so one needs to be careful or else this will break.

I like having small contraptions around the kitchen for storing and serving. This glass oil dispenser is good to have around, although certainly not a necessity, since store- bought containers are just as convenient. It seems fragile, but it’s still got enough going for it to recommend.

Underwhelming desk - concerns for longevity. Overall, this desk looks nice but leaves me concerned with its longevity due to flimsy feeling materials.

Pros: the desk looks nice, and is the advertised size. Height seems good, but I don’t yet have chairs to see how well it fits with a standard height chair. Relatively easy to assemble. Minimal screws and parts made it easier for me to assemble myself. The desk is also surprisingly light, and moves easily across the carpet for positioning. Metal Frame seems sturdy.

Cons: one of the tops came damaged, and shows just how thin the veneer on the top board is. The biggest con for me is how flimsy the whole top feels when any sort of weight is put on it. This seems to be largely due to the top support plank, which runs from one end to the other (also mdf). I believe it’s supposed to prop both of the desk top halves up to support the middle of the desk, but as you can see in the photo, this board was flexed and does not support both sides. Additionally, all screws were hand tightened, but you can see how the screw posts pulled into the soft mdf, immediately damaging. These will loosen up quickly over normal use of the desk and don’t leave me confident this desk will last very long with two people using it. Lastly, the description advertises cable management via the desk holes, but it also mentions built in usb ports, which are not on this desk. Misleading advertising.

Recommend with reservations.. I bought this French Press for my camping trip. I thought it would be an easier method for making coffee, which it was. My main complain with French Press coffee brewers is that the coffee gets cold while it sits and brews. I thought that the thermal design would eliminate this problem.  I was wrong. It still cooled off unacceptably while brewing. The problem is that, even though the double walled design should hold in the heat, the opening in the spout allows the heat to escape through the top. I improvised a solution of my own by plugging up the spout with a wadded up paper towel while the coffee brewed. This was somewhat successful and allowed me to have hotter coffee than if I hadn't stopped it up. Plugging up the hole again, while I drank my coffee, kept the left over coffee warm enough to have a second cup, though it was cooler than the first. Without doing that, the coffee would be completely cold by the time I finished my first cup. If Planetary Designs wants to improve this design, I would recommend a completely closed system that allows the coffee to brew without any heat loss. The thermal, insulated design is really useless without that.
