bird bed cover set. I really wanted to love this.. I love the 100% cotton.. the print is really pretty - but a dirty beige background. Wish it were lighter.  The material seems really lightweight. I am nervous about how thin the back of the sham is.  I worry about tears as you try to fit your fluffy (in my case memory foam) sham pillows into them.  And finally it came removed from its original bag and put into a non commercial vacuum seal bag for mail. There had to be a lot of hands touching it. Eh.  Further, I ordered a second and it was sent the same way.  Disappointing.  I would have preferred it stayed in it's original packing and messing with original seal.  The vacuum sealing did very, very little in sizing. So I wonder why we couldn't have the original bag.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

30oz stainless mug. I purchased 2 of these.  Supposed to come with 2 different lids and one of them only had one.  Disappointing.  Further, of the double walled stainless mugs I have purchased over the years, these do NOT keep iced drinks iced for as long as others. I would say about 6 hours tops.. the one I had just before this set, at LEAST 24 hours.  Eh.  I replace these about every 2 years or so... these I will probably replace sooner. Eh.  They are 30 oz size.  Do not wash in the dishwasher for longer life.  Came with a couple of stainless straws, I don't use those if they don't have silcone tips because it's kind hard on your teeth... And the missing lid was disappointing.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. I hope this was helpful to you in some way.

short in length. These hangers are a little less than 2 inches shorter than the average plastic hanger. So be aware if you're wanting to hang adult clothing. It will be ok for women's t-shirts, tanks, but not for men's clothing. I cover the hangers with yarn so that clothing is less likely to slip. I am just disappointed these are signficantly shorter than the standard plastic hanger.
I think they would be good for people with small closet space as the hooks are compact and the width of the plastic rod is small too. Hope this helps!
artificial babys breath. Meh.  They look really fake.  The "flower" is too big... it's white.. and small.. but I wouldn't call it baby's breath.  I put in a vase.. but not where I had planned.
Ordinary. These plastic swords are just that... plastic swords.  Nothing terribly special, but they work. I use them every so often and just need to replensh my supply.
pikake lei wood candle. Nice scent but a SUCH small candle - the price is crazy.  Disappointed in the price, but the scent is pleasant.

cedar shavings in cotton bags. When you first open the bag they are delightful... aromatic...  They note that when the fragrance lessens, just crush/press the bags.  Hmm. Ok.  But it's within about 3 days that you need to do that and it is never the strength of the first time.  They do faintly smell of freshly shaved cedar. Very nice. But it doesn't last long enough in my mind.  Put all 12 of them in my two door (sliding) closet... very small area... The bags themselves are small.. about 3" long.. thin cotton like material.  The doors of my closet are kept closed.  At first you could catch a whiff when you opened the doors... now, nothing.  I will continue to "crush" the bags for a few more weeks and then probably toss them.  You could try some essential oil drops or spray to possibly lengthen their strength.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Overall, I would not recommend these for anything more than very temporary, brief use or possibly in an enclosed plastic tub?

works.. but not the best quality. As other reviewers have said, not the worst, but not the best pan I've ever owned.  I just need to replace a 12" cooking surface pan I had used up.  The edge is very shallow, but for a quick, small sautee, it will work.  It is really lightweight, but will last for a little while.

mini wooden chests. Purchased these for a pirate treasure hunt .. they are tiny... about 4 or 5" long by about 3" wide... about 3" deep - eyeballing.  They are super cheap.  One of the boxes won't stay closed.  Total junk.  Worth about $2.  In my opinion.  The metal closures are very dingy - in the photos they look bright and clean.  As long as you're expecting a box worth about $2 - and you don't mind if they don't close, you'll be ok.  I would not recommend these.

satin pillow sham covers. These pillow shams are a bit too shiny for me.  I was focused on zippered shams, and these are - but they are also 'satin.'  Eh.  Too slippery and shiny.  A medium/dark gray.  I will probably share these will someone who likes shiny satin.  They did machine wash and dry nicely.

car rug. I have to admit, I was expecting this to be more a carpet top (the print side)... hook and loop? Something... but it is not.  It's like a felt?  But not as heavy - cheap looking and feeling.  It was crammed into a bag and very severely taped in about a 8"x*8" square- so I have laid it out and hoping it will flatten... eventually.  The back has little rubber dots.. supposedly to help it not slide around - and it kind of works.  And that's on carpet!  We do have a smooth, quality burber carpet - but sheesh.  Anyway... I hope this will last one summer and we will move one from it.  Overall, disappointed in the value and quality.

double wall water bottles. Ordered 2... one arrived with the metal sleeve lifted/broken off.  They keep water WITH ice cold for about 6 hours (NOT in the sun or warm car)  Didn't try anything hot.  Disappointed that one was broken.  Very light weight.

plastic dish rack. I purchased this set thinking it would be useful with the slide out bottom... but not so much in my opinion.  First, most of the "rack" is plastic.  The grill is silver - and may be stainless steel.  The plastic stiff and brittle feeling.  The slide out tray does not drain - so whatever you set on it will sit in the tray with water - unless you put a towel down - which you may what to do because even though the slide out tray is textured in a way - remember it's brittle plastic - most things slide right down on it.  I don't really wash plates so I removed the plastic plate holder.  Honestly, it's not my favorite dish rack I've ever owned, but once I removed the slide out tray and the plate holder - it mostly works for me.  But I think I need to continue looking.  If I had seen this rack in person before purchasing, I would not have purchased it.  Meh.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

wire tie bows. These are OK.  the gold wire wraps are really short- barely enough to hold the bow - so if you want to attach to tree limbs - its a real challenge - nearly impossible.  The material is really wonky outdoor stuff - fake velvet stuff - the usual - very flat looking.  Some of the bows were pretty crushed and they don't really straighten out.  I am going to keep looking for some more sparkle and definitely longer wire ties.

They are disposable. I bought these for disposable, quick use.  They are better than some, worse than others... they are very thin. I prefer a bit wider chop stick, but they work. They are very slightly tapered at one end and loose (not attached together).  Not splintery.  They are about middle of the road and a fair price I think.

x chef defrosting tray 2 in 1. I apparently misread the ad - it's 2 in 1 - NOT two trays.  Eh.  I am disappointed in that.  But I did purchase this as gift in our family Christmas bingo gift pile.  I will update my review should new info seem useful after someone chooses and uses it.

doesn't fit. I bought the Calphalon 12" grill pan.  And this was "suggested" as an additional purchase.  Sadly it does NOT fit well at all.  I keep it because it does sort of rest on the edge, but you should know that even they are the same brand, the lid doesn't work.  The lid is glass and appears to be a good quality.  It arrived quickly and in good condition (I have Prime)

stainless steel double walled glasses with plastic lids. UPDATE below.....You get four, stainless containers with clear plastic lids with slots for drinking (no slides to prevent spills). They also came with 4 straws and 2 straw cleaner brushes. Says they are dishwasher safe, I've put them in. They seem kind of lightweight - so I hope they actually are stainless and doubled walled. Also says it keeps cold drinks cold for 24 hours - I will update my review should new info seem useful.
UPDATE: 8/12/2020.... Just a note. If you FILL the cup with ice to the top, add water and use in room temp (70 degrees) - the ice is visible for about 6-7 hours. It's not exactly 24 hours. But it's ok. Just want to provide the actual use info and report that what is posted is not exactly accurate. I also noted that they are fairly light and not as thick as other double walled cups I have purchased. There is also some sweating that occurs at the very top, outside of the cup. faux orchid plant. I was pretty disappointed.  Most of the skinny leaves had bare wires that were detached from the leaves.  The "roots" are horrid and look very fake.  The funny "mossed" balls at the base of the plant are OK but not great.  Further the faux orchid flowers are very cheap and awkward looking - not graceful at all.  And, they put one tiny polished rock on one side of the plant balls and one on the other side, embedded in some clear epoxy meant to look like water? But, there is a dirty, sticky part that is brushed out in front of each rock.  So... I made an additional purchase of polished rocks to cover those spots and that helped.  However, it doesn't uplift the bouquet enough to recommend it.  Of course, this is my opinion.  But I purchased a different faux orchid bouquet a few days ago and I think I will get another one of those and donate this one..  initially I didn't love it but after this one - I appreciate it a lot more.

floor lamp. It comes disassembled. It took me about 20 minutes to twist all the segments together. The lamp I received is a matte black. The tubing is metal. The lamp is LED. If you use the remote, you can use the toggle on the main tube to dim either the large or the mini lamp - but it will NOT turn the lamp on or off. The remote uses a really small barrel shaped battery (came with it) but looks like it will be hard to find. Eh. But the remote turns on and off both lights, dims them and changes the light from a blue or "warm" color light. The mini light has a goose neck that you can manipulate. The large light has two options, straight up and flat (pointing directly at the ceiling) or at a tilt (which I prefer for dust). I like the light, but disappointed that the main tube of the lamp doesn't work - not that I am terribly surprised it doesn't. It says to light tape the toggle - big nothing. You can tap, gently hold or bang it - NOTHING happens. Thus the 3 stars. TIP NOTE: because the tube is metal, and you have to twist the segments together, be SUPER careful to get them twisting correctly so you don't strip them or get them stuck at the wrong angle.
PROS: LED, doesn't flicker.
You can change the light from a white/blue to a warmer yellower light.
Dimmer option.
The mini light is nice if you read in bed or at the sofa.
CONS: You cannot turn the lamp on or off without the remote - even though you are supposed to be able to. Bad battery size - will be a pain to find replacement.
If I loose the remote, I will not be able to use the lamp. Eh.

Velcro window blind. Ok... 4 stars for easy, no hassle install....  ZERO stars for the length.  So that puts it in at 2 1/2 or 3 stars tops.  My window is 63" long. Second issue is the requirement to hand wash it. I didn't catch that in the product description when I made the purchase decision. I resolved that issue by ordering AmazonCommercial brand openers that were literally half the price (and I ordered tree; two for the house and one for trips.)

Overall I am disappointed. If it winds up breaking like many other reviews claim it will I will simply return it because at least the return window is long (purchased in October 2021, can return as late as February 2022.,)

Quality problems. Unfortunately two of the peg/wood screw pairs would not faster tightly. Fortunately I can get by without them, but had I purchased this expecting to populate all of the pegs I would have been disappointed.

On the plus side the wood is otherwise sturdy and it is very easy to assemble. No instructions were provided (nor were they needed), and the only tool required was included in the package.

Quality issues. I ordered two of these - one for my living room TV and the others as a hangout place for my cats in front of a bay window. Each had quality issues, and they were different for each of the two.

One had bubbles in the top surface of the "wood" shelf because some of the factory installed fasteners were either too long or torqued too much. Also, the metal legs had rust streaks. At first I thought this was part of the rustic look, but the second one had an even finish. Finally, on the first one one of the bolts would not line up.

The second one had a broken and bent piece of the metal mesh shelf, which I had to cut, then file down. It had two factory fasteners that actually broke the surface of the wood (or laminate) layer of one of the shelves. Finally, the two parts (there are actually four laminate and two metal mesh shelves that are connected to form three long shelves) did not totally line up. From a distance they look fine, but up close it imparts a cheap, shoddy look. Finally, two bolts were stripped, and it was real work lining many of them up.

The sad part is this could have been an outstanding product - other than the quality issues the assembly could have been a breeze (misaligned bolts and shelves aside), and it is sturdy. I'll give it that. And if the quality was there the value would be darn good too.

Personally I am not purchasing another product from this company. Caveat emptor.

Flawed app and terrible web support. The app is terrible and will not get past the Activate Roomba screen. The support section of the web site is terrible. But the thing without the app will still work as long as I manually track it down and put it back on the charging station. As for cleaning - it definitely does the job, so I will keep it. If you want vacuum that will do everything it's advertised to do, including being controlled from an app or Alexa this is not it. Look elsewhere.

Disappointing. My and my wife's large hat collection keeps outgrowing available racks. This brings the total to five racks in this style (counting this one) from four different brands. Of them this is the only one that disappoints.

First, there were longitudinal cracks in three of the sections, although they are in no danger of separating.

Second, the legs are not as long or at the same angle as the other four racks I own.

I thought they were all made in the same factory and sold to different brands to put their own labels and sell them. Either I was wrong or my rack is a factory second. The finish is somewhat crude and uneven as well. Finally, there is a distinct varnish odor. Not overpowering, but none of the other racks that I own had that issue. In fact the other four, are perfect in design, fit and finish and are a lot more stable than this one. Stability is not paramount for my use since I am hanging hats and in a child-free environment.

I cannot recommend this rack and suggest that you consider one of the many almost identical brands offered here.

Poor quality and terrible instructions. I took a chance with this brand because I have ordered other furniture from them and each had cosmetic flaws. This one is no exception, so at least the brand is consistent in that respect.  However in the case of the other items the assembly instructions were not an issue. This one, though, has the worst assembly instructions, and you will need instructions unless you are super experienced with putting furniture together.  My main complaints is the illustrations are not detailed enough to orient you to which side of a piece is being depicted. And there are whole steps missing.  Frankly I will never purchase another item from this brand. The overall quality is not up to par in my opinion, and parts do not easily line up.

Works well, but no improvement over other designs. I love how compact this set is. However, you need to shake out the water after each use and let it dry, otherwise water will literally "jump" off it when you are replacing it into the receptacle. Of course, I have had to do that with other brands and designs as well, but this one is particularly touchy.

The brush itself does an excellent job of removing crud. The water where I live is heavy in minerals and leaves a hard deposit on the bowl. Most brushes take a lot of work to remove the deposit, whereas this brush does a more effective job.

I have not owned it long enough to assess how truly sturdy it is, but so far, so good in that respect.
Fast shipping. Smaller than expected
OK - but...... It works OK with nice suction but the end is really too small and it fills up really quick and is not as efficient when there is a lot of " stuff" in it.

Good for cramped bathrooms. I bought this when we moved into an apartment with the world's smallest bathroom. This definitely helped save space and allowed for my husband and I to have all of our products easily dispensable. However I do want to mention that it isn't the nicest looking product, and it feels a tad on the cheap side, but it works great is you are looking to save space.

Tastes like chalk. I love making chocolate molds for the holidays so I bought a bunch of different colors this year, and of course I bought the standard brown (dark chocolate), and I was so disappointed. While yes, this does melt really well, it does not taste good. Even the unnatural colors of red and green chocolate taste pretty good, but this just tasted chalky. I basically ended up deciding not to give any of the chocolate molds made from this, I just threw them out.

Too small for average food storage. This is one of those times when I really should have read the description a little bit better. I bought these so that I could leftovers in different sections instead of using more than one container. These containers are super small. Like super small. And while they do have a divider in them, it is only because two smaller plastic inserts fit into the bigger item to create the separation. I figured I would use these to store small items in, like nails, but even nails 1.75 inches are pretty much too big for the container. I'm not sure exactly how I am going to end up using these, but hopefully I find a use for them.
Just be aware that these are small, very small, and wouldn't really work for most food storage.

Needs better quality control. I love the brand Homesick, my all time favorite candle is by them, so I was super excited about this candle because it’s for Texas, and I’m from Texas and miss home all the time.
The box it comes in is super cute, and would be great for gifts. The label is also super cute.
Scent wise, it is a strong smelling candle, and it does smell nice. The back lists like five scents in it, but honestly it’s mostly pine and leather. I think it would be great for a midsized room.
Unfortunately, the candle kind of didn’t work out for me. These candles are all hand poured, and I think in this instance, it really could have used some quality control. My candle (you can see in the pictures) after I kid you not less than 2 minutes of burn time, the wick was already a good inch into the candle and there was a huge depression. After about five minutes the wax was hitting the flame and extinguishing the flame. You can see on the picture there are decent sized air pockets from the pour, which has left the candle not really able to burn correctly. The wick itself has an empty space all around it where the wax didn’t really harden around it.
I had high hopes for this candle, and I’m sure this is just one that fell through the cracks, but it didn’t work out for me.

Slow, but gets the job done. We got an electric can opener because of a dominant hand injury, so this was really helpful to allow me to keep cooking. And while it was very helpful not to have to open cans on my own, it’s not exactly the fastest can opener.
I normally have to push the button to run it at least twice. It makes about four rotations around the can before it actually opens it. I wish it was quicker. But since I can open cans on my own, this is definitely helpful and great for my kitchen.

Soft, good size, but thin. These are a nice towel set, I liked that it was a set, you get multiple sizes which is nice. The main problem I had with these towels was that while these were decently soft they were fairly thin, like the thinness you would get from a cheaper set. I generally prefer my towels to be a lot thicker than this. I think because of the thinness it isn’t the most absorbent towels either.

Decent sheets. These are pretty decent sheets, I like the pattern and they are really soft and comfortable. I normally have problems finding sheets for this bed because the mattress is pretty deep, but this does fit on the mattress just fine. Honestly, my biggest complaint about these sheets is that the fitted sheet didn’t hold its elasticity that great, so if you are someone who moves around a lot while you sleep you might have issues with the fitted sheet popping off.

Really wanted this to work. I cook a lot but I have a very small kitchen and my pots and pans don't exactly fit comfortably in any of my cabinets, so I decided to get this organizer to help make everything look less cluttered and be more functional. I didn't love the box it came in, and some of the pieces were kind of difficult to get out, they were really stuck on each other. The directions were pretty good and easy to follow, assembly wasn't terrible either. Ultimately, I didn't end up keeping this, it oddly enough was a little too tall for the cabinet was planning on, I found an alternate spot, but honestly it just didn't hold the amount of items that I wanted it too. I ended up finding a different solution and returned this one.

The lid was a disappointment. I got this because I drink a lot of diet coke, it's the only soda we keep in the house, and I thought this would make it easier to store in the fridge, especially because of the lid, that way I could put stuff on the lid. Unfortunately the lid doesn't really fit all that well, it pops off super easy, and at this point I feel like I have to tape it onto the plastic just to get it to stay or just throw the lid away. I wish I had purchased a different one because the lid issue is driving me crazy.

Just eh for me. My house has more lazy Susans in it than I like to admit, in fact I kind of hate them. We have two in on cabinet that we were making for snacks, so I thought these would be a really great way to keep different kinds of snacks separated and organized. I don't like they don't actually nest up against each other fully, they kind of sit at a weird angle so you lose space when you use these. You can really only put smaller items in these. They should have fit in my cabinet no problem, but they were like a half inch to long so they didn't nest into the lip and instead rested on it, so it really just didn't work for my space at all. It is well built, the thickness of the plastic makes me think they would hold up pretty well even with high usage.

Easy to Set Up. I needed something small we could put on our entryway table for time check as we are getting ready to leave the house. This is very small, but still bright enough to be seeable. It was easy to set up and I am content with it. The gray wood grain applied to the exterior is not the best, I have some concerns about how long it's going to hold up, but for now I am happy with it.

They work but aren't pretty up close. I bought these for my day of the dead alter in my house because I couldn't find any live flowers to use. There are a lot in the packaging, which is nice. You do need to take them out of the bag and let them kind of fluff up for a while afterwards, and then there are a couple you need to do by hand. They look pretty decent from a distance, but if you get up close they do look pretty cheap. I think I would recommend these only depending on your needs, like if people are going to be really up close then I would probably take a pass, but if not then these will probably work for you.

Not My Favorite Cervical Pillow. I love cervical pillows, they are incredibly helpful because I have a spinal injury at T1-3. My old pillow was getting worn down so I went ahead and bought this one as a replacement and honestly it's just not my favorite. It works in a pinch, but it's just not nearly as comfortable as some of the other ones I have used in the past. I honestly think its the material of the pillow that is impacting my ability to sleep on it. I can fall asleep on the pillow, but my ability to stay asleep on it is not great. It feels almost a little too stiff, and not enough like a cradle. I probably wouldn't purchase this pillow again.

Super cute, but not my favorite. I don't know about everyone else, but in my house, I am constantly losing my pot holders, so I am always in the market for new ones. I thought these were really cute, and they totally are, but I don't really love them. The material is really stiff, and not the most comfortable when using. Also the shapes, which cute, are not the most functional. The pumpkin is fine, and I use it all the time, but the ghost is another story. The ghost thins at the top, and splits because of the arms, but if you have a larger hand (or really even a normal sized hand) its not easy/comfortable to put your hand all the way in to use to grab things out of the oven. So cute, looks good in the kitchen if you decorate for fall/Halloween, but not all that practical in the long term.

Not Adequately Seasoned - Seasoning layer gone after one batch of cornbread. This pan is a good piece of iron that is well balanced. However, the pre-seasoning is a joke. It is no where near adequate. I've attached a photo to show that what seems to have been a single layer of seasoning is gone after just one use. I baked one batch of cornbread in the pan with plenty of oil & butter. The cornbread stuck to the pan. I washed the pan with hot water (no soap) and used an OXO cast iron pan brush to remove the stuck on crumbs. I did not soak the pan. The seasoning is now gone. The pan will require a great deal of seasoning work before I can use it again. Don't expect to use it without going through the seasoning process. I have other well-seasoned pieces of cast iron cookware, so I'm not new to caring for this type of item.
Broken. A piece of the plastic was broken off of mine but i still decided to keep it since it’s a pain to return.

I usually love Sharks, but…. I have been buying Shark products for many years, and I have never had a bad thing to say about them…until today. I’m not even sure if this is a complaint. Not resistant to cut marks. I had these blue melamine plates that I used as prep boards for years.  You could cut on them but it wouldn't cut into them.  These are okay and like plates which I like (no drip off).  But, I have to put a washcloth under to keep them from sliding all over and they got deep gouge marks just from the first use - slicing potatoes for potato salad.  Not impressed with the gouge marks - they will be a pain to scrub out.
Rather noisy, but works. These are nice, they do seem to clear the air but they are so noisy that I can not use them at night when I sleep - which is what I had hoped to do.

Not sure what makes it cool.... I know the gel is supposed to make it cool.  This blanket is soft and holds my sheet down over me so that I don't need a heavier blanket, so I guess in that way it is cooler.  It could be a little larger.

Took me more than 6 hours to put together. The holes for the screws are not aligned correctly, took me the whole freaking night to make holes by hand (I don't have a drill)! The drawer was driving me crazy the holes were so off, I couldn't even close the drawer. Took me forever to measure the exact point where the holes should be. My hands are so painful now after holding the screwdriver for so long and push screws into the wood by force.

The manual says there is a pack of "K" screws, but I couldn't find it. I could still skip that and put it together without the K pack. For those who are looking for the missing pack, you don't need it.

Otherwise it's pretty. Low price too.

Not that easy to use. Once you get it started it worked fine. Getting it to pierce the can is not a "no-brainer".  I am a handy person, in fact a professional handyman for over 40 years, and it takes me 2 - 3 tries to get it to work. My wife is noT handy and she has given up trying to use it.

Nice and lightweight but the 2 small pockets are pretty .... Where else can you get 2 aprons for $10? Nice and lightweight but the 2 small pockets are pretty much useless.  I had to make and sew new pockets to fit my needs .

Too much glue!!. This buisiness needs to tell the manufacturers they are wrecking the roses. Most of the roses are like this and I have to use tweezers to pick out the glue and the roses on their side, I'll try to rub it off, if I can't I'll paint them. Like the blue ones in the the picture with the red bow. I had to paint the outside to save them!

These are just okay. These are mediocre. Hard to clean and egg seems to stick regardless of the amount of oil/spray involved. Still holds and cooks the egg well tho. I have switched back to my single egg frying pan
A bit disappointing.... Guess I was expecting something so wonderful-smelling that I would be blown away.  It’s nice, but not anything special.

Great pan - but the main handle broke during roasting.. Wow - this is one beautiful, BIG frying pan! It arrived just in time to make the spaghetti sauce for the huge family group visiting over 4th of the July weekend. The best part of this pan is the "Helper" handle - what a difference in picking up this pan when it's full. It also is an absolute breeze to clean. We add sausage to our spaghetti sauce, and in our smaller pan, it was always a pain to get the pan clean afterward. No problems with this pan! I had never heard of GreenLife - but the quality is impressive. The lid fits perfectly. Whoever came up with adding that extra handle, deserves an award. What a convenience!

Amended 10/28/16: We have loved this pan and have used it almost daily. Tonight we decided to roast from lamb chops in it (with a basil sauce) and when we took it out of the oven, the main handle broke off - broke in the middle. The information said the pan was oven safe, and we are certain we were within the temperature limits. Very disappointed, as we used this pan all the time. So, if you decide to roast in it, be careful when you grip those handles - particularly the main one.

Only four cubes - but they’re good ones!. There is no doubt that you get big, clear ice cubes - but this only delivers four.  So, if you’re only a party of four, the big cubes are great.  They keep a drink cold for a long time, melting slowly - and that means a drink that is not getting diluted quickly.  I just wish it wasn’t so big in the freezer - and, at the same time, smaller and holding more cubes!

Interesting design.... This is a mirror that gets everybody’s attention - what’s unexpected is how far it sticks out from the wall - and the side view is not that great. So, best that it be located in an area where it will be viewed just from the front.  It fits into both eclectic and modern decors, and appears well-made.  It could take its place with other wall-hung items to complete an interesting arrangement.

Rather plain - but nice fragrance.... Nice fragrance - don’t know why it is titled “Books”.  It’s also labeled a “homesick candle” which does make sense, as the fragrance is fairly common and probably could remind someone of the home they left behind.  It’s a good size candle and burns prettily.  It’s not unusual in packaging or in the candle itself - it’s rather plain.  Probably a good gift for a student away at school.

Not as easy as it looks.... The video made this process look so simple.  This is the first cappuccino machine I have worked with, and I’m not finding this quite that simple.  Several less than acceptable results.  I hoped this would use pods, but it uses ground coffee.  I think some practice would help before I invite a crowd!  The instruction manual is not that easy for a beginner to follow, so that may be my problem.  I can’t produce anything that looks like a Starbucks cappuccino.  It may be my inexperience - so I split the stars - 2.5 for being difficult for a newbie...

For our outdoor bar. No more carting tools back and forth - this will take care of needs at the bar on the deck.  Everything we need for mixed drinks - one surprise is the “zester”, which is great for adding  a peel, or even some zest for fruity drinks.  Wish the quality of the tools were better - looks kinda cheap - we like that zester and the muddler, though.

Doesn’t work for me.... Once every five years I have to try a down pillow just to see if it will work for my sore neck - and it never works.  This is a high quality pillow - probably filled with top quality down feathers, but, for me, it goes flat after a couple hours, and I spend the rest of the night trying to plump it up enough to support my neck.  This is probably great for many people - it just doesn’t work for me!

Disappointed... We loved the idea of this tea bag organizer, because we drink a wide range of tea.  When it came to loading it with tea bags,  the frustration set in.  when you drop bags into the slots, they don’t fall down flat, they catch on the sides and end up a mess.  We gave up after several tries with different kinds of tea bags and they turned out the same - it just looked like a mess with no way to straighten them out.  Sorry, this didn’t work for us.

Smaller than we expected.. Not what we expected - much smaller - just hoped for a water kettle with ready hot water, without resorting to an electric one.  This one probably has a special purpose, but it wasn’t what we needed.  Looks like good quality, well-made, and the thermometer is a added plus.  Wish it would work for us.

It takes two.. There is no way to put this tray down to load it!  Someone has to hold it, and someone has to load!  If all the glasses aren’t removed, you can’t put it down again without help.  It makes a nice picture to have it loaded with eight drinks and pass them, but if you’re stuck with one, how do you put it down to take that one out?  Maybe I’m missing something.

This is huge!  Three feet across!. It comes ready for you to shape it yourself - which will take some time considering the size.  It’s heavy and will be a bit difficult to hang.  It arrived too late to use for Christmas.  If a light goes out, it can’t be replaced - but all the other lights will still work.  Considering how many lights there are, this probably won’t be a problem.  Hanging it high enough to get the full effect is giving us a problem.  Trees are out as we are in our very windy season.  Looks like a project for next Christmas or a very special occasion!

Smaller than expected. Everything needed for a children’s party - but probably not appropriate sizes for an adult party.  Cups are small, as are plates.  Nicely decorated - and a good stash for an unexpected need to celebrate!

Not soft, but very attractive.... This is a very atttractive throw - but not terribly soft.  It’s completely woven, and looks much more expensive than the asking price.  I immediately thought of all the uses - it could be a tablecloth - a throw on a couch or bed - carry it in the car for seat coverage, etc.  It’s not a throw you are inspired to cuddle up with because of the lack of softness.  But, it is very good quality.

Check  the size - they’re small!. Good lesson on reading the fine print - these are 6 really lovely very small spoons - not for cooking  or kitchen use - these spoons are alternatives for metal spoons.  They might come in handy in a picnic situation where you don’t want to bring breakable things - or for a special effect with a different sort of dessert.  We’ll hang on to them - bu we really needed kitchen wooden spoons!

This is something new!. Might take a while to get used to this new way of preserving food.  The “kit” includes reusable sandwich and produce bags, which can be washed, and 3 beeswax food wraps - made of natural beeswax.  They are sticky - and the info included warns us of that - and they are for wrapping around cheese, nuts, fruits, etc.  They can be washed in cool water and reused - and stored in the fridge.  Our jury is still out on the beeswax wraps - as they degrade with time, and we’re struggling to see the gain from their use.  Interesting idea - time will tell.

Very trendy!. This is the blanket you see on the end of beds in the decorator magazines - very large knit blanket - cream color - looking very fluffy and comfortable.  It is all that, but the yarn tends  to cast off puffs of yarn, which can be a problem.  It’s very heavy in weight, too, which may be great with the new fervor for heavy blankets.  Will look great on the end of a bed so a gift to the younger set may be appropriate and appreciated!  Had to cut back on the stars because of the loose “puff” problem.

Woven pattern.... We expected this to be soft, and it isn’t - so it would seem to be more suitable for a tablecloth - it’s a nice pattern.  It looks almost hand woven - it’s 100% cotton and wash and dryable.  It may soften up with washings.  It may also shrink a bit - best to dry on low setting.  Made in India and suggested washing before use.

Soft but not what I expected. Undoubtedly soft but a little disappointing because it seems like it does not have enough fill inside.  I have bought other brands for my cat and they seem more sturdy while being just as soft.  I purchased this for my dog and he doesn’t want to have anything to do with it and I am wondering if it is because of the fill.

Ok but not really what I expected. I really wanted to like this thermometer. It had what looked like a lot of good features and I had wanted to try a Bluetooth thermometer for a while. Initially, it looked good. It comes with the thermometer, a charging base, and a charging cord. It doesn't come with a charger, but we have those all over the place.

The first odd thing I noticed is that according to the instructions it must charge for 20 minutes every time you use it. Initially, I thought this was a showstopper because I've been using an electronic thermometer for several years and it is always ready to work. When I used it for the first time, I realized that in most cases there is at least 20 minutes of prep time, and you don't need to put the thing in the meat right away. So, that's annoying but not a showstopper. What is really goofy is that you can't even set it up until you charge it for 20 minutes. The charging base shows red when it is charging and green when it is done, but it also goes back and forth. When I was charging it for the first real use, I looked over and it was green. Then I went to get it a few minutes later and it was red.
The biggest issue is the app that comes with it. It's very primitive and doesn't look like it has a lot of options. You can choose one of the "BBQ" menu items and in most cases, it will then give you the option of various degrees of doneness. It works ok but is really limited in terms of connection. It says you can connect up to 165 feet, and that is only if you have the lid open on the grill or oven. I don't know a lot of people who use a grill with the top open, and I know of no one who uses an oven with the door open. It does say in the description that if you close the lid of the grill you will get about 20 feet before it disconnects. I'd say that is pretty accurate but means that you have to stay pretty close to the grill, and that's not why anyone would get a wireless remote thermometer. I suspect the battery is very weak which is why you have to charge it all the time and the weak signal is the reason it doesn't work over 20 feet. This may be fine if you are in a small kitchen and using it with the oven, but normally I move around a bit.
The worst thing about it is that it won't turn off. I used it and two days later it's still running even though I thought I ended it. Evidently, you have to go in and actually force it to stop. This is definitely a security issue and a battery usage issue and just a horrible customer service issue.
Overall, I can't give this device more than 3 stars. The app can be updated, and hopefully this will happen, but the weak signal is not something that will be fixed and the need to charge it every time you use it is another limitation. I expect a wireless thermometer to be pretty simple to operate and have an app that is easy to use. This has neither of those basic features and having no way to close the app is a definite security issue.

Buy the EVOS German alternative instead.. I just bought (and have been using) both the competing EVOS German-made reusable cloths and also these Trendy Tripper brand Swedish reusable cloths, so I can offer what I hope is a useful comparison.

First of all, congrats to the Europeans: compared to either product reviewed here, our US-made Handiwipes are a joke.

Based on my heavy use over the past couple of days, I have concluded that the EVOS German cloths are FAR superior overall to these Trendy Tripper Swedish cloths:

The EVOS cloths cost only about $8 for 5 cloths.

The Trendy Tripper cloths cost about $17 for 6 cloths.

EVOS are about 14" x 14" in size (and are easily folded if you want something smaller in your hand).

Trendy Tripper are only about 5" x 6".

EVOS absorb far more than TrendyTripper.

EVOS dry out faster than Trendy Tripper.

There is no reason to spend $18 for six of the Trendy Tripper Swedish cloths when you can spend only $8 for five of a much better product.

I hope this helps.

Smooth action but minimal installation instructions, and very difficult to install. Ball bearing slides seem well built, but the basket wire only runs left to right, i.e., there are no wires running front to back, which would add needed strength to the shelf.  The mounting holes of the feet are under the wire shelf, not to the side.  The meager assembly instructions tell you to assemble the shelf on the feet before installation, then set it in place to mark the holes to determine where the holes for mounting need to be drilled in your cabinet.  But then you can't get the front feet screws installed because they are very small and have to be held in position through the wire of the shelf before screwing in, which is nearly impossible. You need to disassemble the basket off the slides to finish screwing the front feet in, then line up the basket to the slide clips and reattach the basket to the slides, which is not as easy to do as when the slides are unmounted.  The very small phillips head screws are cheaply made, strip easily, and one wasn't even fully cut so couldn't be used.  Spend the extra money and get sliding shelves better designed for ease of installation.

Not quite what I expected.. This is the 3rd artificial tree I've owned so I feel like I have a good idea on how they compare. There are several things I like and several I don't. The first is the large box it's shipped in. It really is a pain to have to force the tree back into a teensy box to store it. I don't mind if it takes up a little more room. Next, the metal base with this tree is far superior to that of trees in my Christmas past and it's super easy to open and close to store. The little little tightening bolts are nice too. The assembly is a breeze. Each of the 3 sections are clearly marked. You'll want do cut those tags off before using. But the graduated size of the sections are easily to see. You will not need the tags to guide you. The amount of branches on the tree are just ok. From the picture it looks really full and that the pine needles start almost from the trunk of tree. NOPE. Each branch has a good 6" before pine needle action. That was a bummer. However, each branch fluffed out really pretty and easy. Better than any tree I've owned. The bottom 2 sections have hinged branches. The top has thick, flexible wire. The top section also is very dense AND sturdy enough to hold a star. I was looking forward to a 7.5 foot tree. That would be 89 inches. This tree is 80 inches. Maybe you could fluff 1 extra inch at the top. Even then, max height is 81 inches, which is 6'9". It's a massive misrepresentation of the product. This is the biggest reason I gave it 3 stars.  The flocking is very subtle. I could take or leave it. But hardly notice it. The pine cones are 100% real and tied on with craft wire. My kids love them. I may remove them after using this year. All in all it's fine. Not what I was hoping for in both height and fluffiness.

•Then, there is no more retractable cord. You must manually wrap the cord round the machine. Only, look at attached pic in my review. There is not enough room for the cord. I had to shove the cord in "just so" to make it fit. It does hang off to the left. In my opinion, this is preferred, because I hold the cord with left hand while I vacuum.
•Next, the unit is HEAVY and clunky. I am a fit middle aged woman and had a hard time getting vacuum to lift over the edge of my area rugs. I had to manhandle the unit over. It did not glide smoothly. Because of it's weight, this may be a problem for you to handle comfortable.
•My biggest irritation of this thing is that the base swivels. You know how it feels when the handle of a mop or vacuum hasn't been secured correctly to the base? You over compensate your movement up top for the wiggling at the base. This has that exact same sensation. And it's inessential to the workings of ANY vacuum.
Totally not needed imo.
•also not needed, the "reduced suction" option found on the hose (see picture). Initially it was set to that and I didn't know. I went over my rug 10 or 15 times and nothing came up. I looked thru instructions and found nothing pointing it out. It took my scouring over vacuum for a good while trying to assess what was wrong. I finally found the option and turned it to "full suck"
The suction is o.k. Not the strongest. Nor the weakest of vacuums I've used. The vacuum self-propelled but, because of it's weight, your arm still fatigues.
•there are no side bristles sticking off the vacuum base to help with floorboard and edge dust.
•the detachable hose has a massive handle on it that is clumsy and sticks out when you try and store it.
Over-all, I feel like they tried to add too much to this. Collectively all these extra things just don't work. Do the 1 thing great.
Make a vacuum that "sucks" , whose filter can be quickly accessed and washed. Make the cord stow away correctly, make the extension hose easy to get off and on and the extension tools easy to store. Too much to ask? On this unit, yes!

Ugly color pink.. I am a little bummed out about the color of this. It's almost brown in color. It's so pale and dismal. I put a shell-pink pillow next to it so you can see the difference. It's a nice big size, the stitching is perfect and the welds look ok. Just wish the pink was pretty.

Just ok.. I needed a sheer for my bathroom. These are the perfect size bit I think they look pretty cheap. The fabric is flimsy and phony looking. But the pattern is even and they have not snagged or anything.

Just ok.. These are just ok. I put 1 cup of flour in the 1 cup measuring cup and it bowed. The small measuring spoons have sharp edges. They store away nicely and the measurements are accurate. But, I would never order this again.

A little disappointed.. Cute rug. However not 100% cotton . Also, instructions say hand wash or dry clean so, can't wash in in washer then tumble dry. Also, black weave pattern is only on 1 side.
Made in China.

A little disappointed. I have this mattress in the adult version, which is so much better. This childs one is not as firm, thinner, moves more and doesn't have the wool added to it. For the money, I don't feel like it's worth it. My 7 year old daughter is using it, so it supports her just fine. The mattress it touted to last 10 years though. I doubt that it will make it til shes 17. For the money, this mattress should be much sturdier. Super quality components though!

100% acrylic,  ok quality. I've wanted a chunky blanket for awhile now. I know they are trendy but I still love the look. This is all acrylic unfortunately, so it won't look new and fresh for long. It sheds a bit too.

A bit to lightweight for me.. Lightweight and wobbly. The top screw to secure the unit isn’t very long so it always feels like it will pop off. The entire thing does rotate easily. The brushed metal finish is nice too. I wouldn’t trust very heavy utensils in this or too many.

Just ok. I wanted to love this. It's  a little under engineered though. The base is slightly wobbly. The removable upper tray components 'seem' like a good idea, but they only add to the unsturdiness of the unit. The space between the bottom tray and top tray didn't fit my olive oil bottle, so measure before you buy!

Just ok.. This is just ok. Would look better as a set. My problem is with size of base. It's massive and looks clunky, not elegant, as a result. Medium weight, they are no Baldwin's. Holds a normal, taper candle.

Too flimsy for me.. Not very thick or heavy. Lighter than the classic cupcake or muffin liner. The shape is super pretty and I love the natural color. Won't reorder this product. 200/ pack. Made in China.

Nothing special. I’m a little disappointed in this glass set. This looks like a boring, small glass. There is a chunky seam on the stem and they look very basic. Too small, really, to use for reds. You could use for rosés or Sauvignon Blancs. I would never re-order these.

It’s ok. Thick and well sewn. There is a slight shininess to fabric and it feels like polyester. The pocket for the rod will ONLY FIT SKINNY CLASSIC SIZE so if you are using a thicker rod, you’ll be outta luck. The ties are meh. They tend to look a bit sloppy unless done with lots of time and care. I doubt I’d order this again and will be replacing it when I find something I like better.

Inner seal comes off constantly. Wanted to love this. The plastic is not quite as heavy and thick as I'd hoped. But the biggest bummer is that the gray inner seal on the lid comes off every single time you open it. I've never had a product that claimed to be airtight have this problem.
Average. Not quite as durable as I’d hoped for. The plastic is a bit thin and crushes easily. Hard to open and close without marring contents. Still good for price point. They stack nicely too.

Wish this was a little more powerful. Not very powerful and the wand is so slender that all the stuff you vacuum up gets stuck in it really easily. You'll find yourself clearing the nozzle every few minutes. The floppy extension is useless. Too floppy to position into space you need it to vacuum. Love the size and easy to turn off and on. Also, charging is fast.
Already rusted. :(. I've used this for about 8 weeks and it's already rusted at the top. Seals great a d keeps water very cold. Comfortable to hold, doesn't slip. Hard to wash.

Faulty bottles. 3 of the bottles have massive, nubby seams on the bottom of them. They don't stand upright, they just wobble around. You can't shave or clip the seam, it's melted plastic. So a quarter if the product was faulty. The remaining bottles are great. They mist evenly and the lid clicks on tight.

Not as good as I’d hoped.. So much smaller than I had hoped. I am praying the larger ones can continue to hold a medium size hanging basket. Each size is a different sheen? Why?? One is SUPER shiny, the other matte. I doubt I’ll ever be able to use the teeny ones.

Just ok.. Huge tapestry! Very light and silky fabric. The design is just printed on it, it’s not embroidered or anything. But it does look like product that was advertised. The stitching around the border is a cheap, simple stitch that looks clumsy. This is fine for a teenager but lacks elegance and quality.

Just okay.. These are just okay in my opinion. They are a bit difficult to clean and everything will stick so you must use parchment! However, They are very sturdy and absolutely do not warp in a hot oven. All my baked goods have come out evenly brown and I didn’t see any hot spots. Another thing that bugs me about these is that they do not nest in each other. I tried to stack on top of each other and they just slip down. Because of this, they take up much more room in your cabinet. I wouldn’t order these again.

These will never be my go-to glasses.. I'm not  WOW'ed by these glasses by Reidel at all. I own many Reidel products and these don't have the finesse I am used to. You can feel a huge ridge where the stem connects to the bulb. It's very clunky and distracting. The stem is thicker than I am used to. Also, the base is super thick and ugly. I included a picture of the new glass on the left and one of my older reidel glasses on the right. The older one has a fluid, 1 piece, thin base and stem. Over all, these feel like an inexpensive libby-like restaurant wine glass. I'm a bit disappointed.

Just ok.. This basket is just ok. It’s a bit too lightweight to be considered sturdy. And kind of small. All 4 castors lock and the wheels move smoothly but they too are light and feel like they might bend off after putting a bag of flour and a bag of rice in this. The entire unit seems to tilt forward too so I’ve had to finagle the wheels even further. I doubt I’d order this again. It was easy to put together though and would fit under sink cabinet as it’s only 19inches tall.

Nothing special. These look like a cafeteria bowl. They have a thick lip around the entire rim and are heavy and clunky. They are sort of a dirty white color I think they are really ugly and would never use them for a special occasion

Chunky, kinda ugly. These are heavy, chunky and thick. Looks like something you’d pick up at the thrift store for a dime. They are more a cafeteria style plate and lack elegance. I’d never use them for a special or more formal dinner because they are so ugly.

Not all they are “cut” out to be ☹️. These are nice knives. Nothing wrong with them. But the quality vs the price is why I gave 3 stars. They are made in China, not even German or Japanese steel, which demands a higher steel price. Also, they don’t have wood handles. It’s a hard PLASTIC!! They are sharp and I’m sure the chef who sponsered them backs them up. HOWEVER, when you spend this much for a knife set, you should expect PERFECTION.
Just ok. Just ok. It’s heavy, but right out of the box, not very sharp. The blade wiggles a little. The sheath is plastic. You can hook it on your belt if you want (ahem, nerd)

It’s just okay. I have another laundry hamper similar to this that looks the same but is heavier and sturdier. This one is okay but surprisingly flimsy feeling. The fabric is thinner and the bamboo bracing is too. The interior divider is a thin piece of fabric and plastic you manually place inside and tie in all 4 corners. It’s cheap and flimsy too. The lid is held onto basket with fabric, not hinges. It doesn’t have a magnet closure so it just rests on top. I think it looks better than a laundry basket, but on closer inspection isn’t very well made.

Some prints are gorgeous, others are meh. Over all this is an okay set of prints. The frames are all plastic and so is the “glass”. It comes with a protective sheet of plastic film you need to peel off before using. The quality of the print is crisp and clear and the gold leaf touch adds light and movement.  All the colors are vivid and the shapes are unusual. I think some of these prints are totally worthy of display and some just seem like filler pieces. I sort of get an 80’s hotel vibe from some of them. I only used 3.

A little disappointed. Some things I love about this unit:
•Comes fully assembled
•Lightweight
•Extremely maneuverable
• Bright guide light
•Side brushes
Some things I don't like:
•Doesn't suck up much pet hair
•Can't reach beater bar without dissembling bottom
•NO ATTACHMENTS, so all the corners and nooks are unreachable
•No retractable cord
•THE COST; for this amount of $, this vacuum should be FLAWLESS and really "suck"!

Good glass but there are some flaws with this set!. The funnel included is a cool concept but it’s not narrow enough to fit in the neck of the bottle. Also, the black lid seals are too big and flop and hang over the lid instead of being tight and professional looking. These are the 2 flaws. Everything else is pretty good with this. The spout insert snaps tightly into place, the lid screws on tight. The glass is without flaw and doesn’t wobble on surfaces.

Very simple, very lightweight. I guess I expected this to be a little prettier. It’s quite dull and lacks luster. It’s very lightweight. It looks like something you’d pick up at Worldmarket for about $10. The ridges prevent you from placing cheese on it since it’ll smush down into them. I’m having a hard time figuring out what it can be used for. You can turn it over if you want and use the flat side.

Just ok. This pan is fine but I don’t like the textured bottom. I much prefer a slick bottom. It’s also 1/2 inch smaller than all of my other loaf pans. It’s heavy and the color is attractive. I just know I will never prefer it over a traditional shaped one though.
Very small. Petite! Looks like a closet rod that’s been cut to size and sanded. That said, it’s hardwood and is easy to maneuver. I prefer a rolling pin with a taper. And one that’s slightly bigger.

Just ok. This looks like a trendy, inexpensive tv stand. It’s much smaller than I thought and I should have measured it. It took about 1.15 hrs to assemble. There is 1 shelf on the open side and 1 shelf behind the door. There are opening on the back for wires/cables to pass thru. The grey laminate has a few very teeny blemishes upon arrival. The metal brackets in the corners have glue visible in them.

Not the best quality. After initial washing/drying they are all ready balling up. I think it’s probably smarter to go with a thicker 100% cotton apron to avoid this. The strap, though adjustable, is thick and cuts into neck. These are more decorative than utilitarian.

These don’t function as they should.. I loved the color and look of this so much that I ordered an additional one for my kids’ bathroom. After washing and drying for the 1st time, both rugs had dozens of errant threads poking out of both sides. I trimmed them off and I have to do that every time I wash and dry them. That’s literally never happened to me with bath mats or rugs. Also, the way they absorb water feels absolutely murderous on your feet. It’s super clingy wet.  It skeeves me out so bad. And they take forever to dry. Also, they come with a huge tag sewn in them. I trimmed it off but you can see the base of tag. So, they really aren’t reversible.  I would not reorder these again and will be replacing. Too bad because I love the look.

Cute color and shape. Interior needs new design though.. Even set on the super quiet mode, I can hear this at night and it keeps me up. I don’t think it keeps my skin care items as cold as I’d like either when it’s on super quiet mode. I love that the door has a place for face or eye masks. The little shelf is helpful. I wish there was a sliding shelf option though maybe half way up the interior to maximize space. Even with the little shelf, you can see how little space there is inside. Such a first world problem. But still, this isn’t the right fridge for me.

Looks a little fake. I was expecting heavy cast iron like from a railroad tie or skillet. This candle holder is doesn’t have that look or feel. It looks like it has bubbles in the iron that were there when the item was cooled. Almost like a pumace stone. The shape is cool. The paint job is okay. Holds a taper candle. It doesn’t wobble when on a flat surface. Only 1 candle holder comes!!

Big with a thick seam on stem. These aren’t delicate in my opinion and are a bit too clunky for me to use. When you hold the glass by the stem, you can feel a thick seam. However, they are balanced and don’t wobble when on a flat surface. And the glass itself looks like it doesn’t have impurities or bubbles in it.

Smells like vomit. Wow these REEK! They smell like fresh vomit. Looks-wise, they are a bit rustic and simple. The gold thread is on both sides. The twine is exactly like butchers twine. The snowflakes are glued on. I will have to place  outside to see if the smell disappears. If it does, I’ll hang them inside. Looks like they may only last a season, maybe 2.

Very lightweight!. Surprisingly thin and very lightweight. I’ve used knock boxes before in coffee shops I’ve worked in. They are much heavier gauge than this. Also, the rim is sharp enough to cut you. This will work if you have no other options, but if you do, I’d look elsewhere for a sturdier product.

Design flaws.. Strange set of cutters. The edges are severely fluted and this creates a challenge when you’re trying to separate them. They get all stuck together. I prefer the clean edges and don’t really think I can use these. They store in a nice, thick plastic holder with a lid. They haven’t rusted after use.

Just okay. These are neither big nor small. They don’t match the picture on the box as far as the shape and the opening/top of the glass. They lack anything special. They are thin, so they make crisp whites especially nice. I suggest getting a varietal-specific glass vs an all purpose glass. This brand makes AWESOME varietal-specific glasses, so get those instead!

Nice but very “modern”. These are a bit angular for my taste. The stem is thin with no seam and the base sits sturdy. The glass is balanced and the shape is perfect for a delicate Pinot. I just don’t care for the harsh corners in the design.

Extremely small. Teeny tiny! Measure your space and really consider if this provides enough room for your items. Also, the shelve moves as 1 piece. The top does not slide out independently of the bottom and vice versa. This bugs me. All the hardware is included. As are mats for the bottom of the shelves so nothing slips thru.

Split after 1st use 🐝. 🐝 I made soft marzipan candy in these and when I popped them out, I noticed that the mold had split in several places. I included a picture with my review so you can see the weak spots.  I wish it was more durable. The design is darling. And after the bees came out, the detail is spot on and easy to identify. The mold cleaned up perfectly. I loved using this but am disappointed that it may not last long.

Too small to be useful. After receiving this I really thought about if I installed it, I would be taking up more space than I’m gaining. It doesn’t hold very much. The unit slides out as 1 piece, not independent drawers. You’ll probably need a liner in the bottom so your small items like vanilla extract for example, don’t slip through the wire. It’s made with solid craftsmanship and all the hardware is included. Just really think about how teeeny this is and if it would enhance your space before ordering

Not very magical!. The unicorn is a little scary looking and also has teeth! The chop sticks are a little wobbly. They do not store closed and tend to get stuck in drawer because they are always in open position. Still, they are unicorn chopsticks and my 7 year old is thrilled.

Bulky; flimsy. I had a hard time finding where to use this towel holder because it’s so long. Didn’t really fit on the side of my refrigerator. Also, the handles are flimsy  than I thought they would be. This is a cool concept. I just wish it wasn’t so big and the metal was stronger.

Just ok. This rack is super super tiny and barely worth the counter space it takes up. You have to remove the tray to dump the water out. The silverware tray can go outside or inside the rack. I’m still on the fence as to whether I should use this or just use a towel for my hand wash dishes.

Material is very cheap. But looks 🔥 amazing!!. I love the look soooo much. But it’s not wood. It’s pressboard and big chunks come out and it dents super easy if it slightly bumps against something. The hardware they send with this is very cheap. The screw head is angled so when slipped into the back hanging hooks, they move around and don’t feel secure.  I ended up using metal wall anchors vs the plastic ones they sent. I also used a flat head screw that lays flush against hanging hooks so it won’t wobble. These are very lightweight and I doubt will last very long. I love the look so much tho. I want a solid wood set!

White isn’t a good color for a kitchen mat!. Within 2 days this looked terribly dingy and old. The construction is perfectly fine. It’s also tapered so you don’t trip on it. It’s wide enough to provide true support. Just, the color needs to be re-thought. Bummer!!

Just ok. This parchment is just okay. It’s very thin and even when my item is baking in a 350° oven, it still gets really brown. If you’re broiling on this, the paper will flake and turn to embers. It is smaller than a classic sized sheet pan but I like to have a few different sizes. This is more for a toaster oven. I wouldn’t re order this. And plan to search for a different brand next time.

Looks dingy; thin. I love the size and the value of this rug. But it’s so thin and drab. Both my kids asked me if it was old/used prior to us using it because it just looks dirty as it’s normal state. It has no backing. So it needs a pad underneath it if you want comfort. I plan on moving it to the garage after I find a brighter, more cheerful replacement.

Very thin! But pretty.. [[VIDEOID:a4e019f6fbec82f12c309d1ec1ef2f05]] I love the look/color/pattern of this rug. But I was pretty surprised by how thin it is. It feels like a towel. It’s basically tightly woven baker’s twine. The hem is threadbare in a few spots. The backing is soft cotton (no rubber or polypropylene) Because of it’s weight, it doesn’t quite lay flat. You can see evident folds. It also means it slides around a bit. I don’t have a pad under it, but I bet that would solve a few of the issues I’ve listed above. If you need a huge rug for a low price, this is an an excellent choice. But doesn’t expect plush, heavy longevity.

A lot of trouble for a little comfort. You have to really go to a bit of effort to use this. Water fill up, not too full, the correct little reservoir, remembering to check level blah blah blah. I guess it’s better than nothing in a sweltering environment, but it’s a bit of hassle and only appropriate for adults to use, in like, an office setting. Not at night to gain some comfort because the water could run out!

Too small to be useful.. Extremely small and shallow. Doesn’t fit much of anything. Easy enough to assemble. However when I moved it to a different room, the base fell off and I had to put it back on. I ended up giving it to my son to display all his clay creations. It works there and keeps his things elevated.

Just ok. First off, I don’t like the gold bands. They are flimsy and look ugly. They also are just the teeniest bit smaller than a ball/Kerr lid so they only fit in this jar. Second, the glass is very thin and I’m leary about putting these in a 30 minute hot water bath. I wouldn’t prefer them again. But, they are packed very well and arrived all entact. Lots of extra lids came with these too.

Excellent size, but flimsy. Thin and super duper flimsy. But the portion size is PERFECT. I like to use these for personal quiches. Because they are so flimsy, you need to fill and transfer them to the oven on a sheet pan or cookie sheet. I doubt I would reorder these but they are useful!

Too plastic looking for my liking. This looked more like plastic and less like wicker than I expected. The back of each basket has a convenient hanging tab. The colors are integrated beautifully. I was just looking for something extremely organic and more natural.

Too lightweight!. I’d had a few sets of metal nesting bowls over the years. These are by far the lightest, thinnest ones I’ve ever used. They also spot really really bad. I’m sure they will dent and warp quickly. They nest inside one another really nicely and it’s kind of cool to have sooooo many bowls. I mostly use the 3 largest though so the smaller ones are a bit redundant imo

Tiny opening. Awesome quality bags but the opening isn’t the advertised width. It’s a bit smaller, making these very challenging to fit contents inside. They seal very well and work best with loose ingredients, not loaves of bread or cookies.

Mediocre and SO MESSY!!. I really, really wanted to love this burr grinder. It looks sleek and modern. It’s heavy and truly seemed liked the real deal. There are a few flaws though that made me pack it up and put it away. First, there is no hopper to store beans in. The company touts this as a bonus but, after using it, I don’t think it is. The bean lid is magnetic so it fits on there fine but it’s a pain to pour your beans in there daily. They can spill and it’s an unnecessary step every morning pre-coffee. Second, the static caused by the grinder is dreadfully horrific. No matter how careful I am there are grounds EVERYWHERE. EVERYWHERE!! You can’t escape it. Soooooo messy. The little rubber top comes off the top of the grounds cup when you pour the freshly ground coffee into your maker too. MORE MESS! Lastly, the grinder stops mid-grind once in a while. Meaning, PRE COFFEE, I have to pull it out, disassemble it, clean it then start over. It’s too much. Especially when I’ve used the same little krupsGrinder everyday for a decade with zero mess and no mid-grind halt. For the money, this thing should be FLAWLESS. It’s not. And it’s not worth the hassle.

Too small; fragile. Comes in a beautiful gift box. Upon unpacking I was bummed tho. Super small. The ceramic lining hold like 8oz. It broke the first use after placing it on my counter. Not really worth it to me.

Very, very thin. Pretty colors!. This really isn’t a rug. It’s a mat. It’s super flat with absolutely no pile. The design is just printed on the top. The backing is pretty much non-slip. It’s great to use by a front door because you don’t have to worry about the clearance when the door opens. I was expecting a fluffier rug. It works in its location and the colors are very very pretty. Easy to clean. You can sweep or vacuum. You can also wash this in the washing machine.

Very small. Odd hanging option.. These are so small I can barely fit a coffee mug in them. With no middle shelf, it’s not an efficient use of my space. The holes to mount are a pain. Make sure to measure your space then mark 3/4 of an inch to the left because the holes in the shelves slide to “lock” into place. The color is pretty. It’s a rich dark stain. The quality is just okay.

Breaks and cracks upon 2nd use. I love the portion of these bowls. They are very easy to initially use, however after freezing a few of them they crack immediately, and after using the second time the lid cracks pretty bad. So I don’t know if I would re-order these, I might look for some thing with a heavier lid.

So pretty but needs improvement. I ooo’d and ahhhh’d when I unpacked this. It’s so bright and shiny! It’s fun to hold. The base has a rubber ring so it’s non-slip. But as soon as I filled it, popped the lid on and took a drink I was disappointed. The lid is thick and chunky and it’s almost impossible to take a clean sip. It captures liquid in it and drips down. It’s also not ergonomically correct so it’s awkward to line your lips up with the opening. Also, after 2 weeks of use with only sparkling water, the copper at the top has come off. I included a picture.

Almost got it but still not right.. Sadly, my search for the perfect dish drainer continues,as this one won’t work. The main reason is that water pools badly on the drain board and stays there instead of draining into sink. I included a pic in my review. The 2nd reason is because the drain board only drains 1 way so you are forced to set the drainer lengthwise on your counter. And you can’t even push the drainer up against the back wall. The drain board is too narrow and must be aligned with sink. This leaves, on my counter, 3 inches of wasted space between my wall and back of drainer. The expandable drain board is a cool concept. It looks a little wonky but totally works. Love the wine rack and it holds glasses beautifully. I also love the cup rack is over the drain. Gray color is blah.

Some good things, some bad things. Using this vacuum is joyless. It looks and feels very commercial and utilitarian. (Translation: ugly, heavy and durable) As a result, it completely lacks any finesse and any modern qualities.
•The color is horrific and screams hotel lobby
•It is a bagged vaccum
•No attachments/hoses
•Cord hook doesn't turn upside down to release cord. So you have to unwind 50 feet if cord manually
•Very heavy
I love having a beater bar and a carpet pile adjustment. I love having a metal plate to quickly access bottom of vacuum/ water bar. I love turning on with my foot with button on top of the base of unit. It seems to get majority of cat hair off carpet. Am I thrilled? No. Will it work? Yes, til I replace it with something more this century
Already having problems after a week.. Works great when it works! Strong vacuum and great ability to navigate room. Unit stopped being able to dock by itself though. Only used it about 7 times.

Not as pretty irl. I wanted baskets with non plastic woven in them and these looked super cute on the add. When I opened them tho they were just 🫤 meh. Laughably simple, clunky, rustic. And the patterns lacked definition. They each have a small woven hanging loop in the back. They are very thick.

Very lightweight and very small. These are not what I expected. They are so thin and light and just over 3 inches tall. They seem most appropriate for a toddler cup. They sit flat without wobbling and the rim does have a heavy lip around it so liquid tends to get caught there.

Just okay. This is a beautiful skillet. I love the helper handle at the top and the long cool-to-touch handle at the base. Also nice are the 2 pour spouts on each side.  It’s not as heavy as a traditional cast iron skillet and the enamel job is perfect. I was so excited to use it! However, it didn’t perform as well as I expected. First off, the black part is textured. It’s very strange. My food stuck to it and when I tried to clean it with my cast iron cleaner, I scratched it. Second, it was the slowest skillet ever to heat up. I cooked shrimp on this and I swear the pan took 15 minutes to heat and cook. I was shocked. I had it on medium high heat. My other cast iron skillet cooks shrimp in 2 minutes. Third, the heat distribution was very poor. All the heat was super concentrated on the very inside. All the food on the outside was totally raw and never browned. I’m used to having to rearrange food in the skillet to ensure even cooking, but have never used such a poor performer. I can’t recommend this skillet. It’s designed well and is very attractive. But as far as cooking in it, there are many other better choices in all other price brackets.

Attractive but lightweight. This is a pretty table runner. It does have a "modern farmhouse" feel in that there is a lot of texture to the weave, the colors are soft and warm and the runner is a chevron pattern. The runner is 72 inches long and 15 inches wide. The edges are also tasseled. I didnt give it 5 stars because it is so lightweight. It slides all around constantly and has to be smoothed out all.the.time.  As a result, it's barely worth it to use. I have kids who make this runner all bunched up simply by looking at it.

Coffee flung EVERYWHERE. I am totally done with Burg grinders. They are so static-y and fling coffee all over your counter no matter how careful you are. And this grinder was easy to use but again the amount of cleanup was horrible. I just can’t recommend it.

Sloppy looking. Lots of loose threads. These are okay for the money. They are thick but because of that have a look almost akin to a stuffed animal. A surprising amount of errant threads! All over the towel. They absorb water fine. They didn’t shrink after washing.

Cool to look at but sitting in?. These chairs are down right scary to sit it. They are almost like a rocking chair in the way that they bend back. They are not stiff and when you lean back, they REALLY lean back with you. It feels like you will tip over if your not careful. I don’t think they are very safe and wouldn’t sit an older person in one.

Too much hot air blowing out of top. This does a decent job of getting moisture out of room but I couldn’t use it efficiently. The top part blows out HOT air. Everytime I’d walk by it I could feel it and it raised the temp in room up substantially. Causing my a/c to have to work harder.

Rough, very blue.. This is very navy irl. The outside is rough and feels like jute. It has golden threads woven thru it. The insert fits perfectly inside and it’s sewn very well. The tassels are also attached securely. I’m not too keen on the color or the texture

Excellent value but fickle product. This is an inexpensive alternative to a felt rug pad. Using it for a larger space had some challenges. No matter what I did, I couldn’t get it to lay flat. I have a feeling if this is used with a smaller rug, it wouldn’t be a problem. Rolling out my rug over it took a lot of maneuvering and shimmy-ing.
