Seems powerful enough to do most jobs, but probably more of a light duty blender.  The wattage is 550, which seemed like a lot, but in checking other blenders some are in the 700 to 750 watt range and I'm sure they go higher as well.  The gasket is not a separate piece which is a real plus.  I suppose 12 speeds is nice, but how many speeds do you really need?  I don't even use the 8 speeds on my old blender.  Instructions say that to blend hot liquids you need to leave the cover loose and cover it with a towel.  Seems like a hassle when other blenders will handle hot liquids without doing anything special.  When using it with hot food and liquids, you'll now have a dirty towel to wash.  I usually don't read what other reviewers say, as I don't want to be influenced one way or another, but I noticed several who had a problem with the plastic blender cup base breaking easily.  With a two year warranty and the low price of this blender, you probably can't go wrong, but it's not fun to wait for replacement parts.  You also have to search for your receipt and whatever else might be required for warranty service or return.  If I wanted a quality power tool, I wouldn't think twice about selecting Black & Decker as they make good power tools.  Are their small appliances as good?  Probably not.  I recommend buying a blender from a manufacturer who has a long history of making quality blenders.  Apparently Black & Decker acquired General Electric's small appliance division in 1984, so it would seem they have over 20 years of experience, but contrast this with the Waring Blender company that has been making blenders since the 1930's.  There are so many blenders available in the market and there probably isn't a lot of difference amongst them until you start getting up into higher prices.  Seems like there is a lot of competition in the market for blenders and this is a low end competitor is good enough for people who don't use a blender every day.  If you are constantly using your blender (like for a daily smoothie), select something more rugged that costs more.  This is by no means a food processor; I think it is wise to spend more and get a combo food processor and blender, which should serve your needs longer.  This is probably good for a cheap, attractive gift, especially for someone just starting out who really needs a blender.

Nice Set of Heavy Duty Glass Containers with covers; better than plastic for food storage. Nothing beats glass for food storage.  Plastic containers always seem to warp or take on odors or colors of the food.  Also heating in plastic is less than ideal.  This is a nice variety of different sized glass containers.  The plastic covers seem to fit tightly.  Note that there are 4 pieces that I guess you would call dessert cups with a decorative border along the top and these do NOT come with covers.  I thought maybe the similar size dish covers would work, but they don't fit.  You only really want to use those 4 for something that you would finish eating at one time.  If you have food left in them, you would have to transfer it to a container with a cover or cover with plastic wrap.  The set is heavy thick glass and seem less likely to break if you drop them than thinner, cheaper glass containers.  I didn't drop one to find out if it would break.  Pyrex is a trusted name in glassware and I have some older Pyrex that has been in use for years.  One reviewer says that new Pyrex does not use the same glass formula and that these are more prone to breakage especially when subjecting them to temperature variations.  Some common sense here probably would easily prevent any problem.  Even if the glass can withstand it, generally it is not a good idea to take a container of food that has been heated and stick it in the refrigerator right away.  Let it cool to room temperature first and then refrigerate.  Also if you take something out of the refrigerator, don't heat it up right away; again give it some time to reach room temperature.  Those precautions are smart to use with any containers, but especially glass and should prevent any potential shattering problems.  The full set is quite heavy and difficult to lift, which is the main downside if you want to transfer the whole set from one place to another.  Of course once you take it from the box, you probably wouldn't be moving the whole set at once.  Just be aware that if you want to use this as a gift, it is heavy and difficult to move.  If you are a strong, young person you probably can manage it okay, but you wouldn't want to carry it very far.  One other thing I didn't like was the color of the covers.  In addition to red, it would have been nice to have a couple other colors such as green, blue or yellow, just for some variety and potentially color coding your food items.  Not a big deal, but the red seemed a little garish.  The marked down price that Amazon is currently offering seems very reasonable for a set like this.  A few single pieces of quality glassware could cost you as much as this whole set.  Remember those that in addition to the 4 dessert cups, you really only get 12 other pieces of glassware, as the 12 covers count as part of the total 28 pieces.

Very cute; good quality; not quite a work of art; wonderful doorstop. This is really cute and makes a nice gift for someone who likes cats.  It is heavy enough to use for a doorstop and yet light enough to put on a shelf as either just a decoration or possibly to hang keys or some other item on.  Looks and feels durable, so doubt it would easily break, if at all.  It is cast iron after all.  Maybe a little pricey, but you are getting a quality product.  What's the downside?  It is solid black (blacker than it appears in the photo) and might have been a little nicer with some color added, even if just the cats eyes had some color.  If you are artistic, I suppose you could custom paint it yourself.  You need to be careful with this if you put it up on a low shelf as it is heavy enough to cause serious injury if pulled off the shelf by a young child and it falls on them.  I think it is best used on the floor either just as a decoration or as a doorstop.  I like it and recommend it, if you like this kind of thing.  I noticed this company makes a line of dancing pigs as well.

GOOD QUALITY CHAIR FOR GENERAL OFFICE USE. This is a good basic office chair. First the good:
- seems to be good quality
- easy to assemble
- back of the chair is comfortable and tilts back for extra comfort
- arms are adjustable slightly from side to side, so you can make the clearance a little wider if needed
- seat adjusts up and down to several heights with lever, just like most adjustable chairs
- attractive

Now the not so good:
- arms are not adjustable up and down, but seem to be a good height (arms could be removed if you didn't want them)
- arms are not padded, but reasonably comfortable; could get uncomfortable after a while
- seat angle seemed to push me forward somewhat, so I had to keep re-adjusting myself to stay at the back of the chair

I am using this chair at the dining room table for eating and playing cards for a couple of hours. The only problem is that the arms are at a height that they keep hitting the edge of the table. If I lower the chair so that the arms fit under the table, the seat is too low. I had one problem with this chair, but not especially the fault of the chair. I was sitting in it and assembling something in front of me that required some bending. I bent over a little far and the chair skidded out from under me and I fell and hurt myself. It should be noted that care needs to be taken when using a chair with casters, like this one, on tile. It moves very easy and can be a hazard if you aren't careful. Not the fault of this chair, as this will be true of any chair with wheels. Not a chair for klutzes, especially if using on a hard floor. As a final word, I would say this chair is comfortable for a couple of hours, but might not be so much for more time than that. Price of the chair seems reasonable for the quality, but you might find an equal quality chair on sale for less.

Easy to Assemble; replaces box spring and base. I needed a new bed (mattress and box springs).  When I saw this was available, I ordered it right away, as it eliminates the need for the box springs.  It's a base and mattress foundation all in one, so you can put your mattress right on top of this.  It appears to be well made and strong enough to hold a mattress and the weight of two sleepers.  Another Zinus bed frame I had did not look very strong and was poor quality.  This one, however, seems to be much better quality.  Assembly was very easy.  You can almost do it alone, but it helps to have someone hold some of the pieces while you put in the screws.  Two of us put it together in under 1/2 hour.  The illustrated assembly instructions are easy to understand.  You do not need any tools, as it comes with an Allen wrench, which is the only tool you need to assemble it.  The screws went in easily and seemed to fit well and were tight.  Nice clearance underneath, so you can clean under it.  My current bed has to be moved to clean under it, which is a major job.  There are mounting holes in the two end pieces so you can add a headboard and foot-board if you wish (not included).  That would keep the mattress from sliding around, as I have some concern that it might, as there is nothing to keep it in place other than gravity.  Of course on any bed, the mattress just sits on the box spring anyway, with nothing to secure it, so this is no different.  I have yet to sleep on it, but I am sure it will be fine. (Waiting for a good mattress sale.)  I will update the review after I have slept on it.  I don't think you can go wrong with this if you are looking to replace your whole bed.  Don't buy if you want a fancy looking bed with woodwork.

Attractive, programmable, works as slow cooker and steamer as well as a rice cooker. After cooking rice in the microwave for over 35 years, I thought it would be nice to have a real rice cooker.  You can make really nice rice in a microwave, but there are some good advantages to this rice cooker.  The first advantage is being able to program it in advance when you want it to start cooking.  If you are not home when you need to start the rice cooking, you set it up to start at a particular time.  Another advantage to this cooker is that it eliminates the need for a crock pot (slow cooker) as it works for that as well.  There is also a steamer basket in it, so you can steam vegetables and the instructions even say you can do it as the same time as you are making rice.  Instruction booklet is well illustrated and seems very comprehensive and complete (something that is a rarity these days).  The cooker is attractive with a digital control panel. The only issue that I found was that some of the buttons on the digital controls are a little small and close together, so you might easily hit the wrong button if you fat finger it.  Otherwise this is a nice cooker and has settings for different kinds of rice.  Made in China, but appears to be a U.S. Company.  Has a 5-year warranty, which is longer than most small kitchen appliances.  Claims to be BPA free.  A must for families that eat a lot of rice.

Nice looks storage; looks like a bread box; not as large as it looks. This is attractive and useful, but it isn't quite as big as I hoped it would be.  It doesn't really hold that much, due partly to the slanted front.  It looks larger in the pictures than it actually is.  It is made of press-wood and I would have preferred solid wood, but so many things these days are made from press-wood.  The quality seems good.  This looks like a bread box and I guess you could use it for that if the color works well in your kitchen.  It might hold a couple loaves of bread easily, but maybe not much more; possibly 3 or 4 loaves maximum.  You do have to assemble this, but it is not difficult.  I do recommend a power screw driver, as I found it difficult to crank the screws all the way in by hand.  I finally did it all by hand, but it was hard on my wrist.  There are 12 screws that hold it together.  There are also pins included if you want to stack the unit with another like it.  There is an extra screw, an extra stacking pin, an extra screw cover and an extra door pin, in case you should lose any during assembly.  You only need a Phillips-head screwdriver or tip for your power screwdriver.

Quality Chair; easy assembly; works good. This is a little better than a basic office chair. It was easy to assemble. Probably didn't take more than 15 minutes. Includes an Allen wrench which is the only tool you need to assemble it. It is reasonably comfortable. I haven't tried sitting in it all day, but seems fine for several hours.
At first I thought they had sent the wrong seat, as the holes didn't line up on the bottom of the seat for the bracket for the back. They do line up, but I had the bracket in the wrong direction; it only works one way, so you can't make a mistake on assembly. I would have preferred a chair with arms and I think this same chair must be available with arms, as there were mounting holes in the seat for arms. If you buy a chair with arms and don't want or need the arms, you can always remove them, but it is nice to have that option. This model doesn't have the arms and that's okay if that's what you are looking for. If you spend a lot of time in front of a computer, as I do, you probably want a better chair, but this is a good chair, especially if you aren't sitting for hours. I would probably buy it again if I needed another chair, but I would opt for the model with arms next time.

Nice full featured coffee maker; much larger and taller than expected. I got this Coffee Maker to replace an older one that lacked two important features that this has:  programming when you want the brewing to start and automatic shutoff.  This also has a nice feature that lets you pour a cup of coffee before it has completed brewing; you have 25 seconds to put the carafe back in before the filter basket overflows.  The machine also shuts off any drips any time you remove the carafe.  My old coffee maker would just drip coffee on to the heating element.  This coffee maker keeps the coffee warm for 2 hours before automatic shutoff.  It would seem to me that for a roughly $100 coffee maker, it should include a feature to set how long you want the coffee kept warm, rather than just a per-determined 2 hour shutoff.  You can always manually turn it off of course or unplug it.  You also can start it manually with a brew button.  If you don't want to use the timer or if you want to override the timer, you can do that with the manual button.  Of course with a built in timer, you have a clock displayed on the control panel, but that's one more thing to set the time on when there is a power failure.  A battery backup for the clock would also have been a nice feature that's not included.  One nice feature that is included is an optional carbon filter inside the tank that makes the coffee taste better.  Also note that this comes with a permanent filter brew basket, negating the need to buy paper coffee filters.  Another feature is a "small batch" button when you are only brewing 2 to 4 cups, but I couldn't see the point of it since it will still brew 12 cups of you fill the coffee maker with 12 cups of water.  Overall it's a nice coffee maker with some good features.  So what's wrong with it?  It's a bit pricey.  It is also very large; a big hulking machine.  My old coffee maker that makes the same 12 cups is only 11 inches high.  This is a whopping 15 1/2 inches tall.  It is also 9 inches wide; my old one is only 6 1/2 inches wide.  Both my old one and this one are 10 inches deep.  Of course a little extra size is needed for the digital control panel.  If you are using this on a counter with cupboards above make sure you have at least a 16 inch clearance as this is the "incredible hulk" of coffee makers.  I knocked one star off my otherwise 5-star rating for the huge size.

Very Nice Quality, but wash only in cold water. Very nice quality, attractive tablecloth that is good enough for "company".  Seems quite durable.  The only downside to this is that even though it is machine washable, the instructions say to wash in cold water.  If you wash mostly in hot water (as I do), you will have to put this separately in a cold water batch of laundry.  Other than the laundering restriction, I think you will be very happy with this table cloth.  It is not thin, cheap material that will wear out fast or tear.  It is a quality made item.  Made in India according to the label.  Looks good without ironing.

Attractive, Sturdy, Very Useful. Great idea to have separate cutting boards for 4 types of food to help avoid cross-contamination.  The boards seem durable and of good quality.  Also the storage case is attractive and seems sturdy.  What's not to like?  Just one thing that occurs to me.  After using an individual cutting board, before inserting it back into the storage rack, you need to make sure it is really clean or food particles could fall down into the rack.  Of course normally you would clean a cutting board after use anyway.  If you don't want to worry about a complete cleaning of a cutting board after using it, you could use all four boards for anything you want to chop and then after use, put each in the dishwasher after use.  When all 4 are dirty, you run your dishwasher load and then restore 4 clean cutting boards to the rack.  Definitely some good advantages to having 4 cutting boards in a slim attractive rack instead of just one all-purpose cutting board.

EASY OPEN, BUT HAS LOCK TO PREVENT ACCIDENTAL OPENING; ATTRACTIVE. This is the second drink bottle that I have acquired recently.  The first one was a different brand and it was okay, but hard to open to get a drink.  This one has a nice push button so the top pops open easily.  It also has a locking mechanism so that it doesn't accidentally pop open and spill.  The bottle is an attractive black with some nice finger grooves for easy holding.  Overall very well constructed and I like it a lot.

QUIET, EASY TO USE, NICE ATTRACTIVE UNIT. The last humidifier I used before this one was very old technology and it made too much noise.  This unit runs so quietly that you cannot hear it; even the moisture that it emits comes out silently.  I have had some trouble getting the buttons on the unit to respond, but eventually they work.  It was hard to tell if I was getting low or high mist.  The unit shuts off when it runs out of water, which is good.  When I first got this, the tank had a strange odor, so perhaps I should have washed it out once before using it.  The only thing I didn't really like too much about this unit is the amount of water it uses.  If I could use tap water, that would be no big deal, but our water is so hard that it would mess up the unit in no time.  I have to use distilled water and on the high setting it only runs two nights before having to fill it again.  Distilled water is not expensive, but it runs about 50 cents a day using it on the high setting.  The manual says about 50 hours of operation on the low setting, but it didn't seem like I was getting anywhere near that amount of time.  I suppose to get a good amount of moisture in the air in my dry climate it needs to use a good amount of water, but I may have to buy a lot more distilled water each trip to the store.  I already use distilled water for other purposes, so now will have to buy more.  Anyway, it is a nice unit and if you need moisture in the air, this does a great job.

Good Quality; attractive, easy to assemble. Unlike so much of the furniture you can buy these days, this is not made out of cheap particle board.  This is real wood; a decent quality veneer.  Assembly was easy and the color and appearance looks great.  Drawer glides are wooden also, so not too much chance of breaking.  I have seen furniture with plastic drawer glides that are stapled on and they already break.  The glides and made into the drawers and the sides, so no chance of breaking.  Worth the money.

Comfortable, Easy Assembly. This is more expensive than other office chairs that I have owned, but as the old saying goes, you get what you pay for.  This is worth the price.  This was easy to assemble in less than 1/2 hour.  You can do it alone, but does help if you have two people working on it to help hold parts and you hook them together with the included Allen wrench.  The lumbar support is excellent and you can sit for a long time comfortably.  The arms can be raised or lowered and the armrests can tilt outward, inward or straight.  The only thing that I did not find useful was the headrest.  No amount of adjusting (it raises, lowers and tilts) could get it were it helped much.  You have to lean your head back against the headrest and then you can't do anything else, except relax in the chair.  I should have knocked off one star for the nearly useless headrest, but all the other overall features of the chair more than make up for this one deficiency.  This is the first chair that I have owned that had a dedicated headrest, although some high back office chairs do support the head.

NOT AS BRIGHT AS I EXPECTED. This was to replace my microwave light that burned out.  I found a video online on how to do the replacement and it was very easy.  Apparently a lot of Panasonic microwaves use this same bulb.  The bulb is not nearly as bright as the one I replaced, but it is LED, so should last longer.  Of course the light is not essential to the operation of the microwave, but does help when putting food in and tells you visually when it is running.  I am sure that I saved an expensive appliance service call by replacing the bulb myself.  These particular bulbs come two to a package and are still less expensive than some comparable ones that are only sold singly.

Quality product, but a little hard to assemble. I never had an office chair that was quite as difficult to assemble as this was.  It is not complicated, as there is an illustrated guide, but I found the wheels difficult to insert, as they were a tight fit.  That's good, as they won't be likely to come loose.  I also got confused as to which screws went into which holes and I had to actually remove some screws and redo.  I finally figured out that the screws are numbered on the assembly diagram and on the corresponding cardboard that they are attached to.  It would have saved some time and trouble had I realized that at first.  The real problem that I encountered is that the screws designated to hold the arms to the back of the chair were too long.  I had to actually cut them off with a hacksaw to get them in far enough to get the trim strip to cover the heads.  That was a little surprising and frustrating, since all the other screws went in fine.  That problem is why I knocked off one star on my rating.  Also, I found it hard to attach the back; struggled with it for a while to get it positioned correctly.  There are some extra screws included in case you lose one or more.  Also, they include an Allen wrench to put the screws in with, so you don't need any other tools (unless you have to cut off some screws, as I did).  This is a good quality chair for the money and it seems very durable and well made.  Haven't decided yet how comfortable it is, as it takes time to adjust to a new chair.  It does appear to have some lumbar support for the lower back.  Not having lumbar support in my current chair, makes it a little uncomfortable at first, but I think over time, it is a good thing and will help anyone who sits a lot, as I do.  The chair is adjustable on height, as almost all office chairs are.  There is no adjustment on the arm height, but not expected for the price of the chair.  Also note that the arms are a hard material and not padded.  They seemed comfortable enough, but my current office chair has padded arms.  The chair is basic black, but quite attractive.  A good chair for the price.  If you want more features, like adjustable arms, you will pay more.  UPDATE:  I have used this chair for a while now and find it to be very comfortable; more so than other chairs in the same price range.  I am abandoning my old office chair and using this one exclusively now.  5 stars on comfort; the lumbar support is great.

VERY ATTRACTIVE SET WITH NICE STORAGE BOX. My wife likes nice things and is picky about quality.  She looked at this set and immediately thought it was a very attractive set.  It also comes in a nice quality polished wooden box.  This would make a gorgeous gift that you can buy for under $50 and it looks elegant and not cheap.  I had expected a flimsy, low quality box that the silver would come in, but was pleasantly surprised that the box appears to be very well made.  It is only service for 6, so I would suggest buying two sets if you want more than 6 place settings.  For the price, it seems as if it would be hard to find a comparable set.

Very easy, fast assembly, attractive, strong and functional. Very easy to assemble in just minutes and without any tools.  Seems like it took me 10 to 15 minutes tops.  I did have a little difficulty getting the top to slip on to the pegs that hold it; had to apply quite a bit of pressure (after I got it started on, I actually sat on it to push it down on).  Once assembled it is very solid and sturdy and not likely to fall apart easily.  It is attractive and the adjustable shelf is a plus.  I knocked off one star on my rating because this is made of pressed wood, rather than solid wood.  I think the pressed wood makes it heavier, as it is a bit on the heavy side. Many things these days are made of pressed wood and I would guess it keeps the cost down.  Also the plastic-like lamination over the press wood was chipped on one corner on the top where it was easily noticed.  That might have happened in shipping, as my box was rather beaten up when it arrived.  Fortunately it was packed well with protective Styrofoam.  Unfortunately the Styrofoam is is type that breaks apart really easily, so I had little pieces of it all over the floor that needed to be cleaned up.  Bottom line: strong, functional and attractive bookcase that is quick to assemble.

GORGEOUS, HIGH QUALITY TABLECLOTH - RECOMMENDED. Beautiful tablecloth with a nice texture.  We are expecting visitors soon and this will be one of the tablecloths that we will use.  It looks much better than in the picture.  My wife, my sister and myself all liked it and liked the color and design a lot.  Nothing here to find fault with.  Whenever something says "machine washable", that's always a good thing.  The description says for "outdoor use", but this is nice enough to use inside and that's where we will probably use it.

Nice enough, but not special. This is a nice soft, absorbent mat and the color (off white) is okay.  Am going to use it in the guest bathroom.  It doesn't seem like it is anything that special, but perhaps a little nicer than a standard bath mat.  Price is okay but you might find something as nice for a bit less.

Looks nice; takes some time to assemble. I was slightly disappointed, but not surprised that this product was made of pressword.  Solid wood would have no doubt been more expensive and heavier.  At least the quality of the presswood seemed quite good.  It took quite some time to assemble this, but the illustrated instructions are EXCELLENT.  Assembly went very well, although a little slow.  Fortunately are the parts are numbered and well referenced on the assembly instructions.  There were some extra pieces of hardware included (screws, etc.) which is great if you were to lose something during assembly.  I am quite happy with the look of the product and it is a nice looking TV stand.  Before I was using a simple table/desk which was never ideal.  If you want a great looking TV stand at a very reasonable price that is not too difficult to assemble, you should be quite happy with this.  This is made in China, but then what isn't these days?

Works fast; works great. I had some quite old popcorn that would not pop very well in the microwave.  I loaded it up in this machine and every kernel popped and it was done in a short time (about 2 to 3 minutes).  Worked great.  I love it.  It will get a lot of use.  The popcorn wasn't so good, but I am sure it was because it was quite old.  Am anxious to try it out with some fresh popcorn.  It is an attractive little machine too.  Doesn't look like it holds much, but it filled up a good size bowl.  I couldn't believe that all the popcorn would be ejected from the spout, but every piece was.  Highly recommended for popcorn fans.  You could make a lot of popcorn in a short time.  In half an hour, you could make about 8 to 10 big bowls of popcorn.

Great for Camping or During a Power Outage. This was not quite as tall as I expected, and the fan is small.  For a small fan, it has good air flow and 3 speeds, as well as feature for rotation if you want it to rotate.  Also has 3 levels of night light if you want it.  Because this is USB rechargeable, you don't need a cord to run it, which means you could use it when camping or when there is a power failure, and your air conditioner isn't running.  It is a nice little fan.  It is important to realize there is an overall master on/off switch on the side of the base and then operating buttons on the top of the base.  Haven't run it long enough to see how long a charge lasts, but according to the specs it should run a number of hours.  You can collapse this for easy storage.  I am impressed overall with the fan and might get another one.

Looks Classy; Nice Quality. Very nice looking tablecloth and seems to be very good quality.  Wasn't sure I would like the charcoal color, but it's very classy looking.  Has a nice feel to the material.  Great that it is supposed to be water resistant, but I haven't tried dumping water on it to find out, nor have I yet spilled anything on it.  If it help with spills at all, that's a plus, as most tablecloths just soak up the water.  I don't think you would go wrong with this.  If you have kids that tend to spill liquids a lot and you don't want to put a cheap looking tablecloth on your table, this might be just the thing for you.

Lots of pieces; takes a while to assemble; good assembly instructions. Like a lot of furniture these days, this is made from press wood or chipboard or whatever you call it.  I had a pretty good idea that it would be when I ordered it.  Solid wood furniture is very expensive, so this is a good alternative for saving some money.  It looks to be decent quality and will look good once I finish assembly.  It is going together slowly because there are a LOT of pieces.  Set aside some time to assemble this, as you won't be able to put it together quickly.  The assembly instructions are easy to follow and seem complete, so it there is nothing difficult here; just a little time consuming.  I think it will be okay in the end, but sometimes because the screws holding it together are going into press wood, some of the wood can crack or chip out a little, but eventually seems like the screws will hold okay.  Appears to be a solid, attractive desk, easy to assemble and an affordable price.  I would not hesitate to recommend it, if you can't afford solid wood.

Nice that you can microwave or freeze. These are nice because you can pack up to three different items in one container and have them well separated.  You put one item in the bottom and then you insert a two compartment tray above and add two more items.  The tray for other items is optional of course if you are only packing one item.  These are microwavable and freezer safe, so that's a nice plus.  They are a little more durable that some food containers, but don't seem strong or durable enough to be permanent, but are good for more than just one time use.

Great Decorator Item. I was hoping to pass this on to a child as a truck to play with after I enjoyed having it for a while.  Unfortunately, it is not suitable for play, as the wheels are fixed and do not move.  Also it has some sharp edges that a child could get hurt on.  They did put real rubber tires on this, so that makes it look more realistic.  Suitable mainly as a decorative item.  Would make a nice centerpiece for a table and you could use the truck bed for napkins (if folded a certain way) or for a few condiments, such as a salt and pepper shaker.  The truck has enough detail to be attractive and interesting, such as side mirrors and a steering wheel.  I knocked off one star on my rating just because the wheels are fixed in place.  I am happy with the item and will probably keep it, but it is suitable quality as a gift or re-gift for the right person.

ADORABLE RABBITS; SOLID ALL METAL CONSTRUCTION. Have ordered a couple of other Design Toscano items and they are always top quality and really cute.  These bookends are heavy enough to hold books quite well and the rabbits are adorable.  Truthfully I can't imagine anyone not liking these or finding any problem with them.  These are all metal, so nearly impossible to break.  Very happy with the item.  These would make a great gift too.
Soft High Quality Pillow Cases. These are nice enough to give as a gift, so we are holding on to them for that purpose.  They are soft and appear to be high quality.

Nice Small Fridge, but a little too small. Nice looking fridge.  Reversible door is nice, but looks like a little bit of work to get it reversed to swing the other direction.  Runs reasonably quiet.  Maybe adequate for a dorm room, but otherwise just too small to hold much of anything.  I didn't realize it was quite so small when I ordered it.  The door will hold just one two liter bottle of soda.  The freezer compartment will fit maybe two ice cube trays and that's about it.  Overall will hold only about 12 cans of soda.  Not sure if it is big enough to hold a leftover pizza in the box.  Would not be big enough for a small apartment.  Not sure if this is frost free; I don't think it is, so you might have to defrost the freezer once in a while. Nice table.... with the drawer. This will be a long but helpful review, I hope. I think this is a nice heavy table. It was so easy to put together following the easy directions which are just pictures with the part numbers on it and that was great !...until I got to the drawer!! Lol. I carefully looked at the directions before I put it together, or so I thought. Then I saw those little white hole plugs and have never used them before. I thought they would be put in after the screws to cover/plug where the screw was showing...wrong, they need to be put in BEFORE the screws go in..and you have to make sure the little holes in them match up with where the screws so the screws can go into them. They keep the screws nice and tight in their holes. I didnt know that as like I said, have never used this type before. So I had to take one of the sides off (since that is all I did at this point,) so I could do it correctly and move on to finishing the drawer. Lesson #1 learned. The rest of the drawer went together so nice and easy...or so I thought...until I had to put the drawer into the table !! Lol Here I sit in my kitchen trying to slide it into the rollers..after a few shoves and angry words, I gave up and looked for the "if you need help, call...number" there is NONE on the instruction sheet !! Ugh. So I carefully studied the drawing of the drawer bit by bit as I compared my drawer to the drawing..alas I have noticed that on the drawer the slide has an open end and a closed end..on step #7, it sure would have been helpful to put a circle around that part or notation saying " make sure  the opened end of the slide is facing the front of the drawer" (naturally mine were facing the back)... or mention there is a left and a right on the side parts, so I had to take the whole thing apart ..again. Then I put the drawer in front of the table and it slid right in !!!!  I was going to use the table without the drawer if it didnt go in this time lol. But all in all this is a wonderful, nice table that was very easy to assemble..that drawer mmm not so much lol. Lesson #2 learned, look extremely careful at the drawings. But I am hoping the drawer will be much easier for you to put together after reading this. Very happy with this table.

I start this up at the same time I start my tea brewing and go about feeding the wildlife in my backyard.  It’s just a very peaceful start to my day. Excellent for moving & storage & floods!. I purchased these for multiple reasons. The main reason was that I was moving. I was moving bc my apt kept flooding.  Luckily having been through other floods I generally store all my stuff in plastic containers anyways. Sadly a couple of my vintage Singer’s in wooden boxes had been left out during the last move & the last flood got them moldy & ruined them.  I am a bibliophile & these bags held not only huge stacks of my hardcover books, but my 40 pound Singer sewing machines. I also carried hundreds of pounds of yarn (50 per bag) and thousands of pounds of quilting fabric during my move.  It held up to paints, plants, garden pits, & pretty much anything I threw at it. I even put my pots & pans in these bags.  While I still thought they were a bit pricey I did buy some on sale & I think I bought 18 total that I was able to pack & take to my new place & unload & go pack again. Tho I now intend to leave some of my yarn in them as it’s waterproof.  Tho I intend to place it on a top shelf just to be on the safe side. Lol. Not one bag ripped, tore, or had an issue so far that I am aware of tho I have not checked them over very well. And I had no issues with the zippers tho I am positive that I packed several bags well over the weight limit on accident bc I was trying to keep certain quilting fabrics together for a quilt project.  I’ve bought some real duds on Amazon, but this was not one of them. This has by far been one of my better purchases & I’ve told my kids that are planning to move to buy the bags too bc it is just so much easier imo.  I literally used a taxi to move half my stuff (disabled & don’t drive) & was able to fold the bags back down to how they arrived after unpacking to take them back to be packed again.  I also made little tags and used color coded handkerchiefs I hung on the handles so I knew which room the bags went in or knew what was in them without having to open them in the wrong room once I moved.  It saved time.  I live in an apt & these bags take up a lot less space than the massive sterling & Rubbermaid hard sided plastic totes I normally use for moving & craft storage.  I still have them & use them, but storing them is a challenge.  Also, the bags fit under my zinus/spa sensations type elevated platform bed. It’s a frame amazon sells & you buy your own mattress. Normally I can fit 8 hard sided tubs under my bed (queen bed), but I’m limited by the height of the tubs. The bags fit or I’m able to squish to fit if I overfill them which is nice. Delonghi - quality name - quality immersion blender!!. First let me start by saying this is my second DeLonghi blender. The first one I has lasted me for years and is still in use today (despite heavy use). When I opened this new tri-blade handblender, I was immediately impressed with how the design has been improved: sleek, contemporary design which fits far easier in my hands than the old on. It is easy to use and has been vastly improved since my older model. I love making home made pasta sauce. And, whether using canned peeled tomatoes or fresh ones, the DeLonghi makes food preparation a breeze. I get compliments every time with people assuming I spent hours preparing dishes (when the Delonghi takes only seconds to blend thoroughly). I have given my old model away to my daughter to use (yes, I know, I probably should have given her the new one, lol) and now I am exclusively using the new blender. This immersion blender is reasonably priced and comes highly recommended from a long time DeLonghi fan. I know I will have and use this one, as I did the former, for years to come!

Love this Convection Oven!. Let me preface this that I am now living alone and, the majority of the time, cooking for only one person. I hate heating up an entire oven to basically make a small dish of something (with the cost of natural gas in my area, it really is cheaper to send out sometimes than to be baking on a large scale). I also really don't like using microwaves unless when I really have something fast to warm up (I hate really cooking with microwaves as foods come out rubbery and unevenly heated).When I first saw the Black and Decker convection oven, I knew it was a name I could trust (having purchased B&D appliances in the past, most recently a food processor). I absolutely love this new oven and haven't used my full size oven in well over a month now. The size (20 x 17 x 12) is large enough for baking most casseroles. The oven heats up quickly and the food cooks evenly and thoroughly. Although I have only used the broiler once since I received this, I found again the cooking to be flawless and the cleanup a lot easier than I had anticipated. The unit is a good size for my countertop (not to big, not too small) and with the black and stainless steel body, blends in well with the rest of the appliances in my kitchen. I think this unit (at under $80) is perfect for apartment dwellers, singles, small families or senior citizens (think a great Christmas gift for your aging parents). I normally don't ramble on like this with most products in review, but I really love this countertop oven and I highly recommend this appliance.

Great baking stone. Having returned from a cooking trip to Italy last May, I was anxious to start utlizing my recently learned skills. Making desserts and pizza were two of the things that I couldn't wait to try when I got home. I first used the Emile Henry baking stone for pizza and I really loved it. The thin crust I made came out crispy and evenly cooked (475 degrees), my sons loved it. Only complaint I had was that it is not the easiest item to get in and out of the oven (especially when it is fully heated). First time I tried it, I found it heavy and almost impossible to get a good grip on (especially with baking mitts on). Stone also retains heat for a good amount of time (keep that in mind if it is summer and you take it out of the oven to cool). Second time I used it was kind of like a quasi-cookie sheet. I made biscotti which requires to bake the cookies twice (first time in a lengthy roll of almost 12 inches, second as sliced in cookie slices). I only had the oven at 350 this time and the size of the stone was perfect and the cookies came out delicious. I do highly recommend the stone for anyone looking for an extra tool in the kitchen. Cooks evenly, but might be a little awkward in maneuvering it when it is fully heated.

Can't buy a better set of cookware anywhere!. Let me begin by saying I love Circulon cookware. My kitchen is a walking advertisement for it. It is designed for the cook, from the detailed handles that fit correctly in the palm of your hand to the way the pots clean up beautifully. I have never had a problem with the non-stick cookware peeling or pitting or scratching in anyway (unlike the Calphalon I have had in the past). Now specific to this set: This is the perfect housewarming or shower present for the bride to be. This set will last for years and will make even the most novice chef appear to be a professional on the first try out. There is every size in the set (perhaps with the exception of a really large stock pot) which a chef could ever need. Last weekend, I actually used almost the whole set simultaneously cooking an Italian dinner for my extended family, and I can assure you the set was well used, scraped and stirred for several courses. After the set was washed,  it looked like I just took it out of the box. Circulon may be a little more pricey than some lower cost manufacturers. But it's the old adage, you get what you pay for. Large, quiet effective unit. Let me start by saying that unlike the first reviewer, my unit was shipped in the manufacturer original packaging (not double boxed). This is a large and heavy unit and the bottom of the package actually was damaged and I was afraid the unit would also be damaged. Luckily, when the unit was removed from the box, I found the dehumidifier itself was not damaged. I thought this was a terrible way to send this item and Amazon was lucky that the unit was packaged well by the manufacturer. Now to the device itself... Like I mentioned, this is a very heavy device and I needed help getting it set up out of the box (warning to people who are not that strong). Once set up, the unit was surprisingly quiet and I also was surprised how much water the system collected from my basement (guess I never thought of my basement as that humid). The 70 pint container filled in just about 2 days and, again, I would warn anyone without much strength to empty it more frequently. Bottom line, great device, works as designed and super quiet, just heavy and poorly packaged for shipping. I would not buy this as a gift for anyone (as there is no privacy in the shipping).

Loved the taste and convenience. Not sure why there were some less than glowing reviews about this Mr. Coffee Iced Coffee Maker. I absolutely loved it. I can tell you that I already have an Iced Tea maker similar to this and I was wondering why one would bother having two very similar items. I can say that, although you can make iced tea in this coffee maker, I don't think you could find a way to do the opposite. I loved the way the iced coffee came out, cold and refreshing and perfectly brewed. I enjoyed it far more than an iced latte I would get at the local Starbucks. I would think this makes a great gift for a coffee lover, a first time homeowner or apartment dweller. Better yet, a fantastic gift for a college student which will make him/her the life of the party when it comes to dormitory living. I would not hesitate to purchase this Mr. Coffee as I think it excels at what it is expected to deliver. If you love coffee as much as I do, you will love the Mr. Coffee Iced Cafe Coffee Maker!!!

Great iced tea maker! Freshly brewed tea in minutes!. What an amazing little machine! It seems like within seconds I am drinking my first glass of fresh brewed tea. I used to have a machine years ago where I had to buy paper brew baskets and they used to make such a mess. Not any more with the Mr. Coffee machine since their basket just needs to be dumped of the tea bags and rinsed in the sink. I have nothing but good things to say about this Iced Tea maker. I think this would make a great gift for bride to be, first time homeowner, or someone who just loves iced tea!

Great for a starter set of pots and pans - think bride to be. I want to start by stating that I am a huge Circulon fan having bought and given sets as gifts over the past 10+ years. For some reason, I don't feel this set lived up to the quality of the other sets I have owned. I did see some tiny scratching on the bottom of the frying pan after only a couple of uses. I also ran several of the pieces through the dishwasher a few times and did notice a dulling in the shine once the cycle was done. I am still rating this as 4 starts as the set will last for years and is at the low end of Circulon's set pricing. This would be great as a wedding/shower gift where you can give a nice set of pots without breaking the bank in doing so, Check out my other reviews on Circulon for sets which, for about $100 more, are higher end quality and durability.

Good news - bad news. First, the size of this set is large. It is wonderful for cooking, straining and storing pasta. It is handy to have as it does all three (no need for a separate strainer) and stores nicely in my pots and pans cabinet. I was disappointed as I did try to store the pasta with sauce in the refrigerator. When I used the remainder I was surprised to see how easily the bowl stained from the red sauce. Several dishwashing loads later, it has faded some but I still can see it. I guess the lesson here is don't store spaghetti sauce in anything plastic (and I already should have known that). Outside of my own stupidity, this is a great set. I just wish the manufacturers would find a way to make these items a little more resistent to staining (for people like me).

Great alll purpose countertop oven. Not sure why some folks found the dials complicated on this. I thought the B&D Rotisserie Toaster Oven a compact toaster over loaded with tons of features and bells and whistles (and I had no trouble figuring it out). Although I am sure the main purpose of this oven is to serve your toasting needs, I found the size large enough to bake pizza and even a full rack of blueberry muffins. I tried the rotisserie feature this past week and found it to be a little messy (so I do not think I will be using that again). However, what a great little dorm room oven/toaster to give a new college bound child! The stainless steel features match my kitchen design perfectly and I will be using this smart little oven on a regular basis (saving $$ by not having to fire up a full stove for smaller baking needs). I highly recommend this oven for everyone who is looking for a nice sized, multi-purpose countertop oven.

Best new addition to my hostessing skills!. I absolutely loved this new kitchen gadget. This past Thanksgiving I used all three to put on a buffet to keep food warm (mashed potatoes, stuffing, corn) for my guests. It's attractive, easy to set up and a perfect size fr my side table. I love the lid holders in the back, that make it easy when guests go to serve themselves. I love the fact that the three of them slide to fit perfectly together and, unlike other reviewers, I really think the idea of having only one plug is an excellent idea (it saves space and there aren't a bunch of cords hanging around my dining room). I have nothing but good things to say and I think I will be purchasing another set (I see they are out of stock now, but hope they get more soon) to use for Christmas (as I had more veggies that I could have used two more cookers for. Oh, and the red color is great, too. Matches my kitchen just perfectly. Highly recommend to anyone for their own use or for giving as a gift to a hostess who loves to entertain.

A must have in every laundry room. This works just great in my laundry room.  I simply take my clothes out of the dryer and hang them immediately. Lessens the wrinkling of clothing. No real installation, just place it over the top of your door and, voila, you are done! Great item.

Every kitchen should have one!. Great little kitchen gadget. The older I have gotten (just turned 60 this year, yikes!), I find it more and more difficult to unscrew some jars. I am usually banging away at the lid with a knife or a spoon to try to get the seal broken and then I make lame attempts at trying to unscrew. Usually end up giving it to my son or nephew (or whoever may be around) to do it. With this new Hamilton Beach Jar Opener, I no longer need anyone! It is easy to use and compact. Quite a conversation maker, too. If you are looking for an add on bridal shower gift, or something no one else would ever think of, this is it. I highly recommend!
Essentials for any cook!. For the price, these are great wok accessories. Well made, super reasonably priced. I couldn't be happier. Goes with my new Aroma wok perfectly!

Perfect for the chef of your house!. Great potato cutter. I purchased this along with a Fry Daddy so I could easily make my own French fries. I was pleasantly surprised at how well made it and easy to use (and to clean). Several attachments to make different size cuts makes this a must own for any chef. I love it!

Great non-stick baking pans!. I love all of Reynolds products, and the new bakeware pans are no exception. Perfect size, non-stick (so I don't have to use butter or that scary 'I don't know what is in it' Pam). I made brownies in the first batch and they popped right out. Great fitting lid so I can store and transport easily. No complaints but would love it if they made these in a bigger pack (maybe 6 pans with 3 lids) so it would be more economical and I could reuse lids. Anyway, I will be purchasing more of these for holiday baking use. Kudos Reynolds for another great product!

Cute little gadget. What a cute little gadget for the kitchen! Although at first I didn't know if I would actually use this, I actually think (having used it three times since I received it) will use it often. The color is beautiful (blue) for any cook with the kitchen to match. The ceramic makeup works great as a non-stick and the waffle was prepared flawlessly. My kids absolutely loved this and it cooks waffles quickly and clean up is a breeze. I think this would make a great bridal/shower gift, something unique and handy that can give any chef the edge in making breakfast. Highly recommend!

Wonderful Crock Pot - Would make a great bridal shower gift for the bride to be!. Great Crock pot. It took the place of an older West Bend. I have used this now easily 6 times to cook up stews, goulash and beef bourgingon. Easily programmable, works well, nice size for my kitchen (and I love the red color which matches up perfectly to my other kitchen accessories. No complaints, you can depend on the Crock-Pot name for quality.

Pretty little rug. Pretty little rug, not of the highest quality (but the price is right). Rating it four stars as it was shipped tightly rolled in plastic and I have now had it on my kitchen floor for almost a week with weights on all four corners and I still can't get the curl out of it. Not sure how long I will need to do this, probably because of the material it is made of it holds the packaging curl tightly. I will say the colors are nice and work well with my beige kitchen. Just not thrilled with how long it is taking to lay flat. They should have a better way of shipping these.

Great Dehumidifier for the money. Silent and efficient. As one of the other reviewers stated, I also live in Southern Florida. The humidity down here can be downright unbearable at times (I am a replanted NJ woman). My central air conditioner runs constantly not only because of the heat but the humidity (there is a sensor on it which recognizes the 'feels like' temperature (not just the actual temperature). I have been using this Whynter for over a week now and I have noticeably heard my air conditioning unit kicking on less and less. I know I am saving electricity by using this dehumidifier and, on top of it all, this unit is Energy Star compliant which just seals the deal even more.  I also feel I am breathing better at night (allergies are far less bothersome). This is easy to set up and runs almost silently. If you are in the market for a dehumidifier, you can't do better than this unit. It does the job and ultimately will save you money.

Elsa was all the rage last night!. What a great idea! I have a granddaughter (6 years old) who is a big Frozen fan. I put this on last evening, knowing my son and his wife and child were coming over for dinner. You should have seen the look on the little ones face when she saw me wearing this in the kitchen! I was the biggest hit of the evening, I know she would love this apron as well, but it is made for an adult. I am looking to try to get one for he in a children's size so she can be a character with me next time we bake cookies together. I think this is a cool little apron if you are a mom or grandmom hosting a kid's party in your home or even just some one on one baking party in your home. Colorful, fits well, an is a really cool way to entertain the kids!

Absolutely gorgeous large countertop oven!. Beautiful addition to my kitchen. I must preface this that this is replacing another Oster oven I have had for about 2 years that is a tad larger. I will probably miss that I won't be able to cook the same size roasting chickens, etc, in this. But overall I am thrilled. I absolutely love the French doors. My old one had a door which opened down and could occasionally burn me if I wasn't careful putting food in or even simply closing it again. The French doors work in tandem and close flawlessly. I also think this unit is more energy efficient as well as my kitchen doesn't seem to warm up the way it did when I had my old counter top Oster going. No complaints, beautifully modern and looks wonderful on my countertop!

Great quality! Great size! A must have for every kitchen!. I love Calphalon products and use them almost exclusively in my kitchen. Sure, they are expensive. But when it comes to quality and durability, Calphalon can't be beat. It is truly the old adage 'You get what you pay for' applies when shopping for your kitchen. This large stock pot is beautiful and stands up to my tough cooking (I have a tendency to stir and use items in the pots that I probably shouldn't). I have even run this through the dishwasher a few times and it comes out looking like new. This is a great size for cooking soups and pasta. Would make a great bridal shower present for the bride who has all the basics, to help expand her kitchen ware. It also would make a great 'not so new' homeowner or renter to just help make their kitchen complete (think holiday shopping). I love this Signature series!

I am in love with a soap dispenser!. Beautiful soap dispenser. Matches perfectly in my Moen brushed nickel fixtures bathroom. Larger than I was expecting, I think I would have liked it a tad smaller (just because I feel I may have to keep it filled up most of the time because of it's crystal clear see-through glass), but outside of that it's perfect. Well made construction, pumps perfectly and beautifully smooth in design. No complaints, just wonderful for any brushed nickel designed kitchen or bathroom.

Not just for wine - every day use as well!. These are fantastic glasses! Beautiful design, ergonomically fits perfectly in my hand and well made (sturdy glass). I can see where these will be very resistant to breakage (unlike a lot of stem wine glasses I have). However, I must point out that these can be use for most any purpose (also unlike wine stem glasses). I have used them for orange juice in the morning at my breakfast table. In any event, these are beautiful, strong glasses. Another quality product by Schott Zwiesel! A must have for any homeowner/apartment dweller. Would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift for sure!

Standard office chair - reasonably priced. Not much to state on this what hasn't been said in the other reviews. This is a very attractive looking chair and the leather does seem to look high end. The chair is comfortable seating and the arms are ergonomically placed for maximum comfort. I will state I am a woman in her 50's who is a little challenged when it comes to assembling these kinds of things. Although I was able to do it, it took me almost an hour to do as I found the instructions difficult to follow. It may be me, so I hate to deduct more than a star in the rating, but I think assembly could be clearer and easier to make this a more quality chair. Also, the fact that there is no adjustable lumbar support could also be a downside. However, to be honest, it's as nice as anything I saw in Office Max when I was there a few weeks ago and was easily $20-40 less in cost. I would recommend this chair but please be sure you are up for the challenge of assembly.

Great powerful little fan!. Although I do camp on occasion, my primary reason for ordering this fan is for my life in Florida (and the many storms we have here). Last year when we had a super close threat of a Hurricane, I lost power for 1/2 a day. Luckily it was restored relatively quickly. Next time there is a storm like the cat 4 that just grazed us, I want to be better prepared. Heat in the summer here can be relatively unbearable without air conditioning. Needless to say, having a relatively mid-sized powerful fan that can be battery powered, can be a life saver if we lose power for one or more days. My only concern with this is the need for 8 batteries, but I purchased a 24 pack and will have it handy. In using this, I find the fan to be relatively powerful for it's size and I can use it easily in my bedroom to keep the air circulating. I am purchasing another as we speak so I will be better prepared overall. I am extremely happy with this fan and whether you are camping or preparing for a storm, this O2Cool fits the bill for preparedness!

Love this toaster oven - perfect for my needs. Beautiful toaster oven. I love that the door swings up instead of down (like my previous one). Makes it so much easier to remove food without burning my hands. Matches my stainless steel kitchen perfectly. The digital display looks terrific too. Great cooking size, I easily can cook a pizza or even a small roasting chicken with ease. Food cooks quickly and is evenly distributed. I love that for smaller meals I don't need to turn on my full size oven. No complaints, great device if you are looking for a new one for your kitchen.

Great stand for the inept assembler, looks great!. Let me begin by saying that I am a woman, who recently turned 60, and who is normally totally inept when it comes to putting these kinds of things together. However, since I had family coming for Thanksgiving (and a relatively small guest room), I thought I would try to put this together to see if I could open a little space in the room. Well, I did it! I was amazed at how easy this was to assemble. Sure, you needed screwdrivers (but I could handle that). I did need some help in attaching the television to the stand (not very coordinated or strong, either). But, I will say it made a major difference in the room. Besides freeing up some much needed space from the bulky stand I was previously using, it is very attractive and has room for 'storage' which makes it perfect. I am so happy with this and I know you will be, too.

Wonderful knife set. Never owned Victorinox knives before, but I do love to cook and already own a lot of high end knives. I can say without a doubt that the Victorinox knives are up to the challenge when compared with knives which cost double the price. The steak knives cut through a rib eye steak like it was butter. The chef's knife chopped up onions in a flash and the bread knife sliced through a loaf of french bread with little to no effort on my part. I have nothing negative to say about this set of knives with the exception that I wish it came with an 8 piece steak knife set instead of just a 4. I understand that this is a compact set of knives, but it would be far more convenient to have 8 knives for table settings. I will be looking for an additional set of steak knives to match to complete the set.

Great animal print cup cake cups!. These are super cute. I ordered them when I was making cupcakes for a preschool 'What animal would you like to be' party for my grandson. Colorful, different, unique. I love the fact that you can purchase theme-based baking cups like this. In addition to being unique, they are also practical and produce perfectly shaped cupcakes. Perfect for any stylized party needs you might have.

Great chair, difficult (for me) to assemble. Great looking chair at a very reasonable price (compared from what I can get a chair for at Office Depot). It is comfortable and stylish. Wheels and adjustable height makes this a great chair for maneuvering in a tight space (think dormitory). I am deducting a star because, as a 60 year woman who is typically competent at putting things together, found it difficult to assemble. I ended up having my nephew come over to help me. Maybe you won't have any issues, just if you are strong it might be a lot easier than it was for me. Overall, happy with the chair and I would recommend. Would make a great chair for a kid going away to school due to its price and size.

Grinder works well, peppercorns in a mid-courseness came out even and well ground. I have had several electronic salt and pepper shakers over the years. Overall they disappoint me and typically I revert back to the manual grinding ones. This  Cole & Mason Penrose peppermill is no exception. First, I couldn't get it open (even after reading the instructions several times). Granted, I am a 62 year old female and eventually asked my son to help. He struggled but eventually got it open. Then came the batteries (6? Isn't that crazy?). I used this for black peppercorns. It did grind well, and there were adjustable settings depending on how you like your courseness. Anyway, not much to say. It is a good mill, not sure how long the 6 batteries will last. If it turns out less than a month I will come back and update this with a three star review. I have had better, lesser expensive, less battery hungry models (and like I said, the manual grind work just as well). I give it 4 stars for the 'coolness' factor.

Great, quality wood salt and pepper shakers. Would look wonderful on any table in any home!. Quality made, attractive salt and pepper shaker. These make a great addition to any household and would make a terrific bridal shower or housewarming gift (or just a gift for yourself). I use these for more casual settings (although you could use them for everything) and I have received a load of compliments from family and friends on them since I started placing them on my table. On top of looking good, they perform excellently, grinding my peppercorns to perfection. I highly recommend them these to everyone who takes pride in how their table is set.

Great set of cookware - makes a great gift. Pratical and useful for most kitchens.. Great set of pots for the novice cook. These would be great as a shower gift for the bride to be or even just a house warming gift for the first time homeowner/apartment dweller or kid going off to college. Practical, attractive (I absolutely adore this red color) and has pot and pan sizes to meet most daily cooking needs. Adding in the two spatulars is just icing on the cake (work perfectly with the non-stick surface). As others have mentioned, for about $50 more you could buy a more advanced set. However, this set makes a great presentation and has the impressive Paul Deen name on it. I have several of her products in my own kitchen and I know that she does deliver quality products.

A great addition to any kitchen, I couldn't think of an easier, tastier way to cook for my family. These are my absolute favorite items to keep in my kitchen pantry. I use my slow cooker at least 2-3 times a month and these liners make cleanup an absolute breeze. There is no easier way to cook on the planet besides using the cooker and the liners together. I was originally a little leery about using them, wondering if there would be any impact on the taste of the foods. But Reynolds truly knows how to make quality products that make our lives simpler and easier. If you are going to a bridal shower or a first time apt/homeowner, these would make a great gift (of course with a slow cooker).

Beautiful piece for the bathroom. Love this tissue holder. First it is substantial and heavy (not made cheaply). The color blends wonderfully in my cream colored and pastel guest bathroom. I have ordered more to match this piece from the collection (i.e. the wastebasket and cup). I will be doing reviews on them when they arrive this week. I have nothing bad to say, InterDesign makes a quality product.

Love this lightweight comforter! Ella Jayne is known for quality products!. Beautiful, well made, soft and plump with polyester fill, this comforter is a must have for any homeowner. I love the lightweight feel, yet it is amazingly warm and comfortable to sleep with. This is a high quality comforter which stood up to two machine washings since I have had it in the last month (using bulky bedding mode) and came out with no pulls or snarls. The stitching is strong and this should last for years in any household. I love Ella Jayne products and prefer them over other bedding brands because of the quality products they produce. This would make a great present for a bride or a first time homeowner.

Great indoor, relatively smokeless grill, but difficult to clean. I recently sold my house and moved into an apartment where I intend to stay for about three months until my new house is ready. I love to grill in my old house and new house I had And will use a gas grill.  I knew living in a strange place for a few months and being out of my regular routine, I would really miss the healthier meals that I would make. When I saw this Krupp’s grill, I was a little hesitant.  Currently living in an apartment, I didn’t want to have to worry about smoke detectors going off, or anything else that might impact the building on them. From a personal perspective, I was worried that I wouldn’t like the taste of the food given that I’m used to growing on outdoor grills. Boy, but what a mistake I made! This is an absolutely great grill. I found very little smoke and cooking hamburgers, and they tasted great. I even think they cooked more evenly then they would’ve on the grill.  My only complaint, and that’s why am removing one star, is the cleanup. I did line the pan with aluminum foil which did help. However the inside of the grill underneath the heating element. It’s very difficult to clean. With the splashing of grease from the burgers it did take me a while to try to get this clean, and I’m still not sure if it was 100% clean. I probably won’t be using this quite as often as I would have an outside grill, but in a pinch, this is a great grill to use indoors for an apartment or a home.

Excellent Air Purifier. As a mother with several children with allergy problems, I am no stranger to using air filters/purifiers in my home/various rooms. The Fellowes purifier with Hepa does an excellent job. It is solid and runs almost silently. I was amazed at how much dust and allergens were collected in just one week of use. I highly recommend this purifier to anyone who is looking to change their room into a cleaner, easier to breath place to be. Of course, it is only good for a normal size room so you will need more of these if you plan to convert your whole home into an allergen free room. I am using it in my oldest son's room and I can tell you that, without a doubt, the Fellowes is an excellent little machine. Kudos!

Gorgeous new candle, looks wonderful in my home!. This is an absolutely beautiful decorative candle made by Yankee Candle. I absolutely love the shape and design and it looks really great in my contemporary leather living room. The fragrance is light, but fragrant and looks amazing when lit. I have been using it non-stop for the past week or so and it still looks like new. Nothing but great things to say about this candle!

Great pillow inserts!. This is a great, convenient, 4 pack of pillow inserts. I had bought some decorative sea life pillow covers that had been sitting in my linen closet for months now waiting for me to make my way to Michaels to buy inserts. I was thrilled to see that Amazon sells these, and a 4 pack is just what I needed. These are the right size (18"), well made, sturdy and fit inside my cases perfectly.  These are great for my living room set. Perfect!

Great device, I don't know how I lived without it all these years!. This is a neat little device. I used to use my garlic press, but no more. This helps me grate garlic into smaller slivers which seems to blend and cook better in my recipes. The most wonderful part of all is the cleanup. My garlic press seemed to leave more in the device than in my recipes and clean up was difficult getting it out of all the nooks and crannies. This garlic grater works cleaner and I get far more garlic in my dishes. I also like that I can slide or shred into different consistencies (depending on my recipe), something I would usually have to do with a knife. I couldn't be happier with this device and no kitchen should be without it. This would make a great little add on bridal shower gift (something unique and useful).

One of the best chef knives on the market today!. I love to cook and I am always in the market for knives. This Wallop Damascus Santoku Knife is just perfect. For under $80 (which was the price when I was reviewing this), this knife is as good as the multi-hundred dollar+ competitor knives. First, it a perfect fit in my hand which allows me to maneuver the knife around my vegetables smoothly and flawlessly. Second, it is super sharp and slices through tomatoes and onions flawlessly. I can honestly say this is one of the finest chef knives I have ever used and I highly recommend this knife for anyone who loves to prepare and cook. This also makes a great gift with it's attractive packaging and would be a wonderful, thoughtful, shower, wedding or homeowner present for the person you love!

Great tree skirt, inconvenient way to light. I need to start by saying I really am impressed with this skirt.  It is large and a beautiful red plaid color. I kind of like the faux fur (might be a tad gawdy). This is really well made and a quality item. I deducted one star because of the lights and the way they did the battery. I actually turn my lights on my tree remotely now, however with this skirt, I need to bend down, find the switch and turn it on and off. Anyway, I will only be lighting it on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day as it is too difficult to put the lights on the skirt. They really should have thought that through.

Great stockpot, perfect for everyone!. This is a great stockpot for the money. First, it is super attractive, well made and lightweight. I love this color, too, it blends with all my kitchen decor. I love Rachel Ray products as they always provide good products at reasonable prices. This 6 quart size is great for making pasta and soups. This would make an excellent bridal shower or housewarming present for anyone. Highly recommend!

Best hand-held mixer on the market today!. This is a great hand mixer. I actually have only used mixers before for cake batters and whipping cream purposes. But with this B&D Performance Premium hand mixer, I find I can do much more. I used it most recently with making cookie dough for Christmas. I was amazed how easily this is to use and how well everything mixed. This fits well in my hand and I can control it well. The red color matches my other kitchen accessories so it looks great. This would make a great holiday gift or a wonderful bridal shower or house warming gift for someone you love. Modern, stylish and full functional for all your mixing needs.

NIce, attractive pillow covers for your home. These are relatively inexpensive velour pillow covers. I use the on my white leather couch to add a pop of color to my family room. Soft and well made, the blue color is beautiful and vibrant. Normally, velour is not my go to fabric choice (reminds me of the 1970s) but these are pretty and will add a great dimension to your home.

Great space heater and overall circulating fan!. This is a really good room space heater and fan. I live in Florida and used it for a few weeks back at the end of April and now I am using for strictly room circulation/fan in my bedroom. With the constant storms we have down here in the late afternoons and evenings, the light whirring noise the fan makes helps to 'white noise' hide some of the thunderboomers too throughout the night (allowing me to sleep better). I really like this as my bedroom (which is 14x18 in size) gets full coverage from this unit. I highly recommend if you need a space heater or even just a fan for your room.

Nice old school style clock, alarm and radio. If you are in the market for an alarm clock, this Pingko is the way to go. I love the fact that I can have the display dim during the overnight hours so that it will not disrupt my sleep. This clock is visible from anywhere in the room and certainly makes seeing the time an easy thing to do. In this day and age where everyone is using their smart phones to alarm and tell time, this is so much easier (and old school) so you don't need to pick up anything to see the time. This would be great for traveling and I will take it on my upcoming cruise in August.

Wonderful way to enjoy your meals on the go!. Such a unique product! I typically bring lunch with me to work instead of buying it. Many times I have left overs (like yesterday I brought some meatloaf with me), but the sandwiches are cold by the time I get to eat them. Now with this little handy device I can plug in the bag about an hour before lunch and, presto, my lunch is warm and tasting fresh. I have already bought one for my son (who also brings his lunch/dinner with him on occasion) and will most likely give one as a gift this Christmas for a dear friend of mine up north. This is the kind of thing that would make a great gift for the person who has everything. Unique, classy and works!

Beautiful blue soft fleece blanket. Super soft fleece blanket. I fold it and keep it over my family room couch and use it to drape it over myself when I am feeling cold. It is soft and pill free and is so comfortable. It looks super attractive, too, with a vibrant blue color. Of course, others may want to use this as a bed blanket, but as my bed is king size, this is far better used as an oversized throw. I absolutely love this.

Great way to keep your silverware and utensils organized and available!. I live in a new subdivision in Florida where the neighbors get together all the time. Twice I have hosted events in my home and had to put my silverware out on a countertop. Not a great organized way to display the forks and knives and it actually took up a lot of unnecessary countertop space. When I saw this I wanted to see how it would work. Last weekend I used it for the first time and it was a huge success. First, it is attractive and blends easily with my brushed nickel sink and stainless steel appliances. Second, it is compact and takes up less space. And last, it has compartments for the various types of utensils (and keeps everything organized). I am thrilled to be using this and will continue to keep it in my kitchen pantry for future parties and events!

Absolutely perfect - Great device!. I love this Cuisipro Free Fat Separator! It is attractive, quality made and super easy to use. I read some of the other 5 star reviews and there is not much else I can add. I love to cook and I am always looking for new kitchen gadgets to make me perform like the professional chef I long to be, lol. I think this would make an excellent gift for a new bride or homeowner as it is a tool that often people do not think of giving (as an alternative to other kitchen gifts). Kudos to Cuisipro!

Great way to store your winter and not so often used things. I moved from NJ to FL about 3 years ago. Fan works great, cools me in the Florida heat. This is a nice little handheld fan. I live in Florida where it is hot 9 months of the year and I honestly needed this. Outside of that, great little tool to keep in your car or bag to use when you need it. I assume it will come in handy as well when the next hurricane strikes (yike) and I lose power.

Nice quality towels for your bath. I really liked this towel set. Well made, soft, absorbent, these towels are great. If there was anything to deduct a star for, it's for the 8 piece set.
