Beautiful real looking roses for your home!. These are much nicer than I was expecting. Beautiful white flowers, rich green leaves, quality made, they fit perfectly in my 12" vase. I have received many compliments on them since I start displaying them. Highly recommend!

Great, powerful portable battery operated fan. This is a great rechargeable fan to keep for emergency uses or even to take if you are not anywhere near electricity. I live in Florida and with frequent lightning, I have had several occasions when I was without electricity. When I saw this fan I couldn't wait to try it. I also like this for use when we are out on my lanai in the heat to have the fan on helps with circulation and definitely brings the heat levels down. Highly recommend!

Hours of fun!. I got these for my grandchildren for when they visited me in Central Florida this past July. What fun! Highly recommend for good fun (without the damage).

Good quality, reasonably priced desk/table. This Decoholic computer desk is surprisingly nice for the money. Super functional, nice size, it can be used as a desk or even as just a place to showcase items in your home. Another great Crock Pot product!!!. This is one of the best slow cookers around. Love the programmable (not just high-low) setting capability, love the size (perfect for when I am making a meal for four people), easy to clean and very attractive for the countertop. You can't go wrong with this purchase.

Great sheets, fits perfect and is super soft!. This is a really nice deep pocketed sheet set. I got a queen size and it fits my bed perfectly. I have washed this set twice since I have received it and the gray color is still vibrant and the sheets are virtually wrinkle free. These sheets are super soft and luxurious and I have already purchased a set for my son and daughter in law because I was so impressed. Spoil yourself (at a reasonable price) and buy a premium set of sheets for an optimal night's sleep. Highly recommend!

Great cast iron skillet, perfect for a single cook to use!. This is the first time I have ever used a cast iron stove top skillet and I have to say I am quite impressed. However, if I was looking to make pancakes for my grandkids, this would never be able to pass the test only cooking about 2-3 pancakes at a time. I am going to look for a larger version to keep around for weekend family meals.

A must have for every kitchen!. This is just what I was looking for for my kitchen. It is a nice size and clings nicely to my quartz countertop. I can wash loads of dishes and place them to drain on this mat. Water rolls off easily and dishes dry quickly. When I am entertaining I simply roll up the mat and store it. Highly recommend, especially the grey color as it seems to blend with most kitchen decors.

A real easy way to take care of your plants when you are away. This is a great way to maintain my Florida lanai plants when I am away. I travel often (either for business, visiting family or just taking a cruise). I am so glad I found these so I no longer have to ask (beg) a neighbor to come over and water the plants when I am gone. I use a slow drip on my Christmas cactus plant and a faster drip on my pathos vines, it's nice being able to control the release. Now I have to figure out if I can use these when I go for three weeks in October to visit some friends, but even if they are only good for two weeks it's an amazing aid. Easy to set up, easy to use, highly recommend!

What great food storage containers! I love them!. I really love these! First they are relatively heavy (glass) and super durable. I love that I can make a meal, store it in the container, freeze it and then place it in the oven or microwave when I am ready to eat it.  These are dishwasher safe, seal perfectly and are now one of my most used items daily in my busy home. I highly recommend these to everyone who needs a quick easy way to store meals. Whether you want to use these strictly in your kitchen or carry them to work or school with meals these are perfect. Would also make a great gift during the holidays for the person in your life who has everything.

I'm in love with an electric wok!. Great electric wok! Nice size (5 quart) which is bigger than  many of the others out here. I love the way it heats up quickly and clean up is a total breeze with the non-stick surface. For many years I used to swear by my stove top wok (I have a gas range), but honestly never felt I was getting it clean (as you had to be careful not to mar the 'seasoned' pan. Now I exclusively use this wok and find it as good, if not better than the old traditional. This would make a great unique gift for the bride to be!

Great pot holders, durable and long lasting!. I love DII products. Usually very reasonably priced, the quality can't be beat. These pot holders are no exception. Well made, they stand up to heat easily to protect my hands from oven and bakeware. I have washed them once in my washing machine and they came out looking like they were new. I love this whole product line as the colors match flawlessly and make my kitchen look clean and fresh. These would make a great shower gift to give the new bride (or even home/apartment dweller) as a complete set for the kitchen. Can't go wrong, great price and quality!

Great seat covers!. I really like these. I have been using them every Sunday since I received them for when my son and his family come to visit. My current dining room set (less than a year old) has beige seat cushions which are an open invitation for my two grandsons to make a mess during meal time. I have been using these covers for their chairs and set up and clean up is a breeze. I just throw them in the washer to clean them after use. They also look great and I just ordered another set (since I have 6 seats) to use as a means to switch up my decorating from time to time. Really highly recommend them.

Wonderful humidifier, works great and I sleep much better now!. I have been using this Vick's humidifier almost nightly since I received it. Normally my bedroom, especially this time of the year is dry and cold and I wake up with a semi sore throat. Given that I also suffer from allergies. I rarely get a good night's sleep because my nasal passages also fill up overnight. Since I have been using this,  I awake refreshed and my throat is clear and not raw. I have not used this with Vicks Vaporub in the device yet, but I can definitely see where this will be my definitive go to when I catch my next cold. My room is 16X20 and I keep the device on my nightstand for optimal impact. Highly recommend.

Super fun and easy to set up and use!. This is a cute gadget for the person who has everything! Easy to add batteries and easy to use, this would make a great gift during the holidays. No more messing around with manual screwing bottle openers, this makes opening a wine bottle super easy. I have some fingers which are arthritic and this opener makes the chore a simple pleasure. I highly recommend this opener for everyone!

Not just for Christmas!. These are really nice, full size pillow covers. I put them on some existing throw pillows I had on my off white living room couch to change it up for Christmas. However, after having them on there for a couple of weeks now, I will probably keep them on long after the holidays. Solidly, quality made, great muted colors (not super bright red), they look great. I highly recommend these for all uses and all times of year.

Great compact iron for many uses!. Very nice compact iron and with the name Proctor Silex you know you are getting a quality item. It's been years (seriously) since I had used an iron and when I saw this I wanted to try it.This little iron packs a punch and steams and dewrinkles everything. I have been using this weekly on shirts to get them crisp looking and is also small enough to take on a trip to help with wrinkled packed clothes. This is a staple in my house now and I am not sure what I have done without it before.

This toaster oven does it all!. Really nice toaster oven. I had never heard of this brand before and since it had an air fryer option I was anxious to try it. This would make a great housewarming/bridal shower gift for someone or just as an option to replace an older unit you already own. Highly recommend!

Great small non-stick pan for muffins or candies. They call this a mini-muffin pan, but I think it is better for making candies (too small for muffins I like to make). Anyway, well made, beautiful color, easy to clean, this is a great cooking pan for any chef to have in their kitchen. A few of these in different sizes would make a great bridal shower gift to give to someone as unique gifts. Really loved this!

Well made, easy to clean, great for candy making!. This is a great pan for making small cookies or candies. I highly recommend this pan for you or the chef in your life. Keep in mind the size of the cookies/candies when selecting this pan.

Great, relatively light weight, versatile slow cooker!. Absolutely amazing slow cooker! This replaced a HB slow cooker I had for about 6 years. This model 33480 has all the bells and whistles the older model didn't have. Colorful way to show your American pride!. This was a great set to help decorate my golf cart for the local 4th of July golf cart parade. Lots of colorful patriotic items which actually are pretty well made. This is perfect for my cart, the little flags look great along the sides. The lanterns are really cute too.

Great looking and functional lunch cooler/bag. Great bag to take to school or the office. Nice size with compartments. Fashionable (I got the red color) and fits easily under my desk. Great quality lunch bag for all ages!. Super cute and colorful, this is a great insulated lunch bag. Just what I was looking for!. I have been looking for a new paring knife for some time now. When I saw this, I had never heard of the KBK brand so I wasn't sure what to expect. Great closet organized, well made, looks great and works!. This was a god-send to me. I have a new home with a standard closet and I had pocketbooks and shoes all around with no place to store them. Nice attractive utensil holder. This is an attractive utensil holder, beautiful blue color it matches my decor perfectly. But, it is really nice and definitely adds to the look of my kitchen.

Nice quality heat resistant tongs, work perfectly!. These are great heat resistant tongs. I have been using them on my grill and just this past weekend used them to flip some ribs and chicken. Great stainless steel flask. This is a really nicely made flask. Silver color, doesn't tarnish (I have put it through the dishwasher twice already). Holds liquids well, no leaks. If you are in the market for a quality made flask at a very reasonable price this is a great choice to make. Highly recommend!

Great vacuum sealer, easy to use and saves food. This is a great vacuum sealer machine. I use it every time I grocery shop at Sam's Club and buy a package of steaks, chops and or chicken. I seal portion sizes easily and flawlessly and am able to freeze foods without getting freezer burn on the meats. This was much easier to use than I thought it would be and if I can use this, anyone can. Great way, especially for single homeowners like myself to make meals and portions easily (also helps with keeping my caloric intake under control). Highly recommend to all.

Great all use spatula. This is a really nice, reasonably priced, spatula. Well made and very heat resistant. I have used it in my kitchen with my frying and crepe pans and I have also used it for turning hamburgers on the grill with no problem or 'melting' of the rubber. It is a nice size as well, easy to store and washes well in the dish washer. Highly recommend.

Nice holiday pillow covers for my home!. These are cute pillow covers for the holidays. They are a darker blue, matches my decor perfectly and definitely helps add to the spirit of the holidays in my home. Not the softest of material, but they fit a standard pillow perfectly and zip up easily. Quality made, too. Highly recommend.

Great way to get holiday spirit!. This is a super cute way to decorate for the holidays. Nice shag bathroom rug!. I really like this Ouka bath mat. It is soft and plush and I love the old school shag feel to it. The blue color is a deep color and blends perfectly in my guest bath. Nice inexpensive rug for a great look and feel.

Great storage and attractive too!. These are beautiful storage containers. I have them on my kitchen counter and I keep spaghetti, rigatoni, coffee and sugar in them. You could also use these and fill with colorful pebbles or candies to add color to any decor, so I have already ordered another set to sit out on a shelf in my living room. I highly recommend these.

Great little grinder. I had never tried grinding my own coffee before and usually buy my coffee already processed. When this came across on Vine I decided I would try it. I am so hooked now, you couldn't get me back to packaged coffee again. What a difference for me to be drinking freshly ground coffee and I just love it. The Bodum Bistro Electric Burr Coffee Grinder is easy to use and I found it relatively quiet (in spite of other reviews on here). The coffee is ground evenly and smoothly and the aroma from the ground beans is amazing. I love this grinder!

Great smaller size bakeware, perfect for quiches. I love Chefmade products and have a lot of their baking dishes in my kitchen. This 7 inch tart pan is great. Well made, sturdy and easy to use, I can make a quiche or a small cheesecake easy with the removable bottom. Really nice looking to, it would make a great extra gift for a bridal shower (a size and type of kitchen accessory that may not be typical but truly will be one of the most used items in their kitchen). Really nice, highly recommend.

Nice way to store toys and other items around your house. Great, nice-sized (13.75x13.75x17) storage. I am using it in my home to hold my grandchildren's toys when they aren't visiting. I would have preferred a sturdier unit that could still collapse but have more support when open.

Great colorful decorations that are easy to put up and take off. These are super cute St. Patrick's Day window decorations. Every kitchen should own one of these!. This is a great little device. Makes cutting and serving pizza a breeze. Sometimes pizza cutting can be tricky but this tool does it all. Great mattress protector!. This is a really nice queen mattress protector. I have larger/deeper mattresses and had no trouble with this fitting my bed. Really nice placemats!. These are super attractive placemats. I love the color (blue) as they match my kitchen decor perfectly. They wipe clean easily and I usually use an extra one to put my hotter serving dishes on. Highly recommend these if you are in the market for new placemats.

Great way for the little ones to get in the Easter spirit!. These are super cute Easter window decorations. Every chef needs one of these!. I have been using this as a dough cutter for about a month now. I love to bake and make my own crusts, so I like to make a lot at one time and freeze the extra. This pastry cutter is great. It fits well in my hand and maneuvers easily. Cuts and presses the dough flawlessly. Clean up is also a breeze. Highly recommend!

Where have you been all my life????. My household drinks quite a bit of wine and one of the chores we hate the most is opening the bottle. I had never tried an electric opener before. I will never go back to manually opening a wine bottle again (of course unless it is a screw cap, lol). Highly recommend to all. Sometimes old school is better!. I used to use can openers like this back in the day and eventually started using electric ones. Great larger toaster oven, meets all my needs. I love this new toaster oven. Replacing a french door model that I had (not Hamilton Beach) this stove really gives me what I needed. I love the digital display and the stainless steel finish matches all my kitchen appliances. I couldn't be happier.

Great gadget! Don't know how I lived without it before!. Wow, what a clever idea! I always am making kabobs here in Florida, most of the time chicken but occasionally beef. There is nothing worse than taking the kabobs off the grill and bringing them into the kitchen and trying to remove the meat and vegetables from the skewers. But if I am able to get a grip with a potholder and try to remove the food using a fork, I usually end up with broken pieces of food and some chicken/beef that will stay on the skewers in strings. When I saw these I was skeptical, but having used these once I can tell you that they are the neatest thing ever. Sliding down the skewer, all meat and vegetables are removed (in tact) and none of the food remained on the skewer. I am honestly surprised no one had this idea before. I think this would make a great supplemental bridal gift to give the bride who has everything! It is practical, functional, and bears the quality Cuisinart name. You cannot go wrong!

Every kitchen should own one!. First, I really like Maison Huis kitchen products and own several of their devices. This garlic press is incredible and an excellent time and mess saver. This hand tool cuts the time by 75%+ and makes peeling and crushing/cutting garlic a breeze. Clean up is a breeze and I just pop it into the dishwasher and it comes out looking like new. This would make an excellent add on present for a bridal shower or home warming gift.

Great for all your food storage needs!. These are really nice quality food storage containers. There are a variety of shapes and sizes which makes it nice for all your storage needs. This would make a great housewarming or bridal shower gift.

An ok garland, lights are pretty, battery compartment difficult to open. This is a perfect sized garland for what I needed it for (on my credenza under my television). Great set with everything you need!. This is a slick bartender set at a great price. I was looking for something to use in my new bar area and this certainly fits the bill. Where have you been all my life?. I typically, when icing a cake, have used a basic knife. Really a smart choice for any bath!. This is a great toilet brush and holder set. It works well, helps keep my master bath sparkling clean. It also looks super attractive in the toilet area with its sleek modern design. Highly recommend!

Well made and festive!. This is a great decorating package of Oktoberfest decorations. I cannot wait to put it out next month during my family Oktoberfest party planned for mid-month. Every home should always keep one set on hand for unexpected guests!. This is a great party set. It has everything you need with cups, napkins and plates for a small get together or party. Makes a great present for someone or just for yourself!. I had never heard of Lieve chocolate before and was a little hesitant to try this. Absolutely love my new Vornado. I have two cats and have resisted getting standard floor fans because of their inane curiosity with all things that move quickly. Amazing quality mattress at a reasonable price!. This is a great high quality mattress for the price. I rated it as only 4 out of 5 stars for several reasons. First is the way it is packed. I understand that unlike a brick and mortar store that will deliver mattresses to your home, this has to come standard shipping (this came UPS), however the mattress is rolled tightly to fit in a box that is very HEAVY and I needed assistance from the neighbors just to get it inside my door (over 100 lbs). Secondly, it is rolled in a reverse way that I would pack it (makes it awkward when trying to maneuver it onto a frame). Thirdly, there is a smell to it, but I use an air cleaner in the room so that seemed to clear up once I covered it with a mattress cover and my sheets. On the plus side, surprisingly when unrolled it flattens out to a soft, but firm, mattress and I can say it is almost as good as a mattress I paid three times as much for (Icomfort). If I had known I could have gotten a mattress from Amazon of this quality, I would have saved the money and definitely had bought this one earlier. Alas, it is in my guest bedroom now, but I did sleep on this last night and had one of my best night's sleep to date. I highly recommend this mattress to all!

Great knife for the money!. This is a really nice knife. Quality made, for the money you can't go wrong. Cuts through vegetables easily and flawlessly. This knife also fits well in my hand and makes cooking prep a breeze. This knife also comes in a nice box so it would be perfect for gift giving (think bridal shower or housewarming present). I highly recommend this Konoll knife to every household!

Nice quality comforter, works in both warm and cooler climates. Well made down comforter, perfect for any kind of weather. I did deduct a star as it didn't seem as big as it should for a queen, I found the width of it to be a tad short on my bed (so I needed to pull it to one side a bit more so you couldn't see the mattress when entering the bedroom). Other than that, it's a nice quality comforter.

Excellent stock pot!. This is my new favorite stockpot. Non-stick, heats evenly (I have a gas stove) and after using and washing at least 1/2 a dozen times, the pot still looks like new. If I had any complaint, it would be I wish I had gotten this in a larger size (not big enough for large portions), but that is my problem as I didn't realize how big 4 quarts is. Highly recommend to all chefs and would make a great shower/housewarming gift.

Nice non-stick whisk for every kitchen!. I really, really like this whisk. Super light in my hands, it makes mixing a breeze. A great chef's knife for the money!. I love to cook and I own a large variety of knives in my kitchen. I wasn't sure what to expect for this price, but I honestly was pleasantly surprised. Best Espresso machine on the market today!. I love, love, love this Espresso maker! Let me start by saying I have been making espresso for 20+ years now. Having grown up in an all Italian neighborhood in NY, and having vacationed in Italy 5 times now, this 100% Irish girl loves her Italian coffee. The best thing about this Dedica is the size, takes up so little counter space. But don't let the size fool you. It is an amazing device, able to make the best blends. I especially love the cappuccino this makes. It's easy to use, extremely attractive and makes some of the best espresso and cappuccino I have ever had (including the brews I had in Italy). You couldn't ask for a better espresso machine and you can rely on the De'Longhi name for quality and durability. This would make a wonderful/thoughtful wedding/shower gift for homemakers, too!

Great large oven!. I absolutely love this oven. To give you some background, I moved to my new home in Florida last year. With limited resources, I replaced many of the outdated appliances. The one thing I didn't replace was the range/oven. It was a nice gas/electric combo and appeared to be in good shape. Anyway, after using it for about 6 months, I woke up to find the range top working fine (burners) but the inside oven broken. I had to repair guys out here told me it would cost close to $1000 to fix (something to do with needing a mother board). Anyway, long story short, I had been depending on my medium size toaster oven to take the place of the large oven until I can try to replace it. I find it too small for larger things (think an oven roaster chicken). When I saw this Oster, and it was less than $100 (Amazon Warehouse deal), I jumped on it. It is beautiful (stainless steel blends well with my other kitchen appliances), the digital display is clear, large and makes it appear very modern. The size is great, I can fit a chicken in here with no trouble. I will most likely still need to replace my oven (think Thanksgiving), but this will get me through the next 7 months until such time as I can save up for the real thing.

Another great Reynolds' product. Kudos!!!. As I have said in other reviews, I absolutely love Reynolds products. They always have the chef in mind for easing cooking and clean up needs. I used these for pork chops last night and filled the bag with onions and seasoning, popped it into the oven for 50 minutes and, yum, cooked to perfection. Deep tissue massage, easy to use!. This is one of the bests massage guns I have ever used. I know the Circulon name usually generates thoughts of costly cookware, especially for a new bride/cook. But you get what you pay for with Circulon and it is absolutely the best money can buy!
