There is a minor assembly to do, the glass front doors need to be attached, the bottom screen tray and the kettle.  It came with a non-slotted aluminum scoop (I traded for one with holes for the kernals to fall through that I already had) a pinch of fairly large popcorn bags (NOT flat bottomed, so you can't fill them and stand them up - I bought some small, flat bottomed bags) some unmarked scoops and measuring spoons. NO sample packets of popcorn were included.  I purchased some 8 oz Great Northern Popcorn premixed bags to try. The directions for use that came with the machine and the on premixed popcorn bags was different and ultimately I used the directions that came with the machine.  After using it, I think either way would have worked fine.  Basically, heat the oil and kettle up first, then add the popcorn and salt works best.  It made plenty for 4 of us to eat full (small) bags of popcorn with a couple of refills. There were a lot of unpopped kernals, but I think I may not have heated the oil long enough. The 8 oz kit was done within about 3 minutes. The popcorn was very tasty... but maybe a little tough. I am going to experiment with my own popcorn and oil to see if this is different.  I estimate for our family gatherings I will need to pop 3 or 4  8 oz popcorn kits. I also plan to try using coconut oil that doesn't have all the yellow dye in it. Further, I purchased a set of 12 different popcorn seasonings for fun. Just sprinkle in the bags after loading them, not in the machine. I was dreading the cleanup, but honestly, it really wasn't bad at all.  I do recommend wiping out after each use to avoid harder to clean build up.  All in all, I am very happy with this suprisingly well made machine. It's glass and metal with some plastic and is fairly heavy.  There is a manufacture date on the base of the machine that says April 2014.  I will quickly update my review if we have any issues.

Seal the lid top and place in boiling water pan (water below the lip of the coddler).  Cook per your desired temperature.  Around 10 minutes if you prefer a hard cooked egg - or around 5 if you like a more loose yolk - even less if you like a very runny yolk..  Scoop out with a small spoon or dip with toast sticks.  It's a real treat.  These coddlers are very nice because they are clear glass and  go right into the dishwasher. The metal clasps securely hold the lid on which is very important (you don't want water in the coddle) - and are easy to remove with a towel (they will be hot when they come out of the boiling water).  The only negative I will report is that the add clearly states it is a set of two.  I only got one.  Had a "replacement" order placed and again only got one. I ALMOST gave this 4 stars instead of 5 because there is no solution for stud earrings. The designers thought of everything else but a tray that could hold miscellaneous baubles & earrings with posts. My solution to this was that I hung a small jewelry pouch from the valet and stored those earrings inside the pouch. It means I have to go rooting through the bag a lot, but really this jewelry valet is just perfect for storing everything else and it looks so cute on the wall. Since I really love it I decided to give it 5 stars, since it does exactly what it's advertised to do. My friends always compliment it and it's helped to keep me MUCH more organized. So far, I love the Wowgo cordless vacuum.. I have a very good canister vacuum for "cleaning day" and just wanted something easier/lighter to take around the apartment for quicker/easier vacuuming without dragging the canister and wire around. I checked out reviews of quite a few stick vacuums before this purchase. I couldn't believe how expensive some of them are. I mentioned to my sister that I was looking for a stick vacuum and she told me she just got one on Amazon, had only used it a couple of times and couldn't say much about it other than it was quiet, good suction, light weight and only $99. She got it because several ladies in her apt. building had one and were happy with it.

I decided to take a chance and ordered one for myself. It came in a day, in good shape. It was easy enough to put together. It's lightweight, pretty quiet and easy to empty. The head swivels and gets into corners. I don't think it would last long with an aggressive house cleaner. The swivel head might not be strong enough to be slammed into walls or corners. I haven't yet used the other tools it came with, yet. The suction is very good and I used it mostly on the low setting, but I don't have pets or children and my floors are laminate or have low pile carpeting so I can't say how it would be on thick carpets, etc. The high power just shortens the battery life. I was happy that the suction was strong enough to pick up crumbs, etc. and didn't just fling bits out the other side. The battery lasted about 30-40 minutes, enough to do my whole apartment with good suction. It takes about 4 hrs to charge the battery, so I wanted to purchase an extra battery to have charged and on hand. It's $33...a third of the vacuum cost...Wow!

I haven't used it enough to comment on the quality (how long it lasts, parts break, or suction weakens) but so far, I'm very happy with the vacuum. It serves its purpose well. If need be, down the line, I'll add to or change this review.

This chair is a BEAST!. Upon opening the box, we were impressed with the fortitude of each part - it is very weighted and similar to chrome (at least in finish and heaviness). This is much akin to a Chevy Bel Air vs modern cars as far as comparing it to previous desk chairs which I have owned, it is clearly built to last and sustain a lot of weight and use.

I left the assembly to my partner, who said that other than the heaviness of the parts when wrangling them, was incredibly easy. The instructions do suggest that you make use of the box it arrived in to help prop parts as you screw them together because you will need the support, and he did this and said it made it much more manageable.

I walked into the room once it was finished and gaped at how large this chair is. In fact, I felt like a child climbing into the seat, my legs left to dangle and I kept scooting back further and further (You can lower it with the pneumatic lift so that your feet touch the ground, it also has nice rounding of the seat front to prevent your back of knee circulation from being cut off!). The seat is HUGE both front to back and side to side and can comfortably accommodate larger bodies. I never had so much room in desk chair seat before! But the solidity of this chair is what has me in awe - I feel safe and comfortable in it. No teetering, no awkward tilting, nothing bad! The only plastic parts to the structure of the chair is the pneumatic lift handle and the wheels (which seem more like high impact plastic and dense), so no fear of parts breaking under weight strain and movement.

I would say that the only downside to this chair is now my partner is jealous of it and we're going to have to get him one of his own so he that doesn't pilfer mine. Excellent desk chair, an easy 5 stars

Sturdy. I've been reorganizing my pantry. These clear storage bins make things easier to access as well as making it look nice. The bins are durable and sturdy. I like the variety of sizes.

Great for Moving!. We've been using these bags to move my daughter back and forth from college. They're durable and strong. The handles make it easy to carry. These bags even have a little vinyl window so you can label your items. When my daughter gets moved back in at college, she can store these bags under the bed which takes up much less space than plastic tubs.

Spice Labels. This is my 2nd set of spice labels that I have ordered recently. These are better than the last, but they're still not perfect. What I like better about these is that the placement of the spice name is on the top of the label. That makes it easier to see them when they're in elevated rows. So that's really good! The thing that would make these even better is to have more types of spices. For example, in my kitchen, I have rubbed sage and sage leaves. There is only 1 sage label. Of course I could use a blank one, but then they wouldn't all be uniform. There are a few other spices like that where I have more than one type of the same but they're in different formats. Now some of the labels did differentiate between types, but not all of them did. And the ones that I do have in different formats are not weird ones. They're pretty common. The quality of these labels is good. The adhesion is adequate. I was able to quickly remove them to straighten them up as I was putting them on the jars. Overall, I am happy with these.

Vibrant. This hall way rug is a vibrant red carpet. It looks just like the photos. When it arrived, it was folded in half. I've had this in my hallway for over a week now. The middle where it was folded has a line where the fibers of the rug were spread out in the folding. It's slowly fixing itself, but it's still a bit noticeable. The quality of the rug is satisfactory. I am pleased with how it looks in my entry way!

Calming Activity. This mini Zen garden is a nice & calming activity. It comes with everything you need to create your own little Zen garden. The garden tools feel a little cheap, but they do the job. I have been having fun with this.

Soft!. My daughter has a part time roommate who is allergic to cats. She recently got 2 kittens. She's taking measures to help keep the apartment better for the roommate. She keeps his room shut all the time. There are hardwoods throughout. She is using an air purifier and now she has a cover to keep on the couch when he's around. It can be washed between the roommates stays or as needed. It's nice looking and very soft. It fits the couch pretty well. She's hoping it works for the roommate!

Works With Cotton Rounds. I was intrigued with this automatic cotton pad dispenser when I first saw it. I have been keeping my cotton rounds in an acrylic tube like container, but I often will pull half of a cotton round instead of the full one. I wasn't entirely positive that this would work with the round shape, but it does! The first time or two that I pressed the button to get a cotton round, it gave me two instead of one. But after that, it dispenses only one at a time. It's very sanitary. It's also a little fun to use!

Super Cute!. These fall beverage decorative pieces are super cute! I can't wait to put them in my fall themed tiered tray! They are a little smaller than a real coffee beverage you would get at SB, which makes it a good size for the trays. The faux foam is soft but solid. The cups are decorated differently so you could definitely use both of them on the same tray. I have ordered similar ones for different themes for a much higher price, so getting a pair of them is a deal!

Sturdy!. My daughter has a queen size platform bed. She recently moved into a shared apartment and has limited space. She wanted to raise her bed enough so she could store things underneath her bed. Her bed has 9 legs, so I ordered a second set. From what I can tell, the center one shouldn't be touching the floor, so that one doesn't have a riser. The corner legs as well as the other legs that are on the sides of the frame have one of these risers. She did put one of the extra pieces under the center one so it doesn't have as far to reach a surface since the bed has been raised, but it is not touching the center leg. The black color goes well with her aesthetics. I would recommend.

Attractive Wall Art. These are attractive wall art. The set can be used together or individually. They are printed on a sturdy material that feels heavier than paper, but thinner than canvas. I like these a lot!

It Meets My Expectations. This adjustable tension shower rod meets my expectations. It does what it is supposed to do. My daughter is using this to hold a light weight curtain across her door-less closet. It does the job!

Great!. My daughter is moving into a new place next week. She has been using these organizers and setting up her dresser drawers with them. She is very happy with how these are working. It is making organization very simple. She's nearly finished with the drawers. We will be wrapping the individual drawers with packing cellophane and they won't be transported in the dresser. So when she is setting up her new bedroom, the dresser will be ready in no time. She especially likes how her t-shirts look now that they're organized. She says its easy to find what she needs. Since there are dividers, removing one shirt doesn't affect the rest.

Beautiful!. This is a beautiful Georgia shaped cutting board. The detail is laser engraved. It has a hanging tie on it in case you want to use it as a wall decoration. It would really make a good gift!

Wonderful Towels!. I had low expectations for these microfiber towels. I've had several microfiber beach and bath towels over the years and they have been just okay. These towels are a bit more plush and thicker than what I have used in the past. Usually they are super thin and have a kind of weird feeling when you dry off with it. These are nothing like that. I am very impressed and very happy with them!

Beautiful Bakeware!. This is beautiful bakeware! My daughter is in college and moving into a new apartment this summer. She needs some basic kitchen stuff. She's not going to have a dishwasher, so the fact that these are hand wash only isn't an issue. The pieces are sturdy and feel tough enough for normal cooking and baking. They look great, too!

Holiday Decorating Made Easy. This bundle of Halloween themed decor makes holiday decorating easy! The items are a good quality, though the wood blocks look mass produced as opposed to hand painted. The pieces are a good start for decorating your tiered tray!

Gives New Life to an Old Bed!. This gel mattress topper gives new life to an old bed! It adds 3 inches to the height of the bed. It arrived compressed. I took it out of the packaging and let it expand for a few days. I didn't notice any bad chemical smells when I opened it, but by the time I checked on it a few days later, there was no smell at all. It's very comfortable.

Great Tumbler!. I am trying to drink more water. I like using pretty tumblers with straws. This one is bright and cheery. I like the texture it has. The cup is somewhat insulated. It keeps drinks with ice chilled for a while, more so than a regular plastic cup, but not as long as a stainless steel one. I think this is priced well, too.

Nicer Than Expected. This seasonal sign decor set is nicer than I expected. The pieces can be used with the larger one as there is a spot for it to go, or individually. Stands are included. They look very nice in person and don't have that mass produced look to them. I plan to use them with my tiered tray.  I am pleasantly surprised by these.

Perfect Size for My Tiered Tray. These patriotic pieces are the perfect size for my tiered tray! A lot of items end up being too tall, but these are just right! They are well painted and look great. I am very impressed with these.

Deluxe!. This is what I consider to be a deluxe towel. It's probably the nicest beach/pool towel I have ever had. It's very thick and plush. It has great absorbency. It looks high end and fancy! I love it!

Shorter Than I Anticipated. My daughter lives in an apartment at college. She took her bedroom furniture with her leaving behind a mostly empty room at home. I ordered this for that empty room. Though she lives elsewhere, she still comes home for holidays and occasional weekends. We've set this up to hold some of her basics such as underwear, socks, and tee shirts. When she comes home, she rarely brings much in the way of clothing with her because she still has a lot here. We just needed to organize it better. Assembly was okay. It could have been easier. I think the issues my husband had with it was (A) the print on the instructions was really small and difficult to read and (B) it was vague at times. It probably took him about 45 minutes to put it together by himself. It ended up being much shorter than I anticipated. It's about the size of a night stand. It's sturdy enough. It's not what we would call quality furniture, but it's fine for what we need. It would be well suited to someone just starting out.

Good Size. My daughter needed a desk chair for her new apartment. Most desk chairs are big and bulky. This one is a great size and doesn't overtake the room. She is very pleased with how it looks. She also finds it to be comfortable. Assembly was quick and easy.

Nice Variety of Decor. If you're new to tiered tray decorating, then this is a good set for you. It has a nice variety of items. The wooden blocks look mass produced, but they're not bad. Their paint job is just too perfect! I like that this comes with the garland, gnome, and beads, too. This is not enough to fill one full tray at my house. I try to make sure mine has items on all sides, not just the front. But it is a good start.

Great Assortment. These are nice, uniform labels. They make my spice cabinet look quite organized. There are a couple of things I would change if I could. The first being the placement of the spice name. I know it looks nice and centered where the name is, but I keep my spices on one of those "stair step" type racks in my cabinet. I cannot easily see the names of the spices on the 2nd and 3rd rows. My taller husband can see them much better. If the spice name was closer to the top of the label, it would be easier for me to see. Secondly, there are a couple of spices that could use 2 labels. For example, I have ground cumin and cumin seeds. There was only one cumin label. Same with cloves & sage - I have 2 different types but only one label. There were a few ones that had this covered already with 2 separate labels. Of course, I could use a blank one, but I am not crazy with how that would look next to the nicely printed ones.

Beautiful Chair!. This is a beautiful chair. I love how it doesn't look like most ugly desk chairs. My husband put it together for me. He said it wasn't really difficult, but there were a couple of parts that could have been better designed. But overall, he said it was a fine chair. The finished chair looks great! It's a firm seat, which I prefer. It keeps me sitting straight which I am happy with.

Fall Decor. This set of fall decor is the perfect size for tiered trays. The pieces are colorful and durable. They definitely look mass produced as opposed to hand painted because they are "too perfect". These are affordable pieces and a great way to add to your tiered tray items.

Great Storage!. My daughter recently moved out of her college apartment. She has a few weeks at home before she moves into her next apartment. When she moved out, she primarily used boxes and tubs. While everything is at home, we're transferring what we can out of the tubs and boxes and putting them into these bags. Of course, some things don't work well in these bags such as breakables or really heavy stuff, but they do work for many items. The advantage to using these is that she can unpack at her own pace and then fold the bags up and stick them under the bed or in the closet until she needs them again. With the tubs she has to empty them before we leave that day and send them home with us or bring them back on her next visit home. Her apartment is pretty small and she really doesn't have the space to store the tubs. These bags are very durable and sturdy. Plus with the handles, they are easier to carry than boxes or tubs.

Unique Measuring Spoons. These are unique measuring spoons. They feel sturdy. The designs are beautiful. I don't think I would be comfortable using them with wet ingredients such as oil, but for dry ones such as sugar or spices, they are fine. I will also only wash them in the sink and as needed. I would be afraid that they would get damaged if washed too frequently.
Easy to Put Together. This coat rack is very easy to put together. I love the hooks. They really do give the feeling of leaves! The unit is very stable and sturdy. I am very pleased with it.

Beautiful!. This is a beautiful serving board/cutting board. The artwork is really nice. I am hesitant to use it as a cutting board for fear of damaging it. Right now I am hanging it up in my kitchen. This would make a lovely gift!

Cute Fall Decorations!. These metal pumpkins are cute fall decorations! They are much nicer than I expected. There are some slight imperfections, but that's a part of the whole farmhouse decor thing. I'm not quite sure where I'm going to put them this fall, but right now they're on my mantel. I do like that they're not the typical fall colors. It's nice to have a change.

Works Well. My husband recently gave our coffee grinder to our daughter to use at college. He really hated to part with his because he uses it regularly. So I ordered this one to replace his. This one is actually a little better than the one he had. He doesn't use the grinder for coffee beans, he has a coffee burr for that. He uses his grinder for spices. He likes to make his own rubs for meat before he cooks them on the smoker. This one has a storage container for your ground up stuff. It also has different speeds for the grinding, too. It does what he needs it to do, so he is satisfied.

Basic But Just What We Needed!. My daughter is moving into a small duplex next month. She would love to have one of those cute coat racks with a bench but there's just not enough room. This coat rack is pretty basic, but it's just what we needed. It will allow her and her roommate a place to hang their coats and jackets, right by the door without taking up too much floor and wall space. The pieces are sturdy and heavy. We were a little worried it might be too light weight that it might tip over if not balanced, but now that we've put it together, we're not worried any more. Assembly was easy. It looks good.

Love These!. I love these Halloween decorations! They are super cute! They are some of the best mass produced wooden decorations that I have ever seen. They will work perfectly on my Halloween tiered tray. Each item comes with a stand. Some of the pieces have jute or fake straw which adds to the overall look. I am very happy with these and would strongly recommend them.

Easy to Use. Fireplace season is over, so we tried this out in the backyard fire pit. It was easy to use. There were no problems lighting it and getting it started. I didn't really notice any coffee scent to it, but it's possible I wasn't near enough to the fire. It seems pretty comparable to other starter logs.

Good Sizes!. We use storage space saver bags all the time. They're great for bedding! These are good, but not perfect. The sizes are good. The biggest ones are huge! The valves on the bags have to be turned/twisted in order to open them up so you can release the air. We didn't realize that at first, but the pictures on the packaging show that you need to do that. The pump and the valve don't have any threading to them, so the pump gets separated from the valve easily. We haven't been able to get the bags as flat as we have with other bags.

Sturdy. I have been dissatisfied with my laundry hamper. I saw this and thought it was promising. It is a nice laundry hamper. There are metal poles or sticks that you insert into a sleeve on the interior of the hamper. Those keep it upright and help with the sturdiness. The lid only attaches by Velcro, so I found it to be more of a hindrance than a selling point. As nice as it is, I found that it wasn't big enough for my needs. It would not hold a week's worth of clothes for my husband and me. Coincidentally, my 24 year old son asked me for a new hamper a day or two before this one arrived. He decided he wants 2 hampers so he can pre-sort his dirty clothes before doing his laundry. This is perfect for him since he's just one person.

Pleasant Scent. While this candle didn't smell as I expected, it does have a pleasant scent. It says it's a coffee scent but I don't really detect any coffee. It smells more like a men's cologne to me. The candle burns fine. It doesn't produce heavy smoke or soot, so far. I do find it to be a bit expensive for the size, but it is a premium brand in my opinion.

Cute Theme. I love decorating my tiered tray for the different seasons and months. This is a cute, summer theme. There's a nice variety of decor items in this set. While they are mass produced, they don't "scream" mass produced. There were a couple of items that had flaws such as smeared ink or streaks. I included a picture of one. But in all honesty, I am not unsatisfied with that and I think it makes it look more realistic and natural.

Nice Looking Pumpkins. I have always gone all out when it comes to decorating for holidays and seasons. I saw these pumpkins and have to get them. They are a good size - actually a little larger than I anticipated. They're too large for my tiered tray, but great for the mantel or end table. I really like the burlap on the front. The texture of the burlap adds to the aesthetics.

Excellent Quality. I have several tiered trays in my house. I love decorating with them. I was drawn to this one because of the interesting octagon shape. There are 3 tiers. They have a slight edge which keeps things from falling off. It was easy to put together. The quality is excellent!

Novelty Candle. This fruit loop candle is definitely a novelty candle. As a candle, it's cute. The quality is okay. The description says it's vanilla scented, which I concur. I was really hoping for a fruit loop scented one.

Cute Assortment. These neoprene cup sleeves are great! I think they're cute and practical. They keep your cups from sweating. They also keep your hands protected from chilly drinks. The small one is the one that works with the Starbucks Grande size. I'm glad I read that on the product description. Otherwise the sizes are as expected.

Nice Glass. This is a very nice glass. The etched map of Atlanta looks really cool, especially when the glass is filled with a liquid that's not clear. It's a good quality glass and would make a great gift!

Nice Thanksgiving/Fall Decor. This is a nice set of Thanksgiving/Fall decor. It's a good size for my tiered tray. The wood blocks look mass produced (a little too perfect), but they're still fine. I like that this comes with some other items such as the beads, gnome, & leaves.

Great for Entertaining. This 2 level serving tray is great for entertaining. Especially when you have limited table space. It requires some assembly. It also is designed to be taken apart easily for storage. It's sturdy, but could definitely be sturdier. I think it would be more durable if it was not meant to be taken apart for storage. It looks great! I'm excited to use it this holiday season.

Cute Grinch Theme. This is a cute Grinch themed set of decor for tiered trays. I plan to do 2 trays this holiday season. One will be Grinch themed and the other will be a more traditional Christmas theme. The variety of pieces are good. They do have a mass produced quality to them - they're just a little too perfect and flat. The Grinch gnome is my favorite! I only need to add a few more items for my tray!

Would Make a Nice Gift. This Vera Bradley recipe card holder and cards would make a nice gift. The stand is wooden and seems durable. The painted flowers on the stand look a little too mass produced, but it's okay. The cards are sturdy and quite pretty.

Nice Quality. I have ordered several different sets of decor for tiered trays. I like changing my tray to match the season or holiday. These are some of the better ones that I have ordered online. First, there's a good variety of pieces. Some sets I've seen are all wooden blocks. This includes a gnome, beads, and a furry spider in addition to the wooden blocks. Second, while the wooden blocks are most likely mass produced, they look better than some of the other mass produced blocks I've seen. I've got a few that have a shiny and flat surface. It almost looks like a sticker was slapped on. These blocks look better than those. This is a good value and a great start for your Halloween tiered tray!

Cute!. I'm on my way to being a crazy cat lady, so why not put a cat towel in my bathroom! This towel is really cute. I have it hanging on a towel ring in my guest bath. It's kind of thin, but it seems to dry quickly and absorb well. There are snaps so you can put the cat's paws around the rack to secure it and keep it from falling.
Nice. These wooden utensils are very nice. I love the colorful designs on them. They are an excellent quality and perform well. I have been hand washing them and they are holding up well.

Luxurious!. These sheets are amazing! They are so luxurious. These have to be my favorite sheets ever! After a few nights of sleeping with these sheets, I've ordered another set! They are so soft. They have a slightly slick feeling, but not slippery like satin or silk. They seem to retain less body heat than cotton sheets. I would not call them cooling sheets, but they are cooler than a lot of sheets. I have a sleep number bed with a padded topper. These easily fit over the sheets. They haven't popped off the bed yet either which is pretty impressive. The sheets I was using prior to this set, had to be repositioned almost daily. I highly recommend these!

Great Bed Sheets!. I love these bed sheets! In fact, I love them so much, I have ordered 2 sets! I am getting rid of all other sheet sets so I only have these sets. The color is a light, sage green. They are slick feeling, but not slippery. I love the feeling of them. It makes me happy when I slide into bed each night because it feels so soft! I highly recommend them.

Fits Well. My daughter is away at college. She's living in an apartment with a roommate. Somehow, the apartment has fleas. They don't have any pets. They've done a flea bomb, but they're still finding fleas. I ordered this for her to put around her box spring in case they're hiding in there. It fits well. It's not noisy. We're hoping this does the job and helps control the flea population.

Easy to Use. These ice ball molds are so much easier to use than the silicone ones that came out a few years ago. It was so tricky to fill those older ones without getting water everywhere! I love the design of these molds! My husband likes adding a large single ice ball to his bourbon. These make very nice ice balls!

Light Weight. These are cute, light weight Thanksgiving themed gnomes. The body of the gnomes is a plastic jar which could be filled with fall colored items (candy!!). The details are good. They look nice with my holiday decor.

Fall Gnome. This fall gnome is pretty cute. He's a little larger than I expected and will make a good addition to my fall theme decor. The pumpkin that he sits on is weighted so he won't tip over too easily. The quality is decent. I didn't notice any problems with his construction.

Halloween Decorating!. I ordered these specifically for my tiered tray. I thought it would be a fun way to add some new and creative decorations to them. This comes with everything needed to make the potion bottles, except for the potions. I don't mind making my own, but I do wish there had been some suggestions. I know I can do water and food coloring, but what are some other good ideas? I will definitely have to look that up. The quality of the items is good. I love the labels. The artwork on them is very creative!

Good Looking Silverware. My daughter just moved into a new apartment. Last year she lived with 3 other roommates and they had communal silverware. She thought she had a few random pieces, but after being in the new place for a week, she asked me if I could find her a full set. She was very pleased with this one. The quality is very good. She loves the modern design on them. It's kind of like a hammered metal look. This is a full set and includes 8 place settings of 5 - soup spoon, regular spoon, table knife, salad fork, dinner fork. Each setting came individually packaged in a fabric drawstring bag. She plans to use them for when she has to take her lunch with her and needs silverware.

Huge!. My adult son just graduated from college and lives in our basement. He's a big guy and has been using a beach towel to dry off after his showers. I asked him why he kept taking my nice beach towel and he said it was because his bath towels were big enough to wrap around his body. I had been missing my beach towel when I went out to our hot tub, so I had to reclaim it. But I couldn't do so without replacing it for him. This sheet size bath towel is huge! It fits around his body without any problems. It's pretty thick and plush, but could be both thicker and plusher. I washed it before giving it to him and it got lint on all the rest of the towels, but I'm hoping it got most of it and won't be a problem moving forward. So far, he likes his new towel and I have my beach towel back!

Great Hangers!. A few months ago, I started replacing all of my plastic hangers with slim velvet ones. These are comparable to others that I have ordered. They take up less space in the closet. Clothes stay on the hangers and don't slide off easily. There's no visible branding on these to identify them as Kenneth Cole Reaction.

Love the Floral Print. This is a pretty plate. I love the floral print. The plate is pretty sturdy. It's made from melamine so I expect it to hold up well. It's a salad plate, so it's not full size. I have been using it for lunch. It definitely dress up the meal a bit!

Cute Cups!. These are decent plastic cups. They are fairly sturdy. The decoration is pretty. I don't think they're super high quality, but they are affordable. I have been using them outside and they are ideal for that. I like seeing new items in the Vera Bradley product line.

Makes a Nice Gift. This Vera Bradley set would make a nice gift. The items come in a cute satin drawstring bag. The set includes a pillow case, eye mask, and hair scrunchy. My favorite item is the pillow case. I'm using it in my bed. I like that it has an envelope style closure so my pillow isn't slowly sneaking out of the case! It's very soft and silky. The scrunchy isn't big enough for my thick hair. The eye mask is pretty thin, but it's decent. I have to use ones that are molded so they're not laying directly on my eyes. I was using flat ones every night for a while and I noticed my eyelashes were starting to grow sideways a bit. I stopped that right away! The items have a lovely pattern. The quality is pretty good, too.

Cute Coasters. These are cute coasters. They're fabric and absorb moisture well. I have been hesitant to use them on wood surfaces because they don't have any backing to them so I would imagine that the moisture could go all the way through if your cup leaked or spilled.

Fun Advent Calendar!. I am new to advent puzzle calendars. I really like how this one is done. Each day there's a little box to open that contains some puzzle pieces. The pieces are for a section of the puzzle. The quality of the pieces is very good. I haven't opened all of the boxes yet, but the ones I have have been great. Little to no puzzle dust. No peeling. Decent thickness. It comes with a poster. You will need a large area that you can devote to this nearly month long advent calendar.

Nice Cups!. I like using insulated cups with straws for my daily water intake. These cups are clear so you can easily see how much water you have left. They are durable. Two of them have pastel lids and straws and the third one is just all translucent. I would prefer if it had also been a color instead. They work well at keeping the drinks chilled for a while.

Works Great!. In my grown up years, I have always wanted to make fudge. I have never owned a candy thermometer, so I never ventured into that. Well, now there's nothing holding me back! The thermometer is a good size and much larger than the one I remembered my mom using. It's pretty easy to read, though I still have to put my reading glasses on. It works well which is the most important part!

Nice Theme. I am obsessed with decorating tiered trays. I have at least 2 different trays set up at a time. This is a nice theme. I don't think I have seen gingerbread themed ones before. I especially like the gnome and the beads. the blocks look mass produced. By that, I mean they are kind of flat and too perfect. They don't have the hand painted look to them. Overall, this is a fun set for the holidays.

Great Chairs!. My daughter just moved into a new apartment. It's unfurnished so we've been trying to fill it. These are great chairs! They are very sturdy and they look nice. The assembly is easy and straight forward. The only thing I don't like is that there's a brand tag on the seat. Most furniture pieces don't have their brand name on them in a visible spot.

Gorgeous Tumbler!. This emerald green tumbler is gorgeous! It definitely reminds me of one you might find at the local SB coffee shop. It's sturdy. It keeps my water at a cool temperature for several hours. The texture makes it easy to hold and less likely to slip out of your hands.  I like it!
Cute Pillow. This pillow arrived slightly compressed. It quickly expanded to its full size. The cat pattern is just on one side. The pillow insert is included. It's a very cute pillow!

Wonderful Baking Dish. This is a wonderful baking dish. I like the red color. It's more of a reddish/orange color than a fire engine red. The sides are a little higher than my traditional 8x13 baking dish. The quality is good. It seems sturdy. The capacity is as expected. I am curious to see what other items are in this collection.

Husband Approved. My husband is pretty picky when it comes to his kitchen tools. We have several tongs of varying lengths, but they all have silicone coating on the tips which are good when using cookware that scratches easily. My husband says they don't grab food as well and have a tendency to drop the food. I ordered these for him and he is very happy with these. They work well

Great for Tailgating!. It's college football season and these paper goods are great for tailgating! The quality of items is good. I wouldn't call them super high quality, but they're more than adequate. The set comes with 2 different sizes of disposable plates, cups, napkins, table cloth and a banner. One stop shopping!

Works in Tight Spaces. We've been needing something for the tight space next to our sofa on one end. There's a large book case in that region and that's what I have been using to put my cup on, but it always looks out of place having it on one of the shelves of the book case. This little unit fits easily into that available space. It's not entirely hidden by the bookshelf, but it looks fine. It's definitely easier for me to access my cup than the book shelf. It was quick to put together. It's seems sturdy enough. It's pretty basic, but it does the job.

Pretty!. My daughter lives in an apartment at college. Her living room walls have been pretty bare. She can't hang up things with nails, so she's been looking for something big but also light weight. She was able to hang it up with some Command strips. It has made a huge difference in her living room. She's very happy with it.

Beautiful Bird Print!. My daughter is renting a house without a dishwasher. She has a drying rack, but it doesn't keep water getting on the counter. With this mat, the counter stays dry. It's very absorbent. She loves the beautiful bird print. It's something she didn't realized that she needed, but is very glad she now has it!

Turkey Gnomes. Gnomes have been extremely popular recently. There are some for every holiday and season. These turkey ones are fun! They are the perfect size for my tiered tray. The quality is decent. The only issue that I have had with them is that the turkey feathers come wrapped around the gnome body. I have been having to roll them the opposite way to try to get them to fan out properly. I'm not there yet, so I need to keep trying. If they don't straighten up, they have a tendency to wrap around the gnome again.
Cute Cow Blanket. My daughter loves cow print. She also loves throw blankets. This is a soft and well made blanket. It's on the thin side, but good for a throw blanket. The size is just right.

Very Good Quality. I love to decorate with tiered trays. Sometimes I have multiple trays set up, but usually it's just one. I change the themes monthly to coincide with seasons and holidays. These pieces are very good quality. The pieces look nice and not the flat, mass produced ones with paint that looks perfect. There is also a good assortment of items.  I am very pleased with these.

Super Soft!. I love soft blankets! This one is super soft! It was not what I expected at all for a Vera Bradley blanket. Great for Travel!. This Vera Bradley blanket is great for travel! Although thin, it's warm and fuzzy. The size is more than big enough for an adult to use. Sturdy!. This is a sturdy melamine tray. It's great for outdoor entertaining. The design is fairly neutral for Vera Bradley! I really like it!

Nice Valentine Decor. I originally ordered these Valentine's gnomes for my tiered tray. However, when I saw them, I decided to do something else with them. Tiered Tray Decor. Tiered trays are a fun way to decorate for the holidays and seasons. This is a good set of items for St. Patrick's Day and the month of March. There is a good variety of pieces. Ornament. This ornament is a nice way to remember the late Queen Elizabeth. It has a variety of pictures of her. The ornament is ceramic. The image is okay, but it could be crisper. Also, the images are very small and not easy to see.
Fun Cups!. These red Coca-Cola cups are fun. They are very reminiscent of the ones served at some restaurants. They are fairly sturdy. They hold 24 ounces. My family enjoys these.
So Cute!. These Valentine faux beverages are so cute! They are perfect for my tiered tray. They look almost good enough to eat, or should I say drink. I am very pleased with it.

Cute Tray Decor. Valentine's Day will be here before you know it! This is cute tray decor for Valentine's Day. The variety of pieces is nice. Good Size. While I am not pleased with how I'm using this bathroom counter organizer, I am more than satisfied with it. I just quickly put some products and tools in it when I brought it to the room. Great!. These National Parks magnets are great! They would make a nice gift for an outdoorsy person who enjoys the National Parks and what they offer. These are sturdy and they stick well on the refrigerator.

Nice Variety of Items. I love decorating with tiered trays. This Christmas I plan to have 2 different trays. One will be a traditional Christmas themed one and the other will be a Grinch themed tray.
